entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 听得见吗？……行，通信正常。
entries.en: Can you hear me? ...Right, comms are good.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 欢迎来到 BERTH 07。今天第一天上班，先别碰停在外面的那些大船。
entries.en: Welcome to Berth 07. First day on the job — leave the big hulls outside alone for now.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 中间这个是 TS-1，报废穿梭机上切下来的训练舱段，正好拿来练手。
entries.en: That one in the middle is TS-1, a training section cut off a scrapped shuttle. Good for practice.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 远程操作权限已确认。训练项目 TS-1 已载入。
entries.en: REMOTE OPERATION AUTHORISED. TRAINING ITEM TS-1 LOADED.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 今天只有一条规矩：不确定的东西，先查清楚再动。
entries.en: One rule today: if you're not sure, check before you touch it.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 先把无人机飞起来。穿过那几个光环。
entries.en: Get the drone moving first. Fly through those rings.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 长的那个，按住 Shift 冲过去。
entries.en: The long one — hold Shift and dash through.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 进框，按 Space 停稳。
entries.en: Into the box, Space to stop dead.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: F 是飞行稳定。关掉试试，再开回来。
entries.en: F is flight assist. Switch it off, feel it, switch it back on.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 看到左侧那块检修盖了吗？找找它的编号。
entries.en: See the service cover on the left side? Find its number.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 设备 P-001 已识别。
entries.en: ITEM P-001 IDENTIFIED.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 现在打开工程图。
entries.en: Now open the drawing.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 图纸是设计的时候画的，船是后来撞坏的。两边不一定对得上。
entries.en: The drawing was made at design time. The ship got wrecked later. They won't always agree.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 先用它找东西，至于东西现在是什么样，你自己检查。
entries.en: Use it to find things. What state they're in now — you check that yourself.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 面板就在舱段左侧。先把摄像头拉近。
entries.en: The panel is on the left end of the section. Zoom in first.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 这块盖板已经检查过了，没有压力，也没接电。
entries.en: That cover's been checked. No pressure behind it, no power.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 任务很简单，把它完整拆下来，送进回收口。别直接拿切割器烧。四颗螺栓。
entries.en: Simple job: take it off in one piece and into a mouth. Don't burn it off. Four bolts.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 先等等。最后一个螺栓拆掉，这块板就没东西固定了。用抓钩把它稳住。
entries.en: Hold on. Take the last bolt out and nothing holds that plate. Steady it with the grapple first.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 看见没有？这地方没有地板替你接东西。下次先固定，再松最后一个连接。
entries.en: See that? There's no floor out here to catch things. Secure it first, then the last fixing.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 金属结构回收完成。回收重量 0.18 t。资产价值 120 信用点。
entries.en: METAL RECOVERED. 0.18 t. VALUE 120 CR.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 第一笔收入，够买几杯咖啡。先别急着发财，接下来还有正事。
entries.en: First earnings — a few coffees' worth. Don't get rich yet, the real work's next.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 四个角上那几颗螺栓，用维护工具一颗一颗拧。
entries.en: The bolts down its edge — wrench them out one by one.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 这块外壳后面是密封舱。想拆可以，先确认里面还有没有气。
entries.en: Behind that shell plate is a sealed bay. Fine to take it off — once you know there's no gas in there.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 读数出来了。你觉得现在能拆吗？
entries.en: There's your reading. Safe to take it off now?

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 零倒是零。可它测的是哪儿？先把工程图打开。
entries.en: It's zero, sure. But zero where? Open the drawing.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 对，先确定你测的是哪一段。
entries.en: Right. First work out which bit you actually measured.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 阀门关着，压力表根本没连到舱室。仪器没坏。是你刚才不知道它测的是什么。
entries.en: The valve's shut — the gauge never saw the bay. The meter's fine. You just didn't know what it was measuring.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 这回才是舱里的压力。要是刚才直接拆开，里面的气就全跑到船坞里了。
entries.en: That's the bay. Open it a minute ago and all that gas goes into the berth.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 这回不用着急，等泵把气收完。真空里工作，最没用的就是催机器。
entries.en: No hurry now. Let the pump take it. Out here, rushing machines gets you nothing.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 舱室压力进入训练允许范围。气体回收完成。
entries.en: BAY PRESSURE WITHIN TRAINING LIMIT. GAS RECOVERED.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 好。现在可以处理这块外壳了。
entries.en: Good. Now the plate.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 这就是拆船。你不知道里面是什么，就得一点点把它查清楚。
entries.en: That's salvage. You don't know what's inside, so you find out, one thing at a time.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 训练安全联锁启动：目标舱室状态未确认。
entries.en: TRAINING INTERLOCK: TARGET BAY NOT VERIFIED.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 真船可不会替你拦这一下。
entries.en: A real ship won't stop you like that.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: ……还好不是人。重置一下，再来。
entries.en: ...Good thing nobody was in there. Resetting. Again.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 看看测压口和舱室之间，管子上还有什么。
entries.en: Look at what sits on the line between the port and the bay.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 现在要回收这个供电模块。
entries.en: Next: recover the power module.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 控制台说主电源关了。不过旁边那盏灯还亮着。你先查查。
entries.en: The panel says main power's off. That lamp next to it says otherwise. Check.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 检测到备用供电路径。
entries.en: BACKUP SUPPLY PATH DETECTED.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 明白了吧？主电源停了，备用电池还在供电。船上的电源从来不保证只有一个。
entries.en: See? Main's off, the backup battery is still feeding it. A ship never promises just one source.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 还有电容。先让设备完成受控放电和状态验证。别急着拆。
entries.en: And there's the capacitor. Bleed it through the plug and verify. Don't rush it.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 目标电气区域验证完成。允许进行指定模块拆卸。
entries.en: ELECTRICAL ZONE VERIFIED. MODULE REMOVAL PERMITTED.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 这就对了。要是把完整模块直接烧成废铁，老板估计比电容炸了还心疼。
entries.en: That's it. Burn a whole module down to scrap and the boss would cry harder than if the cap blew.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 训练安全联锁启动：目标电气区域未验证。
entries.en: TRAINING INTERLOCK: ELECTRICAL ZONE NOT VERIFIED.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 那一下，在真船上能要命。重置。
entries.en: On a real ship that one kills. Resetting.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 灯还亮着，电是从哪儿来的？图纸的电路层里找找。
entries.en: The lamp's still lit — where's that power coming from? Look at the circuit in the drawing.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 那边还有台冷却泵。这东西能卖点钱。你把它完整取下来。
entries.en: There's a coolant pump over there. Worth something. Get it out whole.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 不用我再告诉你先查什么了吧？
entries.en: I don't need to tell you what to check first, do I?

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 别拽了。看一眼，下面还有东西连着呢。
entries.en: Stop pulling. Look — something's still attached.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 也行，至少能卖废金属。不过下次可以试着把整台拿下来，价钱差得不少。
entries.en: Fine, it'll sell as scrap. Next time try getting it out whole — big difference in price.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 不错。这才叫拆设备，不是拆垃圾。
entries.en: Nice. That's salvaging equipment, not shovelling junk.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 还有一个连接没解。
entries.en: One connection is still on.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 最后剩这些骨架。拆完训练就结束。
entries.en: Just the frame left. Clear it and training's done.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 超重了。你可以去仓库买台更大的设备，前提是老板愿意出钱。
entries.en: Too heavy. You could buy a bigger grapple — if the boss pays for it.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 今天就用现有的工具。看看能不能把它分开。
entries.en: Today you use what you've got. See if it splits.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 残液进炉子，就是这个下场。重置。
entries.en: Residue in the furnace — that's what happens. Resetting.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: TS-1 拆解任务完成。训练舱段剩余可回收结构：0。
entries.en: TS-1 DISMANTLED. RECOVERABLE STRUCTURE REMAINING: 0.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 行，至少你没把船坞一起拆了。培训先到这儿。
entries.en: Well, you didn't take the berth apart with it. That's training.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 看看图纸，那根梁是两段拼起来的。
entries.en: Check the drawing — that beam is two pieces joined together.

entries.kind: 对白或广播
entries.zh: 接下来有个小考核。想试就试，不想试也能直接接第一份合同。
entries.en: There's a short test next. Take it if you like — or go straight to your first contract.

entries.kind: 新版市场分步说明
entries.zh: 先买能直接炼钢的炉料
entries.en: Buy furnace-ready feed

entries.kind: 新版市场分步说明
entries.zh:
先把正在做的拆船合同结算掉。再按 B 打开终端，进入交易行。

左边选「黑色炉料」，品质选「等级 1」。在卖家列表里挑一笔，买 1 吨就够试一炉。

先别买「未分选金属」来炼钢：那是另一条分选流程。
entries.en:
Finish the active salvage contract. Press B and open the exchange.

Choose Ferrous Feed, grade 1, and buy 1 tonne from a seller. Mixed Metal uses the separate sorting line.

entries.kind: 新版市场分步说明
entries.zh: 买好了，先等货到仓库
entries.en: Wait for warehouse delivery

entries.kind: 新版市场分步说明
entries.zh:
付完钱，货还在路上，不是马上就能投进炉子。

打开「交付记录」，等这笔货显示「已收货」。下方的仓库炉料数量增加后，再去炉台。

贸易港要恢复营业，加工区也要完成基础修复。
entries.en:
Payment does not put feed in the furnace.

Open Deliveries and wait for Received. Check that stored feed has increased. Basic trade and processing facilities must be restored.

entries.kind: 新版市场分步说明
entries.zh: 去下方炉台，把买的料运过来
entries.en: Bring your feed to the furnace

entries.kind: 新版市场分步说明
entries.zh:
关掉交易行。从船坞地板的右端绕下去，找到左侧的「炉体操作」，靠近按 E。

选好本炉要用的数量，点「把仓库炉料送到炉口」。机器人会从仓库把你买的料运过来。

这一步只是叫机器人送料，不是凭空生成材料。等原料到炉口，再开始装炉。
entries.en:
Close the exchange. Go around the right end of the berth floor and underneath. Use E at Furnace Control on the left.

Choose the charge size and click Bring Stored Feed to Furnace. The robot moves your owned stock; it does not create material. Wait for arrival.

entries.kind: 新版市场分步说明
entries.zh: 装炉，然后加热
entries.en: Charge, then heat

entries.kind: 新版市场分步说明
entries.zh:
原料送到后，点「开始装炉」。

把加热功率调高，再点「设置功率」。看温度和熔化情况，接近出钢温度时降功率，别一直满功率烧。

机器面板会告诉你，还差哪一步才能出钢。
entries.en: After feed arrives, click Start Charging. Set heating power and apply it. Watch temperature and melting; reduce power near tapping temperature. The console explains what is still needed.

entries.kind: 新版市场分步说明
entries.zh: 测温取样，等探头收回，再出钢
entries.en: Sample, retract, then tap

entries.kind: 新版市场分步说明
entries.zh:
炉料完全熔化、温度合适后，点「测温取样」。

等测温探头完全收回，再点「倾炉出钢」。探头没收回、温度不够等情况，机器会拦住并提示原因。

这里用的是炉子的测温机构，不需要购买手持工具探针。
entries.en: When the charge is melted and hot enough, take a temperature sample. Wait for the furnace probe to retract before tapping. The console explains any safety interlock. This is the furnace mechanism, not a purchased handheld probe.

entries.kind: 新版市场分步说明
entries.zh: 等钢坯冷却，再运回仓库
entries.en: Cool and return the billets

entries.kind: 新版市场分步说明
entries.zh:
出钢后还要浇铸、冷却，然后把钢坯运回仓库。

在炉子里看见钢水，或看见刚浇好的钢坯，都不代表已经能卖。

等仓库里的合格钢坯数量增加，再安排交货。过热烧坏的低等级产品不能交给要求高等级的客户。
entries.en: After tapping, wait for casting, cooling and transport back to storage. Visible molten steel or a fresh billet is not yet sellable warehouse stock. Check qualified billet stock before dispatch.

entries.kind: 新版市场分步说明
entries.zh: 把钢坯交给客户，收到货才收钱
entries.en: Deliver the product and get paid

entries.kind: 新版市场分步说明
entries.zh:
回到交易行，打开「工业客户」。选一份需求，点「接下这笔订单」。

再选本次交货数量，点「从仓库发货」。只有自己仓库里符合等级的货才能发。

机器人把货送到客户处，客户收到后才付款。也可以用「自主挂单」给自己的库存定价出售。
entries.en: Open Industrial Clients in the exchange and accept a demand. Choose a shipment quantity and click Ship From Warehouse. Only owned eligible stock can ship. Payment follows actual receipt. You may also list stock through Limit Orders.

entries.kind: 新版市场分步说明
entries.zh: 自己拆下来的外壳和龙骨，怎么算？
entries.en: What about salvaged hull and keel?

entries.kind: 新版市场分步说明
entries.zh:
外壳、甲板、龙骨拆下来后是废料。完整设备走设备口，危险物走危险品口。

受托拆船是在替客户干活：交回东西后拿回收款，不会再把同一份料免费放进你的仓库。只有明确归公司的留料和买到的货，才是你的库存。

目前分选出来的料还是未评级原料，升级成合格炉料的流程尚未开放。现在练习炼钢，先用买来的等级 1 黑色炉料；不要把没做完的环节当成你漏找了入口。
entries.en:
Hull, decks and keel become scrap; whole equipment and hazards use their designated receivers. Commissioned salvage belongs to the client and pays a salvage fee. Only explicitly company-owned material and purchases become your stock.

Sorting currently produces unrated material. Certification into qualified feed is not available yet; use purchased grade 1 feed for steelmaking.

entries.zh: 锚已打上。把这一段切离，绞盘就会把整段拉进熔炉槽——不用切碎。整段进炉后锚留在绞盘处，记得捡。
entries.en: Anchor set. Cut this section free and the winch hauls the whole of it into the scrap trough — no need to cut it up. The anchor stays at the post afterwards: fetch it.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 传送带不收带完整设备或危险品的整段。先把设备拆下来，或把危险品排空。
entries.en: The belt won't take a section with whole equipment or a hazard on it. Take the equipment off first, or drain the hazard.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 泵在自己抽，不用守着。零件进回收口前记得把泵收回。
entries.en: The pump works by itself. Take it back before the piece goes down a mouth.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 探头留在这里，读数会一直更新，有变化会在无线电里报。
entries.en: The probe stays here: its reading keeps updating, and a change is called out on the radio.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 掉落的装备在事故位置漂着。用抓钩或部署工具点一下捡回。
entries.en: Dropped gear is drifting at the crash site. Pick it up with the grapple or the deploy tool.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 完整送进设备口的供电、热工、驱动控制类设备进了零件仓库，用来修船坞；不想留可以在终端出售。
entries.en: Power, thermal and drive equipment delivered whole goes onto the parts shelf for the berth's repairs; sell it at the terminal if you would rather have the money.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 碎屑网破了，碎块会漏掉。在终端的船坞修缮里修它。
entries.en: The debris net is torn and cut-offs slip through. Repair it under Berth Repairs at the terminal.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 先锋型的精度与稳定性有限。高风险作业建议选用重装型或泰坦型。
entries.en: Vanguard parts have limited precision and reliability. Choose Bastion or Titan for high-risk work.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示

entries.en: CABLE LENGTH LOCKED. TENSION ONLY WHEN TAUT; SLACK CABLE EXERTS NO FORCE. GRAPPLE TO TAKE OVER, OR RETRIEVE THE ANCHOR TO RELEASE IT.

entries.en: Cut while there was cargo in it. Draw the liquid off through the cargo port, then the vapour, and open it only once it is empty.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 退磁之前要先断掉牵引线圈的供电（供电柜读数归零）。
entries.en: Kill the tow coils' supply first (the supply cabinet must read zero), then degauss.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 设备口挂在天花板导轨上：按 %s 让它移到你头顶。
entries.en: The equipment bay runs on a ceiling rail: press %s to bring it overhead.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 先别急着切。用 1 测量工具点外壳上的测压口和测点，看看这艘船现在的真实状态。
entries.en: Don't cut yet. Take tool 1 to the ports and test points on the hull — find out what this ship is really like now.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 读数来自测压口实际连通的那一段。按 Tab 看图纸：测压口和舱室之间可能还隔着阀门。
entries.en: A gauge reads whatever its port is connected to. Press Tab: there may be a valve between the port and the room.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 阀门关着，软管只能抽到阀门外侧那一小段空管。
entries.en: With the valve shut the hose only reaches the empty stub outside it.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 控制台显示的是指令，不是实测：母线仍然有电。
entries.en: The panel shows what was commanded, not what is true: the bus is still live.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 指令已发出。它真的停了吗？用测量工具去测试点验证。
entries.en: Command sent. Did it actually stop? Verify at a test point.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 读数会标出仪器、测点和时间；系统一变化，旧读数就会变灰过期。
entries.en: Readings carry instrument, point and time; when the system changes they turn grey and stale.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 激光靠近设备时会闪红光。切进去设备就成了废料——想完整回收，用 4 维护工具拆它的固定件。
entries.en: The beam flashes red near equipment. Cutting into it turns it to scrap — use tool 4 on its fixings to take it out whole.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 带电部件一碰就是电弧。断开电源、放掉电容，再用电气检测仪确认 0 V。
entries.en: Live parts arc. Isolate the sources, bleed the capacitor, then confirm 0 V with the tester.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 储气罐和舱室是两回事：舱室抽空了，罐子里可能还有压力。
entries.en: A bottle is not its room: the room can be empty while the bottle is still full.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 推进剂泄漏会在附近形成危险区：别在里面用激光。
entries.en: Leaking propellant makes a hazard cloud — keep the laser out of it.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 冷却液会污染附近设备。先关两侧阀门、抽空、等温度降下来再拆。
entries.en: Coolant fouls nearby equipment. Close the valves, drain it and let it cool before you open the line.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 推进剂起火了。泄漏的地方离激光远一点。
entries.en: The propellant caught fire. Keep the laser away from leaks.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 还连着东西。用 1 检查它有几个固定件，用 4 拆掉或用 2 切断。
entries.en: Something still holds it. Inspect it with 1, then undo the fixings with 4 or cut them with 2.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 抓钩最多 3 t。切小一点，或者先拆下附属件。
entries.en: The grapple tops out at 3 t. Cut it smaller or take parts off first.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 硬扯会扯断锁扣和线缆，设备也跟着受损。下次先用 4 解开。
entries.en: Tearing breaks locks and lines and hurts the equipment. Undo them with 4 first.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 管里还有流体。先关阀、用 5 抽空。
entries.en: Still full. Close the valves and drain it with tool 5.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 冷却回路很烫——发电机还在运转时它不会凉下来。
entries.en: The coolant loop is hot — it won't cool while the generator keeps running.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 舱门电机没电。看看船坞有没有外接辅助电源的插座。
entries.en: No power for the door motors. Look for a dock aux power socket.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 舱门变形卡住了，先用 4 解除卡滞。
entries.en: The hatch is bent and jammed — clear the jam with tool 4 first.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 软管在后台抽，不用守着。按 5 可以切换回收 / 排放。
entries.en: The hose works in the background. Press 5 again to switch recover / vent.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 带压舱室被切开会爆发性失压：货物被推撞，气体收益也没了。
entries.en: Cutting into a pressurised room blows it out: cargo gets thrown and the gas is lost.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 发电机或蓄电池还在给母线供电，先断开它们的开关。
entries.en: A generator or battery still feeds the bus — open their switches first.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 零件脱离了。用 3 抓住它，拖或甩进对应的回收口。
entries.en: It's free. Grab it with 3 and haul or fling it into the right mouth.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 撞击会让设备折价。慢一点，或者用 Space 刹停。
entries.en: Impacts cost value. Slow down — Space brakes.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: 泊位上方和右侧是开放的。边缘有牵引场，会把漂出去的东西（包括你）轻轻拉回来。
entries.en: The berth is open above and to the right. A tractor field at the edge eases anything drifting out — you included — back in.

entries.kind: 训练/考核/帮助界面提示
entries.zh: R-02 损毁，新机已弹射。回到左侧机库可以免费修复。
entries.en: R-02 lost; a new one is on its way. The bay on the left repairs for free.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 螺栓
entries.en: BOLT

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 可拆的固定点，维护工具拧下即松开，零件完好。
entries.en: A fixing made to come undone: the wrench backs it out and the part stays whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 最后一颗松开，零件就没东西拉住，会带着惯性漂走。
entries.en: Take the last one out and nothing holds the part: it drifts off with whatever motion it had.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先用抓钩稳住，再松最后一颗。
entries.en: Steady it with the grapple first, then the last bolt.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 船上的螺栓多是 M12–M24 的高强度螺栓，靠预紧力把两件压在一起，承受剪切和拉力的是摩擦面而不是螺杆本身。拧松它不改变零件本身，所以“能拧就别切”：螺栓拆下的设备保留全部价值，切开的只值废金属价。失重下没有地板替你接住东西，一件 0.5 t 的板只要 0.1 m/s 的余速，十秒后就离开一米。
entries.en: Ship bolts are mostly high-strength M12–M24, preloaded so the friction between the faces carries the load, not the shank. Backing one out changes nothing about the part, hence the rule "unbolt before you cut": unbolted equipment keeps its full value, cut equipment is scrap. In free fall nothing catches what you loosen: a 0.5 t plate with 0.1 m/s left on it is a metre away ten seconds later.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 焊缝
entries.en: WELD

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 两件金属熔成一体的连接，扳手拧不开。
entries.en: Two pieces of metal fused into one. No wrench undoes it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 只能切。切开的位置决定剩下的东西还值多少。
entries.en: Only the laser parts it, and where you cut decides what the pieces are worth.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 沿焊缝或标线切，别切进设备本体。
entries.en: Cut along the seam or a marked line, never through the equipment itself.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 结构焊缝的强度和母材相当，激光要把整个截面熔透才算切开。切割速度由材料决定：普通钢板快，装甲和厚梁慢，冰和复合材料各有自己的规矩。激光前沿只按材料的限速追着光标走，贴着边慢慢推才提交切口——急着来回扫只会烧出一道浅沟。
entries.en: A structural weld is as strong as the plate around it; the beam has to melt the whole section through before it parts. How fast depends on the material: thin steel quick, armour and heavy beams slow, ice and composites with rules of their own. The cut front follows the cursor only as fast as the material lets it, and commits when it reaches the edge — sweeping back and forth just burns a shallow groove.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 锁扣
entries.en: LOCK

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 带锁销的快拆固定件，常藏在别的件后面。
entries.en: A quick-release fixing with a locking pin, often hidden behind something else.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 漏掉一个锁扣硬拽，零件会被扯坏或扯断锁扣弹开。
entries.en: Miss one and pull, and the part tears or the lock snaps and lets it fly.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 拽之前看光标提示还剩几个固定点。
entries.en: Before you pull, read how many fixings the cursor says are left.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 锁扣用在需要快速更换的地方：检修盖、可更换单元、货物托盘。它和螺栓一样能用维护工具打开，但拉力过大时会先于零件失效——所以抓钩硬拽时，被扯断的是锁扣，被撕坏的可能是零件的安装耳。拉扯只会扯断锁扣和管线，螺栓不会断。
entries.en: Locks go where things are meant to come out fast: service covers, replaceable units, cargo pallets. The wrench opens them like bolts, but under a big enough pull they fail before the part does — so when the grapple yanks, what snaps is the lock, and what tears may be the part's mounting ear. A pull only ever breaks locks and lines; bolts don't give.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 船坞夹具
entries.en: BERTH CLAMP

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 船坞的液压夹爪，把整艘船固定在泊位上。
entries.en: The berth's hydraulic jaws holding the whole ship in place.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 夹具只夹某几件结构：把它们拆走，整艘船会松脱漂移。
entries.en: They grip a few structural pieces: take those away and the ship comes loose and drifts.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 最后再拆夹具咬着的那几件。
entries.en: Leave whatever the clamps bite on until last.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 夹具通常咬在龙骨或底板上。一艘几百吨的船只要获得 0.05 m/s，撞上泊位端墙时的冲量就足以撞坏舱内松动的设备。夹具咬着的件在蓝图里有标记，拆到后半程时先确认剩下的船体还有夹具抓着。
entries.en: The clamps usually bite the keel or the floor plates. A few hundred tonnes of ship picking up 0.05 m/s hits the berth's end wall hard enough to wreck anything loose inside. The pieces the clamps hold are marked on the drawing; late in a job, check what's left is still held.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 外壳板
entries.en: HULL PLATE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 船的外皮，也是舱室的气密边界。
entries.en: The ship's skin, and the airtight wall of the rooms behind it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 舱里还有气就切开，舱压会把板和里面的东西一起喷出去。
entries.en: Cut it with air still inside and the pressure blows the plate out, and what's behind it with it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先测舱压，放气到 5 kPa 以下再动它。
entries.en: Measure the room, vent it below 5 kPa, then work on it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 一个标准大气压是 101 kPa，也就是每平方米 10 吨的力。一块 1 × 2 m 的舱壁板背后有 100 kPa，就有 20 吨在推它；切出一条缝，气流在缝口达到音速，几秒内把松动的零件和碎屑带出去。舱室低于 5 kPa 视为安全。
entries.en: One atmosphere is 101 kPa, ten tonnes on every square metre. A 1 × 2 m panel with 100 kPa behind it has twenty tonnes pushing on it; open a slit and the flow through it goes sonic, carrying loose parts and debris out within seconds. Below 5 kPa a room counts as safe.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 舱壁
entries.en: BULKHEAD

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 把船分成独立气密舱的内部隔墙。
entries.en: An internal wall dividing the ship into separate airtight rooms.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 两侧压力不同时切开，高压一侧的气体和东西冲向低压一侧。
entries.en: Cut it with different pressures each side and the high side's air and loose things rush through.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 两侧舱室都测一遍压力，先放气或平衡。
entries.en: Measure the rooms on both sides; vent or equalise first.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 舱壁让一个舱的事故不扩散到全船，也让你可以分舱处理：一个舱放完气，隔壁可能还满着。压差才是危险的来源——两侧都是 100 kPa 时切开舱壁不会爆，但两个舱从此变成一个，放气时要一起放。
entries.en: Bulkheads keep one room's trouble out of the next, and let you work room by room: one emptied, the next may still be full. The danger is the difference: with 100 kPa on both sides a cut doesn't blow, but the two rooms become one and have to be vented together.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 承力结构
entries.en: LOAD-BEARING FRAME

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 龙骨、肋骨、纵梁、支撑杆：船的骨架。
entries.en: Keel, frames, longitudinals, struts: the ship's skeleton.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 切断还在承重的骨架，它托着的部分会坠落、弹开或扭断。
entries.en: Cut a member still carrying load and what it held drops, springs or twists off.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先卸掉它托着的重量，最后再拆骨架。
entries.en: Take the weight off it first; the frame comes out last.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 失重下没有重力载荷，但还有预紧、惯性和船坞夹具传来的力：一根梁可能正把两台几十吨的设备撑在原位。骨架件通常很重，常超过抓钩 3 t 的上限，要沿标线切成段再运走。
entries.en: Free fall takes gravity away, not preload, inertia or the clamps' grip: a beam may be what keeps two machines of tens of tonnes in place. Frame pieces are heavy, often past the grapple's 3 t, and go out in sections cut along their marked lines.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 舱门与货舱门
entries.en: DOORS AND HATCHES

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 通往舱室的门，多数靠总线供电开关。
entries.en: The way into a room; most open on power from the ship's bus.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 舱里有气就开门，门会被气压推开爆开；断电后有些门打不开。
entries.en: Open it with air inside and the pressure blows it open; with the power cut some won't open at all.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先放气再开门；要开的门，在断电前开。
entries.en: Vent the room before the door; open the doors you need before you cut the power.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 一扇 2 m² 的门背后 60 kPa，就有 12 吨压在门上，电机打不开，锁一松就会被整扇推飞。货舱大门常由电机或液压驱动：先断了电池，它就只能切开。船坞的外部供电插座可以在断船电后给门临时供电。
entries.en: A 2 m² door with 60 kPa behind it carries twelve tonnes: no motor opens that, and the moment the latch gives the whole leaf flies. Big cargo doors run on motors or hydraulics: kill the battery first and the only way through is the laser. The berth's external power socket can feed a door once the ship's own power is off.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 轨道
entries.en: RAIL

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 货物、吊车或滑架沿着走的导轨。
entries.en: A guide rail cargo, cranes or cradles run along.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 切到还托着东西的轨道，那件东西会被扯坏或掉下去。
entries.en: Cut a rail still carrying something and that thing is torn or dropped.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先把轨道上的东西运走，再拆轨道。
entries.en: Move what's on the rail off it first, then the rail.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 导轨把载荷分散到很多个支座上；切断一段，载荷全落到断口两边的支座，常常超出它们的能力。锁轨货物要从轨道上开出去，不能用扳手卸——见各船的锁轨条目。
entries.en: A rail spreads its load over many mounts; cut a length and the whole load falls on the two either side of the gap, usually more than they take. Rail-locked cargo is driven off its rail, not unbolted — see the rail-locked cargo entry.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 薄膜
entries.en: FILM

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 几微米厚的聚酰亚胺膜：帆面、气囊壁、遮阳膜。
entries.en: Polyimide a few microns thick: sail panels, gasbag walls, sunshades.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 绷紧时一切就撕，裂口会沿张力方向跑开。
entries.en: Under tension it doesn't cut, it tears, and the tear runs along the load.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先松掉张力，再整块拆下。
entries.en: Slack it first, then take it off in whole panels.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 薄膜的抗撕裂强度只有每米几牛，而张紧的帆面每米承受几十牛的膜应力。激光切出的切口是一个尖锐的裂纹源，在张力下以接近声速扩展。薄膜几乎没有质量，不挡碰撞也不挡路径，但会挡光、带静电。
entries.en: Film resists tearing at a few newtons per metre; a tensioned sail panel carries tens of newtons per metre of membrane stress. A laser kerf is a sharp crack start, and under tension it runs at close to the speed of sound. Film has next to no mass and doesn't block the drone, but it shades light and holds static charge.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 电缆
entries.en: CABLE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 设备和电网之间的供电线，两端是可拔的接头。
entries.en: A power line from a device to the grid, with a plug at each end.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 带电拔或切会起弧，伤到无人机和设备。
entries.en: Pull or cut it live and it arcs, hurting the drone and the equipment.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 验电确认 0 V，再拔接头带走设备。
entries.en: Test it to 0 V, then unplug it and take the equipment.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 30 V 以下的电不会伤到无人机；船上的总线常在 28–400 V 之间，电容组可达上千伏。直流电弧不会像交流那样每秒过零 100 次自行熄灭，一旦拉起来就会一直烧。设备的电缆没拔，抓钩拉它会被拉住——拉力大了，扯断的是接头。
entries.en: Under 30 V can't hurt the drone; ship buses run 28 to 400 V and capacitor banks reach a thousand and more. A DC arc doesn't go out by itself a hundred times a second like AC does; drawn once, it keeps burning. A device still plugged in is held by its cable — pull hard enough and the plug is what tears.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 管线
entries.en: PIPE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 冷却液、燃料或气体的管路，两端有接头。
entries.en: A line for coolant, fuel or gas, with a coupling at each end.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 满管切开会漏，燃料会成可燃云，热管会烫伤。
entries.en: Cut a full line and it leaks: fuel makes a flammable cloud, a hot line burns.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 从低点排放口抽空，测温不烫，再拔或切。
entries.en: Draw it off at the low-point drain, check it's not hot, then uncouple or cut.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 管路系统里，阀门关了不等于管子空了：两阀之间总留着一段液体（死腿）。失重下漏出来的液体不会流到地上，而是变成漂浮的液团，碰到带电件就短路。60 °C 以上的管路会伤到抓取它的无人机。
entries.en: In a piping system a shut valve doesn't make the pipe empty: there's always a length trapped between two valves (a dead leg). In free fall what leaks doesn't run to the floor; it floats off in globules that short whatever live thing they touch. Lines over 60 °C hurt the drone that grabs them.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 标线（分段线）
entries.en: MARKED CUT LINE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 超重设备上预先标出的切分位置。
entries.en: Where a piece too heavy to move is meant to be cut apart.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 随便切会切进内部零件，价值大减；整件又超出抓钩上限。
entries.en: Cut anywhere else and you cut into its insides; whole, it's beyond the grapple.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 沿标线切成几段，每段都在抓钩上限以内。
entries.en: Cut along the marked lines; each section is within the grapple's limit.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 抓钩额定 3 t（升级后 5 t）。超过它的设备在设计时就留了可分段的位置：法兰、模块接缝、无管线穿过的地方。沿标线切开，每段仍按设备回收；乱切的切口会穿过绕组、管束或电路板，剩下的只值废金属。
entries.en: The grapple is rated 3 t (5 t upgraded). Equipment heavier than that was built with places it can come apart: flanges, module seams, spans no pipe or cable crosses. Cut on the lines and each section still counts as equipment; a cut anywhere else goes through windings, tube bundles or boards, and what's left is scrap.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 玻璃与舷窗
entries.en: GLASS AND WINDOWS

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 压条螺栓固定的舷窗或精密玻璃罩板。
entries.en: A window or precision glass panel held in by clamping strips.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 背后有压力时拆会被推出去碎掉；附近动激光会烤裂。
entries.en: Unbolted with pressure behind it, it's blown out and shatters; a laser nearby cracks it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先泄压，远离它切割，拧下压条整块取出。
entries.en: Vent first, cut well away from it, unbolt the strips and lift it out whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 玻璃抗压不抗拉，表面的划痕和局部热应力都会成为裂纹源。激光在 0.7 m 内工作，辐射和溅射的热能让玻璃两面温差超过 100 °C，热应力足以让它开裂。完整的光学玻璃价值远高于碎玻璃（几乎为零）。
entries.en: Glass takes compression, not tension; a scratch or a hot spot is where a crack starts. With the laser working within 0.7 m, the heat thrown off can put a hundred degrees between its faces, enough thermal stress to craze it. Whole optical glass is worth a great deal; broken, next to nothing.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 装甲
entries.en: ARMOUR

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 厚的防护板：分层装甲、隔热瓦、屏蔽层。
entries.en: Thick protective plate: layered armour, heat tiles, shielding.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 切得极慢，热量会积在切口附近，烤坏贴着它的东西。
entries.en: It cuts very slowly, and the heat building up at the kerf cooks what's behind it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 能拆螺栓就拆，切口选在远离设备的地方。
entries.en: Unbolt where you can; cut where nothing sits behind it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 装甲靠厚度和硬度吸收能量，切割速度可低到普通钢板的十分之一。屏蔽层（钨、氢化锂）则是挡辐射用的，重而脆。外挂装甲条常用螺栓挂在船体上，拆下来比切穿快得多。
entries.en: Armour soaks up energy with thickness and hardness; it may cut ten times slower than plain plate. Shielding (tungsten, lithium hydride) stops radiation, heavy and brittle. Add-on armour strips usually hang on bolts — much faster off than through.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 隔热层
entries.en: INSULATION

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 两层蒙皮夹泡沫芯的隔热壁，或多层隔热毯。
entries.en: Foam core between two skins, or multilayer insulation blanket.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 破了隔热，冷舱回温、低温罐升压就会加快。
entries.en: Break it and a cold room warms, a cryogenic tank's pressure climbs, much faster.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 冷的东西没处理完之前，别动它的隔热层。
entries.en: Leave the insulation alone until what it keeps cold is dealt with.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 真空中的多层隔热毯靠几十层镀铝膜反射热辐射，漏热只有每平方米零点几瓦；划开一道口，那一块的漏热可以高十倍以上。低温货物的回温和蒸发速率直接由隔热完好度决定。
entries.en: In vacuum, multilayer insulation stops heat with tens of aluminised films, letting through a fraction of a watt per square metre; slit it and that patch leaks ten times more. How fast cold cargo warms or boils off comes straight from how sound its insulation is.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 检修盖与护板
entries.en: SERVICE COVERS

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 挡住后面设备或固定件的盖板。
entries.en: A panel over the equipment or fixings behind it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 盖板后面的螺栓看不见、拧不到，常被漏掉。
entries.en: The bolts behind it can't be seen or reached, and get missed.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先拆盖板，再找它后面的固定点。
entries.en: Take the cover off first, then look for what's behind it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 工程图会画出盖板后面的东西，但图纸是设计时画的，不一定和现在的船对得上。被盖住的固定点在光标上不会显示，只有盖板拆走之后才可操作。
entries.en: The drawing shows what's behind a cover, but it was drawn at design time and may not match the ship now. Hidden fixings don't show under the cursor; they can only be worked once the cover is off.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 接口（测压口 / 回收口）
entries.en: PORT

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 接测量工具或回收软管的接口，接在某个舱、罐或管路上。
entries.en: A connection for the meter or the recovery hose, on a room, a tank or a line.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 它测的是它连着的那一段：中间的阀关着，读数是零也不代表舱里没气。
entries.en: It reads what it's connected to: with a valve shut in between, zero doesn't mean the room is empty.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 打开工程图，确认接口和目标之间的阀门是开的。
entries.en: Open the drawing and check every valve between the port and what you want is open.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 测压口后面常有一段短管和阀门，阀门关着时，你测到的是这段短管（死腿）里的压力。回收口用软管把气体或液体抽进船坞的回收泵：气体按价值计入合同，抽的速度由接口的口径和泵的能力决定。
entries.en: Behind a pressure port there's often a short pipe and a valve; with the valve shut, what you read is that stub (the dead leg). A recovery port takes the hose to the berth's recovery pump: the gas or liquid is paid into the contract, as fast as the port's bore and the pump allow.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 阀门
entries.en: VALVE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 开关一段管路或两个容积之间通路的手动阀。
entries.en: A hand valve that opens or shuts the way between two volumes.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 关着的阀会骗过测量；卡死的阀接不上软管。
entries.en: A shut valve fools your meter; a jammed one won't take the hose.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 维护工具开关它；卡死的先用扳手拧开。
entries.en: Turn it with the wrench; free a jammed one with the wrench first.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 阀门把系统分成段：每一段的压力、液位可以完全不同。查管路时顺着工程图从接口走到目标，每遇到一个阀门问一句：它现在是开还是关？
entries.en: Valves split a system into sections, each with its own pressure and level. Trace the drawing from the port to what you want and at every valve ask: is it open or shut right now?

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 开关
entries.en: SWITCH

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 电路的隔离开关、待发开关、刹车或锁的控制。
entries.en: A circuit isolator, an arming switch, a brake or a lock control.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断一个开关只断一路：别的电源、蓄能还在。
entries.en: One switch kills one path: the other sources and stored energy are still there.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断开后再验电或读表，确认真的归零。
entries.en: Switch it, then test or read the gauge to see it really went to zero.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: “关机不等于断电”：主开关只断主电源，备用电池、独立电源、电容组各自还可能带电。专项机制里的开关常有顺序（先冷却后刹车，先泄压后拔销），顺序错了比不动更糟。
entries.en: "Off isn't dead": the main switch isolates the main supply; backup batteries, independent supplies and capacitor banks may each still be live. The switches of a ship's special mechanisms often have an order (cooling before the brake, pressure off before the pins), and the wrong order is worse than none.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 验电点
entries.en: TEST POINT

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 电网上可以用测量工具读电压的点。
entries.en: A point on the grid where the meter reads the voltage.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 它读的是它所在那段总线；别的支路可能另有电源。
entries.en: It reads its own stretch of bus; another branch may have its own supply.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电、放电之后，再测一次确认 0 V。
entries.en: After isolating and discharging, test again for 0 V.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 读数会过期：你测完之后开关一动，旧读数就不再是现在的状态。安全的流程是“断开—放电—验电”三步，最后一步必须在前两步之后。
entries.en: A reading goes stale: switch anything after you measured and the old number is no longer the truth. The safe sequence is isolate, discharge, verify — and the verify has to come after the other two.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 探头
entries.en: PROBE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 读温度、液位、剂量、张力、转速等的传感器。
entries.en: A sensor reading temperature, level, dose, tension, speed and the like.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 不读就不知道：危险往往藏在数字里。
entries.en: Unread, you don't know: the danger is usually in the number.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 动手前用测量工具读一遍，动手后再读一遍。
entries.en: Read it with the meter before you work, and again after.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 专项机制几乎都有一个探头：线圈储能、飞轮转速、钻杆扭矩、罐压、氧浓度、剂量率、炉芯温度。读数告诉你还要等多久，或者哪一步还没做完。
entries.en: Nearly every special mechanism has its probe: a coil's stored energy, a flywheel's speed, a drill string's torque, a tank's pressure, oxygen, dose rate, a core's temperature. The reading says how long to wait, or which step isn't done.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 外部插座
entries.en: EXTERNAL SOCKET

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 船坞的临时供电、供冷或地线接口。
entries.en: Where the berth plugs in temporary power, cooling or an earth.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断了船电，有些系统还需要外来的电或冷才能安全收尾。
entries.en: With the ship's own power off, some systems still need outside power or cooling to finish safely.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断船电之前先把船坞的那一路接上。
entries.en: Plug the berth's supply in before you kill the ship's.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 船坞供电让门、泵、制冷机在船电断开后还能工作；船坞供冷让冷链货舱不回温；地线把帆面这类大面积带电体的静电导走。插座在外部面板上，接上后才算有效。
entries.en: Berth power keeps doors, pumps and chillers working after the ship's own is off; berth cooling keeps a cold hold from warming; an earth drains the static off a big charged surface like a sail. The sockets are on the outside panel and count once plugged.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 放电点
entries.en: DISCHARGE POINT

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 让电容组经电阻受控放电的开关。
entries.en: A switch that bleeds a capacitor bank through a resistor.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 电容断电后仍能存着上千焦的能量，碰一下就是电弧。
entries.en: Isolated, a capacitor still holds kilojoules; touch it and it arcs.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 打开放电，等到电量归零，再验电。
entries.en: Open the discharge, wait for it to reach zero, then test.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 电容储能 E = ½CV²：一组 0.1 F 的电容在 400 V 下存 8 kJ。经电阻放电时电压按 e^(−t/RC) 衰减，大约五个时间常数后降到 1% 以下。放电点通常在设备附近的接线盒上。
entries.en: A capacitor stores E = ½CV²: a 0.1 F bank at 400 V holds 8 kJ. Through the resistor its voltage falls as e^(−t/RC), under 1 % after about five time constants. The discharge point is usually on a junction box near the equipment.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 密封盖
entries.en: SEAL

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 把生物危险品封进密封袋或密封盖的控件。
entries.en: The control that closes a biohazard item into its seal.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 没封就搬或切，污染会散进整个舱室的空气。
entries.en: Moved or cut unsealed, it spills contamination into the room's air.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先封好，再整件送危险品口。
entries.en: Seal it first, then take it whole to the hazard mouth.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 生物污染随空气流动：舱门打开、舱壁切开，污染就扩散到隔壁舱。被污染舱室里的完好设备要走洗消，价值降四分之一。
entries.en: Contamination travels with the air: open a door or cut a bulkhead and it spreads to the next room. Whole equipment in a contaminated room has to be decontaminated and loses a quarter of its value.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 舱压
entries.en: ROOM PRESSURE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 每个密封舱里还留着的空气或工艺气体。
entries.en: The air or process gas still held in each sealed room.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 带压开口会爆开：门、板和舱里的东西一起喷出去。
entries.en: Open it under pressure and it blows: door, plate and contents thrown out.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 从接口测压，接软管放气到 5 kPa 以下，再开口。
entries.en: Measure at a port, hose it down below 5 kPa, then open it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 舱压由舱里气体的量和舱的容积决定（pV = nRT）。回收泵从接口把气抽走，压力按指数下降：舱越大、接口越小，越慢；大舱可能要几十秒。舱壁一旦有了开口，气体就从开口流向压力低的一侧，相连的几个舱会变成一个。抽走的气体按价值计入合同。
entries.en: A room's pressure comes from how much gas is in it and its volume (pV = nRT). The recovery pump draws it off through a port and the pressure falls away exponentially: the bigger the room and the smaller the port, the slower; a big hold can take tens of seconds. Once a wall has an opening, gas flows to the low side and connected rooms become one. Recovered gas is paid into the contract.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 读数会过期
entries.en: READINGS GO STALE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 测到的数字只代表测的那一刻。
entries.en: A reading is true only for the moment you took it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 之后开了阀、断了电，旧读数就不是现在的状态。
entries.en: Open a valve or cut a supply afterwards and the old number is no longer the state.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 改动之后重新测一次；过期的读数会变灰。
entries.en: After any change, measure again; stale readings grey out.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 压力变化超过 2 kPa（或 4%），或者电路的连接关系改变，读数就标为过期。船上的面板和总览屏显示的是“上一次记录”，同样可能早已过期——永远以自己刚测的为准。
entries.en: A pressure reading goes stale when the pressure moves more than 2 kPa (or 4 %); a voltage reading when the circuit's connections change. Panels and overview screens on board show their last record, which may be long out of date — trust only what you just measured.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 电网与多路电源
entries.en: POWER AND ITS SOURCES

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 发电机、电池、电容、独立电源经总线供给设备。
entries.en: Generators, batteries, capacitors and independent supplies feed the equipment over the bus.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 主电源关了，备用电池、独立电源、电容还能让设备带电。
entries.en: Main power off, a backup battery, an independent supply or a capacitor can still keep it live.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 找出每一路电源：逐个断开、放电，再验电。
entries.en: Find every source: isolate each, discharge, then test.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 工程图的电路层画出每条电缆和它连到哪里。独立电源（无人机电池、门锁备用电源、仪器的不间断电源）只供它那一小片，主开关管不到它；接在总线上的独立电源还会反过来给整条总线供电。超过 30 V 的设备拔线、切割会起弧。
entries.en: The drawing's circuit layer shows every cable and where it goes. An independent supply (a drone's battery, a door lock's backup, an instrument's UPS) feeds its own little patch, beyond the main switch's reach; one tied to the bus feeds the whole bus back. Over 30 V, unplugging or cutting draws an arc.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 热管线与余热
entries.en: HEAT

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 发动机、反应堆、炉子停了以后还热着的管线和设备。
entries.en: Lines and machines still hot after an engine, reactor or furnace stopped.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 60 °C 以上抓取会伤无人机；骤冷会让热件开裂。
entries.en: Over 60 °C they hurt the drone; quenched suddenly, hot parts crack.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 测温，让冷却系统把它带下来，冷透再拆。
entries.en: Measure, let the cooling bring it down, take it out cold.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 真空里没有对流，热只能靠辐射和传导散掉：一件几百度的设备自然冷却可能要几个小时。冷却回路有电、有液时才能带走热量；先断冷却再等，等于把它关在保温瓶里。
entries.en: In vacuum there's no convection; heat leaves only by radiation and conduction, and a machine at a few hundred degrees may take hours to cool alone. The cooling loop carries heat off only while it has power and coolant; cut it first and wait, and you've shut it in a vacuum flask.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 推进剂云
entries.en: PROPELLANT CLOUD

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 漏出的燃料蒸气在舱里或船外聚成的一团。
entries.en: Leaked fuel vapour gathering in a room or outside the hull.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 激光扫进去就点燃，起火、爆燃。
entries.en: Sweep the laser into it and it lights: fire, a flash.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先回收燃料、等云散开，再在附近切割。
entries.en: Recover the fuel and let the cloud disperse before cutting near it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 燃料蒸气只在一定浓度范围内能燃烧（肼约 4.7–100%，氢约 4–75%），太稀太浓都点不着；但云团边缘总有一圈正好在范围内。真空里云团会慢慢扩散变稀，舱里有空气时散得慢得多。
entries.en: Fuel vapour burns only within a band of concentration (hydrazine about 4.7–100 %, hydrogen 4–75 %), too lean or too rich won't light — but the edge of a cloud is always somewhere in the band. In vacuum the cloud spreads and thins; in a room with air it lingers much longer.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 火灾
entries.en: FIRE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 燃料只在有空气的舱里、或碰到氧化剂时才烧；真空里它只会蒸发、结冰、漂走。
entries.en: Fuel burns only in a room with air, or where it meets an oxidiser; in vacuum it just boils off, freezes and drifts.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 激光、电弧、带电电缆的火花、短路、刚切的红热切口、尾焰、爆炸都能点着；火逐团蔓延，舱压可升到 8 倍冲开舱门。
entries.en: Laser, arc, live-cable spark, short, fresh hot cut, thruster, blast: any lights it. It spreads; room pressure can rise 8x and blow the doors.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先把舱抽成真空再动激光；着火的舱别开门补氧，等它把氧耗光。
entries.en: Vent the room to vacuum before the laser; don't open a burning room's door to feed it air, let it use its oxygen up.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 火需要燃料、氧气和点火源三样。失重下火焰没有浮力，成一个缓慢的球，靠扩散补氧。火把舱里的氧耗光会自己灭，但燃料还在，补进空气、再来一个火星就会复燃。封闭舱里的燃烧把气体加热到几千度，压力跟着升到原来的数倍。
entries.en: Fire needs fuel, oxygen and a spark. Without gravity a flame has no buoyancy: it sits in a slow sphere fed by diffusion. A fire that uses up a room's oxygen goes out on its own, but the fuel is still there: let air in, add a spark, and it lights again. In a closed room the burning heats the gas to thousands of degrees and the pressure rises several times over.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 失重液体
entries.en: LIQUIDS IN FREE FALL

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 漏出的液体在失重下变成漂浮的液团。
entries.en: Liquid let loose in free fall becomes drifting globules.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 碰到带电设备会短路，燃料遇激光起火，低温液体冻裂设备。
entries.en: A globule shorts live equipment, fuel lights under the laser, cryogens crack what they touch.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 接软管从接口抽空，再切管或拆罐。
entries.en: Draw it off through a port with the hose before cutting the line or moving the tank.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 没有重力，液体靠表面张力收成球，保持动量直线漂移，碰到表面要么溅开、要么摊成液膜跟着那件走。液氢、液氦一出来就闪蒸掉一部分，其余边漂边沸；水在真空里几秒内结成冰球；燃料慢慢挥发，蒸气汇进可燃云；钻井泥浆落哪粘哪。
entries.en: With no gravity, surface tension pulls liquid into balls that drift in straight lines and either splash or wet the surface they meet, then travel with it. Liquid hydrogen and helium flash part away on release and boil as they drift; water freezes into a ball of ice within seconds in vacuum; fuel evaporates slowly into a flammable cloud; drilling mud sticks wherever it lands.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 回收软管
entries.en: RECOVERY HOSE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 气液回收工具接上接口，把气体或液体抽进船坞的泵。
entries.en: The recovery tool on a port, drawing gas or liquid into the berth's pump.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 接错接口会混料；抽干了还开着，有些泵会干转损坏。
entries.en: The wrong port mixes the media; left running dry, some pumps wreck themselves.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 接上后看读数下降，到量后摘下软管。
entries.en: Hose on, watch the reading fall, take it off when it's done.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 一条软管同时只接一个接口。抽速随压力（或液位）降低而变慢，按住 = 会加速时间。回收的气体和液体按市价计入合同；危险介质要接到对应的回收口，不能放到太空。
entries.en: One hose, one port at a time. The draw slows as the pressure or level drops; hold = to speed time up. What's recovered is paid into the contract at market price; hazardous media have to go to their own recovery, never to space.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 脱离与惯性
entries.en: FREE PIECES AND INERTIA

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 最后一个固定点松开，零件就成了自由漂浮的刚体。
entries.en: With its last fixing gone a part becomes a free-floating body.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 它保持原来的速度和转动，撞上别的东西会撞坏。
entries.en: It keeps its speed and spin, and whatever it runs into gets damaged.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 用抓钩接住，慢慢送进回收口。
entries.en: Catch it with the grapple and ease it into a mouth.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 失重下没有摩擦帮你停下：推一下就一直走，停下来要同样大的反推。重的件动量大，0.5 m/s 的 3 t 设备和 1.5 m/s 的 1 t 设备撞起来一样狠。船坞边缘的牵引场会把漂出去的东西慢慢拉回来。
entries.en: Free fall has no friction to stop things: a push goes on forever, and stopping takes the same push the other way. Heavy pieces carry momentum — 3 t at 0.5 m/s hits as hard as 1 t at 1.5 m/s. The tractor field at the berth's edge slowly pulls back what drifts out.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 磁力抓钩
entries.en: MAGNETIC GRAPPLE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 无人机抓住、拖动零件的工具。
entries.en: The drone's tool for holding and towing parts.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 超过额定质量拖不动；拉还连着的件会扯断锁扣和管线。
entries.en: Over its rating it can't move a load; pulling something still fixed tears its locks and lines.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先看质量和剩余固定点，再拖。
entries.en: Check the mass and the fixings left before you tow.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 抓钩额定 3 t（升级 5 t）。无人机的推力有限，拖着重物时加速慢、刹车也慢，要提前减速。还连着的件被拉时，光标会显示剩几个固定点；拉力越大，越先断的是锁扣和管线。
entries.en: Rated 3 t (5 t upgraded). The drone's thrust is limited: towing, it speeds up slowly and stops slowly, so start braking early. Pulling something still fixed, the cursor shows the fixings left; pull harder and the locks and lines go first.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 熔炉与废料口
entries.en: THE FURNACE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 泊位底部的废料口：废金属进去，熔成钢锭按吨付钱。
entries.en: The scrap mouth in the berth's floor: scrap goes in, is melted to ingots and paid by the tonne.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 危险品、带电或带压的东西进炉会炸。完整设备进炉只值废金属价。
entries.en: Hazards, live or pressurised things go off in it. Whole equipment sent in is paid as scrap.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 只送纯金属废料；6–8 m 外对准长槽甩进去就行。
entries.en: Only plain scrap; from 6–8 m out, line it up with the trough and let it go.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 炉口下面：料仓把废料压实，螺旋给料机送进一台真空感应炉。坩埚以 45 rpm 旋转，离心力把熔池压在炉衬上（约 1.4 g）。水冷铜线圈产生交变磁场，在金属里感应涡流加热（集肤深度 δ = 503·√(ρ/μf)）；炉温升到 1640 °C 出钢，倒进水冷铜锭模。真空本身就是熔炼条件。
entries.en: Under the mouth a bunker compacts the scrap and a screw feeder charges a vacuum induction furnace. The crucible spins at 45 rpm so the melt is held against the lining at about 1.4 g. A water-cooled copper coil drives eddy currents in the metal (skin depth δ = 503·√(ρ/μf)); at 1,640 °C it taps into water-cooled copper ingot moulds. The vacuum is the berth's own.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 设备回收口
entries.en: EQUIPMENT BAY

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 收完整设备的回收口，从下方送入。
entries.en: The mouth for whole equipment, fed from below.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 损坏或切开的设备按成色折价，带电带液的会出事。
entries.en: Damaged or cut equipment is marked down; live or wet equipment causes trouble.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电、排空、拔线之后整件送进来。
entries.en: Isolated, drained and unplugged, then in whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 设备按“价值 × 成色”付钱：撞击、过热、短路、污染都会降成色。合同里的指定件必须完整送达这里。离口太远时，设备口会把接收环移向你。
entries.en: Equipment pays its value times its condition: knocks, heat, shorts and contamination all lower the condition. A contract's named items must arrive here whole. Far from the bay, it moves its receiving ring towards you.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 危险品口
entries.en: HAZARD MOUTH

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 收燃料罐、电池、火工品、放射源等危险品的回收口。
entries.en: The mouth for fuel tanks, batteries, pyrotechnics, radioactive parts.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 危险品送进熔炉会爆炸或污染。
entries.en: A hazard sent to the furnace explodes or contaminates.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 光标显示“危险品”的件，只送这里。
entries.en: Anything the cursor calls a hazard goes here and nowhere else.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 危险品口按危险处理津贴付钱，不按金属价。它的口子小，要慢慢对准；拖着危险品靠近熔炉时，指导会提醒你。
entries.en: The hazard mouth pays a handling allowance, not the metal price. Its opening is small, so line up slowly; towing a hazard near the furnace draws a warning.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 牵引场
entries.en: TRACTOR FIELD

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 泊位开放边缘的力场，把漂出去的东西拉回来。
entries.en: The field along the berth's open edges, pulling back what drifts out.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 它只拉回，不刹车：高速漂出的件仍会撞上东西。
entries.en: It pulls back, it doesn't brake: something fast still hits what's in its way.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 别指望它救场，脱离前先抓住。
entries.en: Don't count on it; catch things before they go.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 泊位是半开放的：底部平台、塔架和悬臂，上方和右侧开放。牵引场在内框以外起作用，越往外拉力越大。船坞扩建时，场的边界会先外推到新的端部之外。
entries.en: The berth is half open: floor, tower and boom, open above and to the right. The field acts outside the inner frame and pulls harder the further out you go. When the berth is extended, the field's edge is pushed out past the new end first.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 船坞扩建
entries.en: BERTH EXTENSION

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 买下的扩建在现场按真实的在轨桁架施工流程建起来。
entries.en: A bought extension is built on site the way a real in-space truss job runs.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 施工时工区封闭，任何东西进去都会被牵引场推开。
entries.en: During the works the zone is closed; the field pushes anything out of it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 看着它建，或任意键跳过。
entries.en: Watch it go up, or skip with any key.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 流程：工区隔离 → 拖船推入折叠桁架盒 → 铰接桁架从储筒逐节展开（每节 0.6 m，横撑锁正后再展下一节）→ 每个模块接口先钩爪锁紧、再上 M20 10.9 级螺栓（预紧 125 kN）→ 电子束焊接缝（电子束焊需要真空，泊位本身就是）→ 管路用氦气加压到 1.5 倍工作压力检漏，同时新地板承受 1.25 倍设计载荷（挠度限值 L/800）→ 调试认证。高船进坞时，塔架顶升加节、平台同步下放。
entries.en: Close the work zone → a tug pushes in the folded truss cassettes → the articulated truss deploys bay by bay out of its canister (0.6 m a bay, each squared and locked before the next) → each module interface latched, then bolted with M20 grade 10.9 bolts at 125 kN preload → the seams electron-beam welded (EB welding needs a vacuum, which the berth is) → the lines proof-pressurised with helium at 1.5 × working pressure and leak-checked while the new floor carries 1.25 × its design load (deflection limit L/800) → commissioned. For a tall ship, the tower is jacked up section by section and the platform lowered in step.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 工程图
entries.en: THE DRAWING

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 船的设计图：管路、电路、舱室和固定件。
entries.en: The ship's design drawing: pipes, circuits, rooms and fixings.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 图是设计时画的，船是后来出事的：两者不一定对得上。
entries.en: It was drawn at design time; the ship had its accident later. They may not agree.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 用它找东西、查走向；东西现在的状态自己测。
entries.en: Use it to find things and trace lines; check their state yourself.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: Tab 打开。图上能看到盖板后面的设备、阀门在哪条管线上、每台设备的电从哪里来。改装、事故、维修留下的变化不在图上：多出来的电源、被堵的接口、补过的管子，只有现场测得出来。
entries.en: Tab opens it. It shows the equipment behind covers, which line a valve sits on, where each machine's power comes from. What modifications, accidents and repairs changed isn't on it: an extra supply, a blocked port, a patched pipe — only measuring on site finds those.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 分段与抢救合同
entries.en: PART-SHIP CONTRACTS

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 只拆指定区段，或只取指定设备的合同。
entries.en: A contract for one section only, or only for named equipment.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 动了范围外的件，损坏或拆走都要按违约扣钱。
entries.en: Damage or take anything outside the scope and you pay for it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 看清界面上画出的区段边界，范围外的不碰。
entries.en: Read the section boundary drawn on screen; leave what's outside alone.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 分段拆解只买区段内的零件，不买气体和液体；抢救单按件付固定报酬，送齐即结束，船体其余部分由拖船拖走。光标会对范围外的件标“范围外”。
entries.en: A section job buys the pieces inside it, not the gas or fluids; a salvage job pays a fixed sum per named item and ends when they're in, the rest of the hull towed away. The cursor marks out-of-scope pieces.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 搬运无人机
entries.en: HAULING DRONE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 船坞悬臂上的辅助机，把标记的零件运进回收口。
entries.en: The helper on the boom that carries marked pieces to the mouths.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 它只运你标记的件，不检查危险：带电带液的照样搬。
entries.en: It carries what you mark without checking: live or wet, it moves it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 处理完危险再右键标记，让它去运。
entries.en: Make a piece safe, then mark it (right click) and let it carry it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 搬运无人机按标记顺序排队，自己找路、选回收口。它省掉的是重复的拖运，不省判断：哪件已经安全、哪件该进哪个口，仍然由你决定。
entries.en: The hauler queues marked pieces in order, finds its own way and picks the mouth. It saves the repetitive towing, not the judgement: which piece is safe and where it goes is still yours.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 撞击
entries.en: IMPACT

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 漂浮的零件、无人机或整段船体撞上别的东西。
entries.en: A floating piece, the drone or a section of hull running into something.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 撞击按速度变化折损两边的成色，精密件最怕。
entries.en: An impact marks down both sides by the change in speed; precision parts suffer worst.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 拖运时慢一点、提前刹车，别让东西自己漂。
entries.en: Tow slowly, brake early, don't let things drift on their own.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 撞击的伤害取决于速度变化（Δv）和件的易损度。1 m/s 的撞击对钢结构无所谓，对光学玻璃或芯片就是致命的。拖着重物刹不住时，松开抓钩反而更糟：它会带着全部动量继续走。
entries.en: Damage comes from the change in speed (Δv) and how fragile the piece is. 1 m/s means nothing to steel and everything to optical glass or a chip. Towing something you can't stop, letting go is worse: it carries all its momentum on.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 配电盘
entries.en: SWITCHBOARD

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 母排、仪表和一排塑壳断路器：全船电力在这里分路。
entries.en: Busbars, meters and a stack of moulded-case breakers: where the ship's power is split up.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 它是电网的汇点，任何一路电源都可能让它带电。
entries.en: Every source on the ship can make it live; it's where they all meet.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先断所有电源，在它的验电点测到 0 V 再拆。
entries.en: Isolate every source, test 0 V at its test point, then remove it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 上部是三相母排室，下面每个分段一块仪表板和一列断路器，电缆从底部的格兰板进线。断路器断开的是负载侧：母排上游只要有一路电源没断，整块盘依然带电。母排之间的电弧温度可达上万度。
entries.en: Along the top the three-phase busbar chamber; below it each section's meter panel and a column of breakers, the cables rising through the gland plate. A breaker opens the load side only: while any source upstream is live, the whole board is. An arc between busbars runs at over ten thousand degrees.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 电池组
entries.en: BATTERY PACK

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 串联的电芯模块、汇流排、冷板和电池管理板。
entries.en: Modules of cells in series, busbars, a cooling plate and the battery management board.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断不掉的电源：开关只断外部，电芯里的能量一直在。
entries.en: A source you can't switch off inside: the switch isolates its output, not the cells.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断开它的隔离开关，拔掉输出线，整件送危险品口。
entries.en: Open its isolator, unplug its output, take it whole to the hazard mouth.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 一组 50 kWh 的锂电池在满电时储存 180 MJ。电芯短路或穿刺会热失控：电芯温度在几秒内升到 600 °C 以上，释放可燃气体并引燃相邻电芯。主接触器在模块一端，断开后电池端子之间仍有全电压。
entries.en: A 50 kWh lithium pack holds 180 MJ when full. A shorted or punctured cell runs away thermally: past 600 °C in seconds, venting flammable gas and lighting its neighbours. The main contactor sits at one end; open, the pack's own terminals still carry full voltage.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 电容组
entries.en: CAPACITOR BANK

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 一排电容罐、汇流排和放电电阻，储能供脉冲用电。
entries.en: A row of capacitor cans, busbars and a discharge resistor, storing energy for pulse loads.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电后仍保持高压，碰一下就是电弧。
entries.en: Isolated it still holds its voltage; touch it and it arcs.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 找到它的放电点，放到 0 再验电。
entries.en: Find its discharge point, bleed it to zero, then test.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: E = ½CV²：0.1 F 在 400 V 下存 8 kJ，发射系统的电容组可达兆焦级。电容没有“关”：只能放电。放电电阻按 RC 时间常数把能量变成热，约五个时间常数降到 1%。
entries.en: E = ½CV²: 0.1 F at 400 V holds 8 kJ, and a launcher's bank holds megajoules. A capacitor has no off, only discharged. The resistor turns its energy to heat on the RC time constant, under 1 % after five of them.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 发电机组
entries.en: GENERATING SET

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 发动机拖动的发电机，带散热器、励磁机和控制屏。
entries.en: An engine driving an alternator, with radiator, exciter and control panel.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 停机不等于断电：别的电源会经总线倒送到它的出线端。
entries.en: Stopped isn't dead: other sources feed back to its terminals through the bus.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 确认停机，断开它的出线，验电后拆。
entries.en: Confirm it's stopped, isolate its output, test, then remove.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 发电机的转子是凸极磁极，定子槽里嵌着绕组；转起来时，即使励磁断开，剩磁也能发出几十伏。机组质量常在 1–3 t，底座有减振器，螺栓都在底座上。
entries.en: The rotor carries salient poles, the windings sit in the stator slots; spinning, even unexcited, the residual magnetism gives tens of volts. A set weighs 1–3 t; its bolts are on the base frame, under the anti-vibration mounts.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 控制箱
entries.en: CONTROL ENCLOSURE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 墙挂的电气控制箱：门、指示灯窗、端子和格兰。
entries.en: A wall-hung electrical enclosure: door, indicator window, terminals and glands.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 箱子小，接进来的电源可能不止一路。
entries.en: Small box, possibly more than one supply into it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 按工程图找全它的进线，逐一断开再拆。
entries.en: Find every incoming line on the drawing, isolate each, then remove it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 控制箱里多是继电器、PLC 和端子排，自身价值不高但接线密集；拆它之前把每根进线都处理掉，比拆完再一根根找省事。
entries.en: Inside are relays, a PLC and terminal rails: not worth much, but densely wired. Deal with every incoming line before removing it rather than chasing them afterwards.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 接线盒
entries.en: JUNCTION BOX

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 四角螺钉的盒盖、接地螺柱、进出线格兰。
entries.en: A lid on four corner screws, an earth stud, cable glands in and out.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 多条电缆在这里分支，常有验电点或放电点。
entries.en: Cables branch here; test points and discharge points often sit on it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 在这里验电和放电，再处理它连着的设备。
entries.en: Test and discharge here, then deal with what it feeds.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 接线盒是电路的“路口”：查一台设备的电从哪来，从它的接线盒倒着找最快。
entries.en: A junction box is a crossroads of the circuit: to find where a device's power comes from, work back from its junction box.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 变压器
entries.en: TRANSFORMER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 三柱铁芯、高低压绕组和夹紧框架的干式变压器。
entries.en: A dry-type transformer: three-limb core, low- and high-voltage windings, clamping frame.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 一侧有电，另一侧就有电：从低压侧倒送也会升出高压。
entries.en: Live on one side means live on the other: back-fed from the low side it puts out high voltage.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 高低压两侧都断开、验电，再拆。
entries.en: Isolate and test both sides before removing it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 绕组匝比决定电压比，10:1 的变压器从低压侧倒送 400 V，高压侧就是 4 kV。干式变压器很重，铁芯占了大半质量，常要沿夹件分开运。
entries.en: The turns ratio sets the voltage ratio: back-feed 400 V into a 10:1 transformer's low side and its high side sits at 4 kV. It's heavy, most of it core, and often has to come apart at its clamps to move.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 逆变器
entries.en: INVERTER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: IGBT 模块、散热器、直流母线电容和输出电抗器。
entries.en: IGBT modules on a heat sink, DC-link capacitors and an output choke.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电后直流母线电容还存着电，几分钟才自放完。
entries.en: Off, its DC-link capacitors still hold charge for minutes.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断开直流输入，等放电或接放电点，验电后拆。
entries.en: Isolate its DC input, wait or bleed it down, test, then remove.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 逆变器把直流斩成交流驱动电机。直流母线电容是它的“蓄水池”，额定电压常在 600–800 V，自带的泄放电阻要几分钟才能把它放到安全电压。
entries.en: An inverter chops DC into AC for a motor. Its DC-link capacitors are its reservoir, rated 600–800 V, and its own bleed resistors take minutes to bring them down to a safe level.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 燃料电池
entries.en: FUEL CELL STACK

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 上百片双极板夹在端板之间，拉杆紧固，配鼓风机和加湿器。
entries.en: Hundreds of bipolar plates between end plates and tie rods, with blower and humidifier.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 只要还有氢和氧，它就在发电：关了总线它照样带电。
entries.en: With hydrogen and oxygen left, it generates: kill the bus and it's still live.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断它自己的开关，关燃料阀、抽空氢气，再拆。
entries.en: Switch it off at its own switch, shut and draw off the hydrogen, then remove it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 每片电池约 0.7 V，几百片串联到几百伏。电堆内的氢气即使阀门关了也会残留，泄漏到舱里就形成可燃云（氢的燃烧范围 4–75%，点火能极低）。
entries.en: Each cell gives about 0.7 V; hundreds in series make hundreds of volts. Hydrogen stays in the stack after the valves shut, and leaked into a room it makes a flammable cloud (4–75 % in air, the smallest of sparks lights it).

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 充电桩
entries.en: CHARGING STATION

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 给无人机或车辆充电的模块，带枪头和线缆。
entries.en: A charging unit for drones or vehicles, with its connector and cable.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 接着充电线时，两头都可能带电。
entries.en: With the cable plugged in, both ends may be live.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断开充电开关，拔掉充电线，再动它充的东西。
entries.en: Switch the charger off and unplug the lead before touching what it charges.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 充电桩自己从总线取电，又把电送进被充的设备；被充的设备若自带电池，拔线时电池一侧也带电。
entries.en: A charger takes power from the bus and puts it into what it charges; if that has its own battery, the battery end of the lead is live too.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 泄能电阻
entries.en: DUMP RESISTOR

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 一排排来回折叠的不锈钢带，接在超导磁体的泄能回路上。
entries.en: Banks of stainless ribbon folded back and forth, on a superconducting magnet's dump circuit.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 泄能时它把磁能变成热，满负荷时发红；拆了它磁体就无处泄能。
entries.en: Dumping, it turns stored field energy into heat and glows; take it away and the magnet has nowhere to dump.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 磁体泄完能之前，别动它和它的母排。
entries.en: Leave it and its busbars alone until the magnets are run down.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 线圈电流经泄能电阻衰减：I = I₀·e^(−t/τ)，τ = L/R。电阻越大泄得越快，但线圈两端电压 = I·R 也越高。几十吉焦的储能在几十秒内变成热，电阻带温度可升到几百度。
entries.en: The coil's current falls through the resistor as I = I₀·e^(−t/τ), τ = L/R. More resistance dumps faster but puts more voltage (I·R) across the coil. Tens of gigajoules become heat in tens of seconds; the ribbon reaches hundreds of degrees.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 滑环
entries.en: SLIP RING

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 旋转侧的一叠铜环和固定侧的电刷，给转动的环供电。
entries.en: A stack of rings on the turning side and brushes on the fixed side: power into something spinning.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 环带电时刹车，电机回馈电流穿过滑环会烧毁它。
entries.en: Brake a ring while its bus is live and the motor's regenerated current burns the slip ring.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先断环上的负载，再刹车消旋。
entries.en: Take the ring's loads off before braking it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 电刷在铜环上滑动导电，电流密度有限；回馈电流和起弧会在环面烧出凹坑。它是旋转居住环唯一的电力通路。
entries.en: The brushes slide on the rings to carry current, which has a limit; regenerated current and arcing pit the ring faces. It's the habitat ring's only way in for power.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 电缆桥架
entries.en: CABLE TRAY

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 顶板下的梯式桥架，里面成捆的电缆，配灯和喷头。
entries.en: A ladder tray under the deckhead, cables bundled in it, lights and sprinklers along it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 桥架里的电缆一根带电，整捆都不能切。
entries.en: One live cable in the bundle and none of it can be cut.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断开它承载的电路，再拆桥架。
entries.en: Isolate the circuits it carries, then take the tray.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 桥架本身只是金属结构，危险来自它承载的线：动力、信号、控制混在一起，拆之前按电路层把每路都确认掉。
entries.en: The tray is just metalwork; the danger is what it carries — power, signal and control mixed together. Check every circuit in it on the drawing before it comes out.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 可更换单元（ORU）
entries.en: ORBITAL REPLACEMENT UNIT

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 为整件更换设计的密封箱：两个抓手、自锁螺钉、盲插接头。
entries.en: A sealed box made to be swapped whole: two grab handles, captive fasteners, blind-mate connectors.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 接头面插着时硬拽，会撕坏背板的接头。
entries.en: Pulled while still mated, it rips the connectors off the backplane.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 松开自锁螺钉，断电后整件拔出。
entries.en: Undo the captive fasteners and pull it whole once power is off.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: ORU 是航天器“整件更换”的思路：机械臂或宇航员戴手套就能操作，所以它是最好拆的设备之一，完整价值也最高。
entries.en: The ORU is how spacecraft are maintained by swapping whole units — a robot arm or a gloved hand can do it — which makes it one of the easiest things to recover whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 离心泵组
entries.en: CENTRIFUGAL PUMP SET

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 蜗壳、轴承架、联轴器和电机装在同一底座上。
entries.en: Volute, bearing frame, coupling and motor on one baseplate.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 进出口管还满着、电机还带电：切管漏液，拔线起弧。
entries.en: Its lines still full, its motor still live: cut a line and it leaks, pull the lead and it arcs.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电、从排放口抽空，拔线拔管后整件拆下。
entries.en: Isolate, drain at the low point, uncouple lines and lead, then lift it whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 离心泵靠叶轮把液体甩向蜗壳外缘，速度变成压力。它最怕干转：没有液体冷却和润滑，机械密封几十秒内就会烧坏。完整的泵价值远高于废金属。
entries.en: The impeller flings liquid to the volute's rim, turning speed into pressure. It hates running dry: with no liquid to cool and lubricate it, the mechanical seal burns within tens of seconds. Whole, a pump is worth far more than its metal.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 管壳式换热器
entries.en: SHELL-AND-TUBE HEAT EXCHANGER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 壳体里的管束，两种介质隔着管壁换热。
entries.en: A tube bundle in a shell: two fluids trading heat through the tube walls.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 壳程和管程是两套液体，常常一套空了另一套还满。
entries.en: Shell side and tube side are two fluids; one emptied, the other may still be full.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 两侧都排空，再拆它的管口。
entries.en: Drain both sides before opening its nozzles.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 折流板让壳程液体来回横穿管束，提高换热系数。一台换热器里两侧的压力、温度、介质都不同，它的四个管口要分开处理。
entries.en: Baffles send the shell-side fluid back and forth across the bundle to raise the heat transfer. Each side has its own pressure, temperature and medium, and its four nozzles are four separate jobs.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 散热板
entries.en: RADIATOR PANEL

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 两端集管之间排满流道管的散热面，靠辐射把热排进太空。
entries.en: Flow tubes between two headers across a fin sheet, radiating heat to space.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 管里还有冷却液；系统还热时收拢或拆下，板会变形。
entries.en: Its tubes still hold coolant; folded or removed while the system is hot, it deforms.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 等冷却回路把热带走、排空后再拆。
entries.en: Let the loop carry the heat away and drain it before you take it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 太空中散热只能靠辐射：P = εσAT⁴。在 300 K，每平方米约排 400 W，所以散热板要做得很大。板面薄而轻，铰链接在吊杆上，抓住它要轻。
entries.en: In space heat only leaves by radiation: P = εσAT⁴. At 300 K a square metre sheds about 400 W, which is why radiators are big. The panels are thin and light, hinged to their booms; handle them gently.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 制冷机组
entries.en: CHILLER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 压缩机、冷凝器、膨胀阀和蒸发器组成的制冷回路。
entries.en: Compressor, condenser, expansion valve and evaporator in one refrigeration loop.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 一停或一切坏，它保冷的货舱或设备就开始回温。
entries.en: Stopped or cut, whatever it keeps cold starts to warm.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先接上船坞供冷或处理完冷货，再停它。
entries.en: Plug in berth cooling or deal with the cold cargo before stopping it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 制冷剂在蒸发器里吸热沸腾，被压缩后在冷凝器里放热凝结。回路里的制冷剂要从储液罐回收口闭环回收，不能放空。
entries.en: The refrigerant boils in the evaporator taking heat in, is compressed, and condenses in the condenser giving it out. It's recovered in a closed loop from the receiver's port, never vented.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 超低温冷柜
entries.en: ULTRA-LOW FREEZER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: −80 °C 的样品或药品冷柜：保温门、控制器、压缩机舱。
entries.en: A −80 °C freezer for samples or medicine: insulated door, controller, compressor bay.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电后里面的东西慢慢回温，有的样品一回温就作废。
entries.en: Off, its contents slowly warm, and some samples are lost the moment they do.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 带电整件送设备口，或先确认里面没有需要保冷的东西。
entries.en: Send it whole while powered, or check nothing in it needs the cold.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 保温良好的冷柜断电后每小时回温几度；门一开就快得多。冷链货物的价值往往取决于它从没超过某个温度。
entries.en: A well-insulated freezer warms a few degrees an hour unpowered, much faster with the door open. Cold-chain goods are often worth what they are only if they never went above a set temperature.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 空气处理机
entries.en: AIR HANDLING UNIT

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 进风阀、过滤器、冷却盘管、离心风机和送风箱。
entries.en: Intake damper, filter, cooling coil, centrifugal fan and discharge plenum.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 盘管里有冷却液，接水盘可能有积水；风机由总线供电。
entries.en: Its coil holds coolant and its drain pan may hold water; the fan runs off the bus.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电、排空盘管，再拆风管和底座螺栓。
entries.en: Isolate, drain the coil, then the ducts and the base bolts.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 空气处理机让舱里的空气循环、降温、除湿。它是舱室里最大的设备之一，沿气流方向一段段排开；舱里的空气压力和它无关，放气要走舱的接口。
entries.en: It circulates, cools and dries a room's air. It's one of the biggest things in a room, laid out along its airflow; the room's pressure is nothing to do with it — vent through the room's own port.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 风道轴流风机
entries.en: AXIAL DUCT FAN

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 风道里的电机、叶片和导流叶。
entries.en: A motor, blades and straightener vanes inside a duct.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 带电拆接线盒会起弧；叶轮可能还在惯性转动。
entries.en: Its terminal box arcs if opened live; the impeller may still be coasting.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电，等叶轮停下，再拆法兰。
entries.en: Isolate, let it spin down, then unbolt the flanges.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 风机断电后叶轮靠惯性还能转一阵，真空里没有空气阻力，会转得更久。
entries.en: An unpowered fan coasts on; in vacuum, with no air to slow it, for longer still.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 过滤器
entries.en: CARTRIDGE FILTER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 壳体里的折叠滤芯，进出口、压差表和排放阀。
entries.en: A pleated element in a housing, with inlet, outlet, a differential gauge and a drain valve.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 滤芯截留的东西可能有毒、有污染、或带放射性。
entries.en: What the element caught may be toxic, contaminated or radioactive.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先排空，带污染的滤芯封好送危险品口。
entries.en: Drain it; a contaminated element is sealed and sent to the hazard mouth.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 压差表读滤芯两侧的压降，堵得越多压降越大。隔离舱、核设施、生物舱的过滤器本身就是危险品。
entries.en: The differential gauge reads the drop across the element, rising as it clogs. In isolation rooms, reactors and bio bays the filter is itself a hazard.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 疏水器
entries.en: CONDENSATE TRAP

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 倒置浮桶式疏水器：排出冷凝水、留住蒸汽。
entries.en: An inverted-bucket trap: lets condensate out, keeps steam in.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 蒸汽管路里的它可能又热又带压。
entries.en: On a steam line it may be hot and under pressure.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 测温、泄压后再拆。
entries.en: Measure the temperature, relieve the pressure, then remove it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 浮桶里有蒸汽时浮起关阀，有冷凝水时下沉开阀。失重下它靠的是压差和流动，不是浮力——船上的疏水器都是改过的。
entries.en: Steam floats the bucket and shuts the valve, water sinks it and opens it. Without gravity it works on pressure difference and flow rather than buoyancy — ship traps are modified for it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 阀组（总管）
entries.en: VALVE MANIFOLD

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 一根总管上分出多路支管，每路一个隔离阀。
entries.en: One header with several branches, each with its isolating valve.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 每路支管里的介质、压力可能不同，拆总管时各路一起漏。
entries.en: Each branch may hold a different medium at a different pressure; take the header off and they all leak.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 逐路关阀、排空、测过，再拆总管。
entries.en: Shut, drain and check branch by branch, then the header.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 阀组让一台泵服务多个罐。开着的支路之间是连通的：抽一个罐时其它罐的阀没关，会一起被抽，或者在总管里混料。
entries.en: A manifold lets one pump serve many tanks. Open branches are connected: draw one tank with the others' valves open and they're drawn too, or mixed in the header.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 调节阀
entries.en: CONTROL VALVE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 球形阀体、阀盖、膜片执行器和定位器：自动调节流量的阀。
entries.en: Globe body, bonnet, diaphragm actuator and positioner: a valve that sets a flow by itself.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 执行器断气断电时会自动走到“故障位”，可能开也可能关。
entries.en: With its air or power gone it goes to its fail position, which may be open or shut.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 别靠它隔离；用手动阀隔离后再拆。
entries.en: Don't rely on it to isolate; isolate with hand valves, then remove it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 调节阀按控制信号连续开度，阀芯有间隙，本来就不是密封用的。故障开（FO）的阀在断电后全开。
entries.en: A control valve throttles continuously to its signal; its trim has clearances and was never meant to seal. A fail-open valve goes fully open when the power goes.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 安全阀
entries.en: PRESSURE RELIEF VALVE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 弹簧压着阀芯，超压时自动开启泄放。
entries.en: A spring holds the disc shut; over its set pressure it lifts and vents.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 冻住、堵住的安全阀不会开：罐压会一直升到爆。
entries.en: Frozen or blocked, it won't lift: the pressure climbs until the vessel bursts.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 测阀体温度，冻住的先解冻，或从接口抽低压力。
entries.en: Read its body temperature; thaw a frozen one, or draw the pressure down at a port.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 安全阀是压力容器最后一道保护，整定压力通常是设计压力的 1.0–1.1 倍；起跳后压力降到回座压力才重新关闭。低温罐的安全阀出口会被泄放的冷气冻上冰塞。
entries.en: The relief valve is a pressure vessel's last line, set at 1.0–1.1 × its design pressure; once lifted it reseats only below its reseat pressure. On a cryogenic tank, the cold gas it vents can freeze an ice plug in its own outlet.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 管路
entries.en: PIPE RUN

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 带法兰、保温和吊架的一段管道。
entries.en: A length of pipe with flanges, lagging and hangers.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 满管切开会漏液或喷出可燃物。
entries.en: Cut full, it leaks or sprays something flammable.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 上下游关阀、从低点排空，再拆法兰。
entries.en: Valve it off both ends, drain from the low point, then unbolt the flanges.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 拆法兰比切管干净：法兰螺栓松开后管段完整，可以整段回收。管段里残留的液体在失重下不会自己流出来，要靠抽。
