entries.en: Unbolting a flange is cleaner than cutting: the spool comes away whole. What's left inside won't run out by itself without gravity; it has to be drawn.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 液压站
entries.en: HYDRAULIC POWER UNIT

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 油箱、电机泵、蓄能器、电磁阀块和压力表。
entries.en: Reservoir, motor-pump, accumulators, solenoid valve block, pressure gauge.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 蓄能器里存着高压油：断电后压力还在，管一切就喷。
entries.en: Its accumulators hold oil under pressure: off, the pressure stays, and a cut line sprays.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 开泄压阀把蓄能器压力放到 0，再拆管和机构。
entries.en: Open the dump valve, bring the accumulators to zero, then the lines and what they drive.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 液压系统常在 20 MPa 以上工作：一个 20 L 的蓄能器在 20 MPa 时存约 200 kJ。它驱动的缸、夹钳、机械臂只要还保着压，就是一根压缩着的弹簧。
entries.en: Hydraulics often run above 20 MPa: a 20 L accumulator at 20 MPa holds about 200 kJ. Every cylinder, clamp and arm it drives is a compressed spring while it holds pressure.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 直线作动器
entries.en: LINEAR ACTUATOR

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 电机、皮带、滚珠丝杠和推杆：把转动变成直线推力。
entries.en: Motor, belt, ball screw and rod: rotation turned into a straight push.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 带电时控制线一断，推杆可能猛地一动；它顶着的东西没锁会掉。
entries.en: Live, a cut control line can jerk the rod; what it holds up drops if unlocked.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先锁住它或它支撑的东西，断电后再拆。
entries.en: Lock it or what it carries, kill its supply, then remove it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 滚珠丝杠效率高，反过来也能被推动：断电后没有刹车的作动器会被负载推着倒转。精密场合（镜片促动器）有专门的锁定机构。
entries.en: A ball screw is efficient enough to be back-driven: unpowered and unbraked, the load pushes it round. Precision uses — a mirror's actuators — have their own locks.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 气瓶
entries.en: GAS CYLINDER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 带瓶阀和手轮的高压气瓶，色环标出气体种类。
entries.en: A high-pressure cylinder with valve and handwheel, coloured bands naming the gas.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 高压气瓶被切开才会爆裂：气体冲进舱里或漂散，瓶阀断掉时整瓶像火箭一样飞出去。
entries.en: A full cylinder only bursts when cut: the gas floods the room or drifts off, and with its valve sheared it flies like a rocket.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 密封完好的满瓶整瓶送设备回收口；要放气就从它的 -V 接口放，别切。
entries.en: A sealed full cylinder goes whole to the equipment mouth; to empty it, vent at its -V port. Never cut it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 一只 50 L、200 bar 的气瓶储存约 1.5 MJ 的压缩能。瓶阀断掉时，喷口推力可达瓶重的几十倍。氧气瓶还会让周围的东西更容易燃烧。
entries.en: A 50 L cylinder at 200 bar holds about 1.5 MJ. With its valve sheared off, the jet's thrust is tens of times its weight. An oxygen cylinder also makes everything round it burn more readily.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 推进剂 / 工艺储罐
entries.en: PROPELLANT TANK

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 卧在鞍座上的压力容器，内有防晃隔板，顶部管口和液位计。
entries.en: A pressure vessel in its saddles, with baffles inside, nozzles on top and a level gauge.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 还有液或带压就切会爆；漏出的燃料成可燃云。
entries.en: Cut with liquid or pressure in it, it bursts; leaked fuel makes a flammable cloud.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 从回收口抽空、泄掉罐顶气，整件送危险品口。
entries.en: Draw it empty at its port, vent the ullage, take it whole to the hazard mouth.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 储罐上方的气垫（罐顶气）保持罐压，让泵吸得进液体。抽液时要么维持增压，要么让空气补进来；在真空里只抽不补，罐会被抽瘪。
entries.en: The gas cushion above the liquid (the ullage) keeps the tank pressurised so the pump can draw. Drawing off, either keep the pressurisation on or let gas in; in vacuum, drawing alone can collapse the tank.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 球形压力罐
entries.en: SPHERICAL TANK

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 赤道环焊缝、安装耳、推进剂管理叶片和顶部加注阀。
entries.en: A girth weld, mounting tabs, propellant management vanes and a fill valve on top.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 球罐承压最高：切开就是一次爆炸。
entries.en: Spheres carry the highest pressures: cutting one is an explosion.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 测压，从接口泄压到安全，再拆安装耳。
entries.en: Measure, relieve it at the port, then unbolt its tabs.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 同样壁厚，球的承压能力是圆筒的两倍，所以高压气体和推进剂常装在球罐里。失重下推进剂管理叶片靠毛细作用把液体引到出口。
entries.en: For the same wall a sphere holds twice the pressure of a cylinder, so high-pressure gas and propellant go in spheres. In free fall the vanes wick the liquid to the outlet by capillary action.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 低温储罐
entries.en: CRYOGENIC TANK

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 真空夹套里的内罐：液氢、液氮或液化天然气在沸点下储存。
entries.en: An inner tank in a vacuum jacket: liquid hydrogen, nitrogen or LNG stored at its boiling point.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 一直在蒸发升压；安全阀冻住就会爆罐。
entries.en: It boils off all the time and its pressure climbs; with its relief valve frozen it bursts.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 保持制冷，边抽边降压，最后再断电。
entries.en: Keep it refrigerated, draw it down to lower the pressure, cut the power last.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 液氢在 −253 °C、液氮在 −196 °C 沸腾。热量每漏进一点，就蒸发一点液体变成气体，体积膨胀几百倍——这就是低温罐压力不断上升的原因。真空夹套一破，漏热增加十倍。
entries.en: Liquid hydrogen boils at −253 °C, nitrogen at −196 °C. Every bit of heat that leaks in boils some liquid off, expanding hundreds of times — which is why a cryogenic tank's pressure keeps rising. Lose the vacuum jacket and the heat leak goes up tenfold.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 水箱
entries.en: WATER TANK

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 带人孔、通气管、防晃板和液位镜的水箱。
entries.en: A tank with manway, vent, baffles and a sight glass.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 切开后水漂出来，碰到带电设备就短路。
entries.en: Cut open, the water drifts out and shorts what it touches.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 从出水阀或接口抽空，再拆。
entries.en: Draw it off at the outlet or a port, then remove it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 水在真空里先剧烈沸腾，蒸发吸热让剩下的水在几秒内结冰，成为缓慢升华的冰球。水是船上值钱的货：几立方米的水按合同价计。
entries.en: In vacuum water boils hard at first; the evaporation chills the rest into a slowly subliming ball of ice within seconds. Water is worth money: cubic metres of it are paid into the contract.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 灭火瓶
entries.en: FIRE SUPPRESSION BOTTLE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 带释放头、压力表和电磁启动器的灭火剂瓶。
entries.en: A suppressant bottle with discharge head, gauge and solenoid actuator.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 启动器带电时误触发会喷放；瓶本身是高压容器。
entries.en: Its actuator, if live, can fire it; the bottle itself is a pressure vessel.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 需要灭火时用它；不用就断电后整瓶送危险品口。
entries.en: Use it if there's a fire; otherwise isolate it and send it whole to the hazard mouth.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 船上常用 CO₂、哈龙替代品或泡沫。在密闭舱里喷放 CO₂ 能把氧浓度降到燃烧下限以下，但也意味着这个舱里的气体不能再按空气回收。有的船上灭火瓶早已空了——测一下压力表。
entries.en: Ships carry CO₂, halon replacements or foam. Discharged in a closed room CO₂ takes the oxygen below what burns, though the room's gas is no longer clean air to recover. Some ships' bottles are long empty — read the gauge.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 应急氧气柜
entries.en: EMERGENCY OXYGEN CABINET

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 玻璃门里两只氧气瓶、减压器和面罩。
entries.en: Two oxygen cylinders behind a glass door, a regulator and a mask.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 高压纯氧：附近动激光会让火势猛增。
entries.en: High-pressure pure oxygen: a laser near it makes any fire far fiercer.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 关瓶阀，整柜送危险品口。
entries.en: Shut the cylinder valves and send the cabinet whole to the hazard mouth.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 氧气本身不燃，但能让几乎所有东西燃烧得更快、更热；浸过氧的织物、油脂甚至金属屑都可能被点燃。
entries.en: Oxygen doesn't burn itself but makes almost anything burn faster and hotter; oxygen-soaked fabric, grease, even metal swarf can light.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: CO₂ 洗涤器
entries.en: CO₂ SCRUBBER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 双床胺吸收（或沸石）罐、切换阀和鼓风机。
entries.en: Twin amine (or zeolite) beds, switching valves and a blower.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 吸附床里富集着 CO₂，再生管线通向真空。
entries.en: The beds hold concentrated CO₂; the regeneration line opens to vacuum.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电，关切换阀，再拆。
entries.en: Isolate it, close the switching valves, then remove it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 两个床交替工作：一个吸附舱里的 CO₂，另一个对真空解吸再生。人呼出的 CO₂ 浓度过 1% 就会头痛，过 5% 有生命危险。
entries.en: The beds take turns: one absorbs the cabin's CO₂ while the other desorbs to vacuum. Above 1 % CO₂ people get headaches; above 5 % it's dangerous.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 变压吸附分离器
entries.en: PRESSURE-SWING ADSORPTION

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 两根吸附塔和上下切换阀组：从混合气里分离出某种气体。
entries.en: Two adsorber columns and switching manifolds: one gas separated out of a mixture.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 塔里有压力，分离出的可能是纯氧、纯氮或氢。
entries.en: The columns are under pressure, and what they separate may be pure oxygen, nitrogen or hydrogen.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 关进气，从接口泄压，再拆。
entries.en: Shut the feed, relieve it at a port, then remove it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 分子筛在高压下多吸附某种分子、低压下放出，两塔交替加压减压，就能连续产出纯气。纯氮环境会让人无预兆地窒息。
entries.en: A molecular sieve takes up one kind of molecule at high pressure and lets it go at low; two columns swinging in turn make a steady stream of pure gas. Pure nitrogen suffocates without warning.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 电解制氧机
entries.en: WATER ELECTROLYSER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 电解槽、氢氧气液分离器、循环泵和整流器。
entries.en: Cell stack, hydrogen and oxygen separators, circulation pump and rectifier.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 同时有氢、有氧、有电：泄漏就是爆鸣气。
entries.en: Hydrogen, oxygen and power in one place: a leak is a detonating mixture.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电，两侧气体分别放空，再拆。
entries.en: Isolate it, vent each gas separately, then remove it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 电解 1 kg 水产生约 1.24 m³ 氢气和 0.62 m³ 氧气，耗电约 5 kWh。氢氧以 2:1 混合是最猛烈的爆鸣气。
entries.en: Splitting 1 kg of water gives about 1.24 m³ of hydrogen and 0.62 m³ of oxygen for some 5 kWh. Mixed two to one they make the most violent of detonating gases.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 加湿器
entries.en: STEAM HUMIDIFIER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 电极沸腾筒、进排水阀、蒸汽软管和控制盒。
entries.en: Electrode boiling cylinder, fill and drain valves, steam hose, control box.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 筒里是热水和带电的电极。
entries.en: Hot water and live electrodes in the cylinder.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电，排水，再拆。
entries.en: Isolate, drain, then remove it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 电极式加湿器让电流直接穿过水把它烧开：水的导电性决定功率。断电后筒里的水仍然很烫。
entries.en: An electrode humidifier boils water by passing current straight through it; the water's conductivity sets the power. The water stays hot after it's switched off.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 紫外消毒器
entries.en: UV STERILISER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 不锈钢腔体中间一根紫外灯管，配强度传感器和镇流器。
entries.en: A stainless chamber with a UV lamp down its axis, intensity sensor and ballast.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 灯管含汞，石英套管易碎；腔体里是水。
entries.en: The lamp holds mercury and its quartz sleeve breaks easily; the chamber is full of water.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电、排空，整件送设备口。
entries.en: Isolate, drain, send it whole to the equipment bay.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 254 nm 紫外线破坏微生物的 DNA。灯管破碎会释放汞蒸气。
entries.en: 254 nm ultraviolet breaks microbes' DNA. A broken lamp releases mercury vapour.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 三相分离器
entries.en: THREE-PHASE SEPARATOR

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 卧式容器里用堰板把油、水、气分开，各有出口。
entries.en: A horizontal vessel whose weir splits oil, water and gas, each to its own outlet.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 容器里常留有残压和三种介质。
entries.en: It usually keeps some pressure and all three phases.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 从塔上的接口泄压，三路分别排空，再拆。
entries.en: Relieve it at its port, drain the three outlets, then remove it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 地面上分离靠重力；船上的分离器靠旋流或离心力代替重力，结构类似但更紧凑。
entries.en: On the ground separation runs on gravity; aboard ship it's done with swirl or centrifuge instead, similar in layout but more compact.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 科氏流量计
entries.en: CORIOLIS FLOW METER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 两根弯管在激振器驱动下振动，测出质量流量。
entries.en: Two bent tubes driven to vibrate; their twist gives the mass flow.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 它装在管路里：拆它等于断开那条管。
entries.en: It sits in the line: taking it out opens the line.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先排空它所在的管路，再拆法兰。
entries.en: Drain its line first, then unbolt the flanges.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 流体流过振动的管子时受科里奥利力，两端振动出现相位差，相位差正比于质量流量。精度可达 0.1%，很贵。
entries.en: Fluid in a vibrating tube feels a Coriolis force; the two ends fall out of phase in proportion to the mass flow. Good to 0.1 %, and expensive.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 雷达液位计
entries.en: RADAR LEVEL GAUGE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 从罐顶法兰伸进罐里的喇叭天线和电子头。
entries.en: A horn antenna through a tank's top flange, with its electronics head.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 它装在罐口上：罐里有压，拆它就开了一个口。
entries.en: It's in the tank's roof: pressurised, taking it off opens a hole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 读它的液位，罐空了再拆。
entries.en: Read its level; take it off once the tank is empty.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 雷达测量电磁波到液面再反射回来的时间。失重下液面不平，船上的液位计读的是平均值。
entries.en: It times a radar pulse to the surface and back. Without gravity the surface isn't flat, so a ship's gauge reads an average.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 载荷传感器（应变片）
entries.en: LOAD CELL

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 弹性体上贴着金属箔应变片，读结构里的受力。
entries.en: Foil strain gauges on a flexure body, reading the load in a structure.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 读数高说明这里在承受大力：此时切开会弹开。
entries.en: A high reading means this point is carrying a big load: cut now and it springs.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 动手前读一遍，读数降下来再拆。
entries.en: Read it before you work; wait for it to come down.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 应变片的电阻随拉伸变化，惠斯通电桥把它变成电压。承力件、拉杆、铰链上的载荷表告诉你哪里还“绷着”。
entries.en: A strain gauge's resistance changes as it stretches; a Wheatstone bridge turns that into a voltage. Load readings on members, tie rods and hinges tell you what's still under tension.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 现场仪表与传感器
entries.en: FIELD INSTRUMENTS

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 带显示窗的仪表、传感器节点、探测头。
entries.en: Instruments with display windows, sensor nodes, detector heads.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 本身危险不大，但常接在带压管路或带电回路上。
entries.en: Harmless themselves, but often on a pressurised line or a live circuit.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 读它的数，再按它所在的管路或电路处理。
entries.en: Read it, then deal with it as part of its line or circuit.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 仪表让你知道船现在的状态；它们的读数和面板记录不同，是实时的（只要你自己去读）。
entries.en: Instruments tell you the ship's state now; unlike a panel's records, their readings are live — as long as you read them yourself.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 螺杆压缩机
entries.en: TWIN-SCREW COMPRESSOR

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 一对阴阳转子、电机、油分离器和油冷却器。
entries.en: A pair of male and female rotors, motor, oil separator and oil cooler.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 排气侧和油分里有压力和热油。
entries.en: Its discharge side and oil separator hold pressure and hot oil.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 停机、泄压、排油，再拆。
entries.en: Stop it, relieve it, drain the oil, then remove it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 两根螺旋转子啮合，把吸进的气体沿轴向挤压到排气端。氦压缩机为低温系统提供高压氦气，氦很贵，要回收。
entries.en: Two meshing helical rotors squeeze the gas along to the discharge end. A helium compressor feeds a cryogenic plant; helium is dear and recovered.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 轴流压缩机
entries.en: AXIAL COMPRESSOR

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 一排排动叶和静叶交错，机匣向后收窄。
entries.en: Rows of rotor blades between rows of stator vanes in a casing that narrows aft.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 转子可能还在惯性转动；进气口还连着工艺气。
entries.en: The rotor may still be coasting; its inlet is still on the process gas.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 等转子停稳、进口隔离后再拆。
entries.en: Wait for the rotor to stop and isolate the inlet, then remove it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 每一级把气体压力提高约 1.2–1.4 倍。叶尖线速度可达每秒几百米，叶片断裂时像弹片一样飞出。
entries.en: Each stage raises the pressure about 1.2–1.4 times. Blade tips run at hundreds of metres a second; a broken blade leaves like shrapnel.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 透平膨胀机
entries.en: TURBOEXPANDER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 膨胀透平和制动压缩机装在一根气体轴承轴上。
entries.en: An expansion turbine and a brake compressor on one shaft in gas bearings.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 转速几万转；里面是极冷的工艺气。
entries.en: It runs at tens of thousands of rpm, full of very cold process gas.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 停机、回温、泄压后再拆。
entries.en: Stop it, let it warm up, relieve it, then remove it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 气体膨胀对外做功，温度骤降——这是低温制冷和液化的核心。小型透平转速可超过 10 万 rpm。
entries.en: Gas expanding through it does work and its temperature drops sharply — the heart of cryogenic refrigeration and liquefaction. Small ones exceed 100,000 rpm.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 分子泵
entries.en: TURBOMOLECULAR PUMP

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 一叠转子和定子叶片，高速转动把气体分子打向出口。
entries.en: A stack of rotor and stator blades spinning fast to knock gas molecules to the outlet.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 转子每分钟几万转，突然进气会让它损毁。
entries.en: The rotor runs at tens of thousands of rpm; a sudden inrush of gas wrecks it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 停机等它慢下来，再放气、拆法兰。
entries.en: Stop it, let it run down, then vent and unbolt it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 分子泵叶尖速度接近气体分子的热运动速度，只能在高真空下工作，前级要有别的泵。完全停下要好几分钟。
entries.en: Its blade tips move about as fast as the gas molecules, so it only works in high vacuum, backed by another pump. It takes minutes to stop.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 涡旋泵
entries.en: SCROLL PUMP

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 一对互相嵌套的螺旋，一个固定一个公转。
entries.en: Two interleaved spirals, one fixed, one orbiting.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 它循环的可能是昂贵的 ³He 混合气。
entries.en: What it circulates may be costly ³He mixture.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先回收它回路里的气，再停机拆。
entries.en: Recover the gas in its loop before stopping and removing it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 涡旋泵无油，不会污染气体，所以用来循环稀释制冷机的 ³He/⁴He 混合气。
entries.en: Scroll pumps are oil-free and don't contaminate the gas, which is why they circulate a dilution refrigerator's ³He/⁴He mixture.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 干式冷却器
entries.en: DRY COOLER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: V 形翅片盘管和一排风机：把冷却液的热散出去。
entries.en: Finned coils in a V under a row of fans: shedding the coolant's heat.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 盘管里满是冷却液。
entries.en: Its coils are full of coolant.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 排空回路再拆。
entries.en: Drain the loop before removing it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 干冷器只靠空气散热，不蒸发水。真空里它没有空气可吹，只能当辐射面用——船上的“干冷器”其实大多是在有气的舱里。
entries.en: A dry cooler sheds heat to air with no water evaporated. In vacuum there's no air to blow, so aboard ship they sit in rooms that hold air.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 冷却液分配单元
entries.en: COOLANT DISTRIBUTION UNIT

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 板式换热器、两台泵、过滤器、膨胀罐和控制器。
entries.en: Plate heat exchanger, two pumps, filter, expansion vessel and controller.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 它连着整排机柜的冷却液。
entries.en: It's connected to a whole row of racks' coolant.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 排空它所在的回路，断电后再拆。
entries.en: Drain its loop and isolate it before removing it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: CDU 把机房的冷却水和机柜的二次冷却液隔开，一台可以服务几百千瓦的计算负载。
entries.en: A CDU keeps the facility water apart from the racks' secondary coolant; one can serve hundreds of kilowatts of computing.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 液体火箭发动机
entries.en: LIQUID ROCKET ENGINE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 涡轮泵、燃气发生器、喷注器和再生冷却燃烧室。
entries.en: Turbopump, gas generator, injector and a regeneratively cooled chamber.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 输送管和冷却夹套里还留着推进剂，有的有毒、有的自燃。
entries.en: Its feed lines and cooling jacket still hold propellant, some toxic, some self-igniting.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 关主阀，从排放口排空推进剂，再拆它的推力架。
entries.en: Close the main valves, drain the propellant at the drains, then unbolt its thrust frame.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 燃料先流过燃烧室壁里的冷却通道再进喷注器，所以停机后壁里还有一层推进剂。肼类推进剂有毒，与氧化剂接触即自燃。发动机是船上最重最值钱的设备之一，常要沿法兰分段。
entries.en: Fuel runs through the channels in the chamber wall before the injector, so a layer of it stays in the wall after shutdown. Hydrazines are toxic and ignite on contact with their oxidiser. Engines are among the heaviest and most valuable things aboard and often come apart at their flanges.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 挤压式小发动机
entries.en: PRESSURE-FED ENGINE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 靠贮箱气压挤出推进剂的小发动机：阀门、喷注头、燃烧室和喷管。
entries.en: A small engine fed by tank pressure: valves, injector head, chamber and bell.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 贮箱还有压，阀一开推进剂就喷出来。
entries.en: With its tanks still pressurised, a valve opened sprays propellant.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先泄掉贮箱的增压气，再拆发动机。
entries.en: Vent the tanks' pressurant before removing the engine.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 没有涡轮泵，结构简单可靠，但贮箱要做得耐高压。小飞船、着陆器、作业艇多用这种。
entries.en: No turbopump, simple and reliable, but its tanks must take high pressure. Small craft, landers and work tugs use them.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 喷管
entries.en: NOZZLE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 钟形喷管：加强环、冷却管和喉部集管。
entries.en: A bell nozzle: stiffening rings, coolant tubes and the manifold at its throat.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 很大但很薄，撞一下就变形；冷却管里可能有残液。
entries.en: Big but thin, it dents at a knock; its coolant tubes may hold residue.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 排空冷却管，沿法兰拆，慢慢拖运。
entries.en: Drain the tubes, unbolt it at its flange, tow it slowly.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 喷管把燃气的热能变成速度：截面比越大，真空中的比冲越高。真空喷管的扩张比可达 100 以上，壁薄如纸。
entries.en: The nozzle turns the gas's heat into speed; the bigger its area ratio, the higher its specific impulse in vacuum. Vacuum bells reach area ratios over 100, with paper-thin walls.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 姿控推力器组
entries.en: RCS THRUSTER QUAD

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 一个安装块上四个小推力器，配加热片和电磁阀。
entries.en: Four small thrusters on one block, with heater pad and valves.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 阀门带电时一误动就喷火；管里有推进剂。
entries.en: Its valves, if live, can fire; its lines hold propellant.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电、关贮箱阀、排空管路后再拆。
entries.en: Isolate, shut the tank valves and drain the lines before removing it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 单组元肼推力器靠催化床分解肼产生推力，几十牛到几百牛。加热片让催化床保持预热。
entries.en: Monopropellant thrusters decompose hydrazine on a catalyst bed for tens to hundreds of newtons; the heater keeps the bed warm.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 涡轮泵
entries.en: TURBOPUMP

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 燃料泵和氧化剂泵装在一根轴上，中间是涡轮。
entries.en: Fuel and oxidiser pumps on one shaft with the turbine between.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 两种推进剂在同一台机器里，泵壳里有残液。
entries.en: Two propellants in one machine, residue in both pump casings.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 两侧分别排空后再拆。
entries.en: Drain both sides separately, then remove it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 涡轮泵功率密度极高：几十公斤的机器输出几兆瓦，转速每分钟几万转。轴封把燃料和氧化剂隔开，封坏了就是爆炸。
entries.en: A turbopump is power-dense: tens of kilograms putting out megawatts at tens of thousands of rpm. The shaft seals keep fuel and oxidiser apart; when they fail, it explodes.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 辅助动力装置
entries.en: AUXILIARY POWER UNIT

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 小型燃气轮机加齿轮箱和发电机。
entries.en: A small gas turbine with its gearbox and generator.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 燃料管里有油，发电机端可能带电。
entries.en: Fuel in its lines, and its generator may be live.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 关燃油、断电、排空后再拆。
entries.en: Fuel off, isolated, drained, then remove it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: APU 在主发动机不工作时提供电力和气源，自己就是一台完整的小涡轮发动机。
entries.en: An APU provides power and air when the main engines don't run; it's a complete little turbine engine itself.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 核热火箭堆芯
entries.en: NUCLEAR THERMAL ROCKET CORE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 六角燃料元件、铍反射层和控制鼓：用核裂变加热氢气推进。
entries.en: Hexagonal fuel elements, a beryllium reflector and control drums: fission heating hydrogen for thrust.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 停堆后仍有强辐射和衰变热；切开包壳会污染全船。
entries.en: Shut down, it is still intensely radioactive and hot; break its cladding and the whole ship is contaminated.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 在屏蔽阴影里工作，等它冷却，锁好控制鼓后整件吊走。
entries.en: Work in a shield's shadow, let it cool, lock the drums, lift it out whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 核热火箭把氢气加热到 2,500 K 以上从喷管喷出，比冲约 900 s，是化学火箭的两倍。停堆后衰变热约为满功率的 1%，并随时间缓慢下降。
entries.en: It heats hydrogen past 2,500 K and expands it through the nozzle, for a specific impulse around 900 s — twice a chemical rocket's. After shutdown the decay heat is about 1 % of full power, falling slowly.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 设备机架
entries.en: EQUIPMENT RACK

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 19 英寸机架：配线架、交换机、服务器和底部的 UPS。
entries.en: 19-inch racks: patch panel, switch, servers and a UPS at the foot.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 底部的 UPS 是一路独立电源：断了总线它照样带电。
entries.en: The UPS at its foot is a supply of its own: kill the bus and it's still live.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断开 UPS 的输出，再拔线拆机架。
entries.en: Switch the UPS output off, then unplug and remove the rack.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 不间断电源平时充着电，主电一断立刻接管，能撑几分钟到几小时。数据设备价值高，整架拆下比拆散好卖。
entries.en: A UPS charges while the mains is on and takes over the moment it goes, for minutes or hours. Data hardware is valuable and sells better as a whole rack.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 航电单元
entries.en: AVIONICS UNIT

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 带显示屏、旋钮和底部接插件的机载电子盒。
entries.en: A flight electronics box with display, selectors and connectors along its foot.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 价值高、怕撞，接插件带电时拔会损坏。
entries.en: Valuable and fragile; pulled live, its connectors are damaged.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电后拔插头，轻拿轻放送设备口。
entries.en: Unplug once isolated, handle gently to the equipment bay.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 航电单元按 ARINC 等标准做成可整件更换的盒子，前面板两个把手，后面盲插。
entries.en: Avionics are built to standards like ARINC as whole replaceable boxes: two handles on the front, blind-mate connectors at the back.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 操作台
entries.en: OPERATOR CONSOLE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 底座、桌面、倾斜的显示面板、键盘和操纵杆。
entries.en: Pedestal, desk, sloped display panel, keyboard and joystick.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 显示的状态可能早已过期。
entries.en: What it shows may be long out of date.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 别信它的屏幕，自己测；断电后整件拆下。
entries.en: Don't trust its screens, measure; isolate and remove it whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 控制台是指令的入口，不是状态的真相：它显示的是传感器最后一次上报的值。
entries.en: A console is where commands go in, not where truth comes out: it shows what the sensors last reported.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 黑匣子（飞行记录仪）
entries.en: FLIGHT RECORDER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 装甲存储筒、水下定位信标和接插件。
entries.en: An armoured memory drum, an underwater locator beacon and a connector.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 合同常要求完整送回；切到它就违约。
entries.en: Contracts usually want it back whole; cut it and you've broken the contract.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 拧下来整件送设备口。
entries.en: Unbolt it and take it whole to the equipment bay.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 抗坠毁存储器能承受 3,400 g 冲击和 1,100 °C 火烧一小时。它记录的是事故前最后的数据——船出过什么事，答案常在这里。
entries.en: A crash-survivable memory takes 3,400 g and an hour at 1,100 °C. It holds the last data before the accident: what happened to the ship is usually in there.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 惯性基准单元
entries.en: INERTIAL MEASUREMENT UNIT

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 三个正交的环形激光陀螺和加速度计，装在减振座上。
entries.en: Three ring-laser gyros on orthogonal faces and accelerometers, on isolators.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 精密而贵，撞一下就失准。
entries.en: Precise and dear; one knock and it's out of calibration.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电后整件慢慢运走。
entries.en: Isolate it and move it whole, slowly.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 环形激光陀螺测两束反向激光的频差（萨格纳克效应）来测转动，没有运动部件。
entries.en: A ring-laser gyro measures rotation from the frequency split between two counter-running beams (the Sagnac effect), with no moving parts.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 星敏感器
entries.en: STAR TRACKER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 长遮光罩、光学头和电子箱：拍星空定姿态。
entries.en: A long sun baffle, optical head and electronics box: photographs the stars to know its attitude.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 光学头怕污染和撞击。
entries.en: Its optics hate contamination and knocks.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 远离它切割，整件拆下。
entries.en: Cut well away from it and remove it whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 把拍到的星点图案和星表比对，姿态精度可达角秒级。遮光罩挡住太阳和亮天体的杂散光。
entries.en: It matches the star pattern it sees against a catalogue, to arc-second accuracy. The baffle keeps out stray light from the sun and bright bodies.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 抛物面天线
entries.en: DISH ANTENNA

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 反射面、馈源支架、副反射面和方位俯仰轴。
entries.en: Reflector, feed on its struts, subreflector, azimuth and elevation axes.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 反射面大而薄，一撞就变形；发射机可能带高压。
entries.en: The dish is big and thin and dents at a touch; its transmitter may hold high voltage.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断开发射机，整件拆下，慢慢拖。
entries.en: Isolate the transmitter, remove it whole, tow it slowly.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 反射面的面形误差要小于波长的 1/16 才能聚焦，X 波段就是约 2 mm。变形的天线只值铝价。
entries.en: The surface has to be true to a sixteenth of the wavelength to focus — about 2 mm at X band. A dented dish is worth its aluminium.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: X 光扫描仪
entries.en: X-RAY SCANNER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 射线发生器、探测器阵列、铅帘和传送带。
entries.en: X-ray generator, detector array, lead curtains and conveyor.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 发生器带高压，通电时有射线。
entries.en: The generator runs at high voltage and emits while powered.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电放电后再拆。
entries.en: Isolate and discharge it before removing it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: X 光管用 100–300 kV 加速电子撞击靶材产生射线。断电即停止发射，但高压电源的电容要放电。
entries.en: The tube accelerates electrons at 100–300 kV into a target. It stops emitting when unpowered, but its high-voltage supply's capacitors need discharging.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 生物识别终端
entries.en: BIOMETRIC PANEL

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 掌纹仪、虹膜摄像头、键盘和门锁状态灯。
entries.en: Palm reader, iris camera, keypad and the door strike's lights.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 它控制的门锁可能另有备用电源。
entries.en: The lock it controls may have a backup supply of its own.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 查清门锁的每一路电源再处理门。
entries.en: Trace every supply of the lock before dealing with the door.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 终端只是钥匙；锁本身靠电磁铁或电机，断电失效还是断电锁死（fail-secure），决定了门要怎么开。
entries.en: The panel is only a key; the lock is a solenoid or motor, and whether it fails open or fails secure decides how the door has to be opened.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 吊钩组
entries.en: HOOK BLOCK

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 夹板、滑轮、旋转接头和带安全扣的吊钩。
entries.en: Cheek plates, sheaves, a swivel and a hook with its safety latch.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 钢丝绳还绷着时拆它，绳子会抽回来。
entries.en: Free it with the rope still taut and the rope whips back.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先松绞车刹车让绳放松，再拆。
entries.en: Slack the rope at the winch brake first, then remove it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 多根绳穿过滑轮组可以省力（倍率），但每根绳里的张力都储存着弹性能。
entries.en: Reeving the rope over several sheaves multiplies the pull, but every fall of rope stores elastic energy.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 绞盘与卷筒
entries.en: WINCH AND REEL

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 卷筒、法兰、缠着的缆、轮毂和带式刹车。
entries.en: Drum, flanges, the cable wound on it, hub and band brake.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 缆还受力时拆轴，卷筒会甩出去。
entries.en: Take its shaft out with the cable under load and the drum flies.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 拔刹车销、看张力表归零，再拆轴。
entries.en: Pull the brake pins, watch the tension gauge reach zero, then the shaft.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 钢缆受拉储存弹性能 E = F²L/(2EA)：一根几十千牛的长缆存着足以抽坏设备的能量。张力表告诉你它是不是还绷着。
entries.en: A taut cable stores E = F²L/(2EA): a long wire at tens of kilonewtons holds enough to smash equipment. The tension gauge tells you whether it's still taut.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 机械臂
entries.en: MANIPULATOR ARM

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 底座转台、肩、大臂小臂和油缸、腕部与夹爪。
entries.en: Base and turntable, shoulder, upper and lower arm with their cylinders, wrist, gripper.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 折叠着的臂靠液压或预紧撑着，拆枢轴会弹开。
entries.en: Folded, it's held by hydraulics or preload; take a pivot out and it springs.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 泄掉它的蓄能器，拔每个关节的锁销，最后拆枢轴。
entries.en: Bleed its accumulator, pull each joint's pin, the pivots last.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 收折的机械臂像一把张开的折刀：每个关节里都可能存着力。正确的顺序总是先卸能，再卸锁，最后卸结构。
entries.en: A folded arm is a jack-knife held open: any joint may hold force. The order is always energy off, locks off, structure last.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 对接口
entries.en: DOCKING PORT

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 带螺栓圈的环形法兰、捕获锁、导向瓣和舱门。
entries.en: A ring flange on its bolt circle, capture latches, guide petals and the hatch.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 舱门后面可能是有压的舱。
entries.en: Behind the hatch may be a room still under pressure.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先测后面的舱压，放气后再拆。
entries.en: Measure the room behind it and vent it first.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 对接口要同时承受结构载荷和气密：一圈几十颗螺栓加双道密封圈。导向瓣在对接时把两船对正。
entries.en: A docking port carries structural load and holds air: a ring of tens of bolts and a double seal. The petals line the two ships up as they meet.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 盘式制动器
entries.en: DISC BRAKE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 跨在制动盘边上的卡钳、活塞、刹车片和油管。
entries.en: A caliper straddling the disc, with pistons, pads and hydraulic line.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 干刹会过热烧坏；它管着的东西可能还在转。
entries.en: Braked dry it overheats and burns out; what it holds may still be turning.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先开制动冷却再刹；停稳后再拆。
entries.en: Turn the brake cooling on before braking; remove it once things have stopped.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 刹车把动能变成热：一个 20,000 rpm 的飞轮里存着的能量，要刹车片一点点磨成热。冷却不够，刹车片温度超过极限就失效，从此停不下来。
entries.en: A brake turns motion into heat: everything a flywheel at 20,000 rpm stores has to be ground into heat by the pads. Without cooling the pads pass their limit and fail, and then it can't be stopped.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 升降台
entries.en: SCISSOR LIFT

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 剪叉腿、平台和底座。
entries.en: Crossed legs, deck and base.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 升起时的液压缸保着压。
entries.en: Raised, its cylinder holds pressure.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 降到底、泄压后再拆。
entries.en: Lower it fully and relieve it before removing it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 剪叉机构展开时力臂变短，油缸推力要很大，所以它降到底时最安全。
entries.en: As the scissors open the lever shortens and the cylinder pushes hard; fully lowered is where it's safe.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 货舱吊车
entries.en: HOLD CRANE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 在桥轨上走的小车、卷扬电机和吊钩。
entries.en: A trolley on its bridge rail, hoist motor and hook.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 吊着东西时拆它，吊的东西会掉；拉杆还紧着切它会抽坏它。
entries.en: Take it while it holds a load and the load drops; cut a tie rod still tight and it whips.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先放下吊物、松开拉杆，再拆。
entries.en: Set its load down and slack the tie rods first.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 失重下吊车不是用来提重的，而是用来控制大件的位置和速度。
entries.en: In free fall a crane doesn't lift weight; it controls where big things go and how fast.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 机床
entries.en: MACHINE TOOL

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 车床或铣床：床身、主轴、刀架或工作台。
entries.en: A lathe or mill: bed, spindle, tool post or table.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 很重，地脚螺栓多；电机带电。
entries.en: Heavy, many hold-down bolts, a live motor.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电后拆地脚螺栓，超重就沿标线分段。
entries.en: Isolate it, undo its hold-downs, split it on its lines if too heavy.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 机床的价值在精度：导轨磨损或撞弯就只剩铸铁的价。
entries.en: A machine tool's value is its accuracy: knock the ways out of true and it's worth its cast iron.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 车辆
entries.en: VEHICLE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 绑在甲板上的汽车、叉车、牵引车或作业车。
entries.en: A car, forklift, tractor or work vehicle lashed to the deck.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 车里有电池或燃料，绑带松了会在舱里滑动撞坏东西。
entries.en: It carries a battery or fuel, and loose lashings let it slide into things.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 整车运走，或先处理电池燃料再拆。
entries.en: Take it whole, or deal with its battery and fuel before taking it apart.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 车辆是整件货物，价值远高于废金属；绑带和轮挡在失重下才是真正拉住它的东西。
entries.en: A vehicle is cargo, worth far more whole than as metal; in free fall the lashings and chocks are what really hold it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 货柜与货箱
entries.en: CONTAINERS AND CRATES

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 标准集装箱或木框货箱，按货物申报计价。
entries.en: Standard containers or framed crates, paid by their declared cargo.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 又大又重，拖动时惯性大；冷藏箱、住人箱里可能有压。
entries.en: Big and heavy, with momentum to match; reefers and accommodation boxes may hold pressure.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 看质量，必要时用搬运无人机或升级抓钩；有压的先放气。
entries.en: Check its mass; use the hauler or a bigger grapple if needed; vent a pressurised one first.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 集装箱四角的角件是唯一的承力点，扭锁把箱子锁在一起。整箱货物的价值远高于箱子本身。
entries.en: A container's corner castings are its only load points; twist-locks lock them together. What's inside is worth far more than the box.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 维护无人机
entries.en: MAINTENANCE DRONE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 停在机位里的小型无人机：机体环、四个旋翼、传感器眼。
entries.en: A small drone parked in its bay: body ring, four rotor wells, sensor eye.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 自带电池：船断电了它还能“醒”过来乱飞。
entries.en: It carries its own battery: the ship dead, it can still wake up and fly.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断机位充电和它自己的电池开关，摘电池包再搬。
entries.en: Switch off its charger and its own battery, take the pack out, then move it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 无人机的飞控在掉电保护逻辑下会尝试起飞返航；被松开时如果电池还接着，旋翼一转就会把自己甩出去。
entries.en: A drone's flight controller tries to take off and return when its link drops; released with its battery still connected, its rotors spin up and throw it about.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 直线电机定子
entries.en: LINEAR MOTOR STATOR

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 叠片铁芯、槽里的线圈和两端翻出的端部绕组。
entries.en: Laminated core, coils in its slots, end turns curling out both ends.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 它的电来自电容组：断主电后仍可能带几百伏。
entries.en: It runs off a capacitor bank: off the main supply, it may still hold hundreds of volts.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先给电容组放电，再拆线圈。
entries.en: Discharge the capacitor bank first, then the coils.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 直线电机是“展开”的旋转电机：定子沿轨道铺开，行波磁场推动动子。电磁弹射靠它在几秒内把载荷加速到几百米每秒。
entries.en: A linear motor is a rotary motor unrolled: the stator laid along the track, a travelling field pushing the mover. An electromagnetic launcher uses it to reach hundreds of metres a second in seconds.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 发射滑架
entries.en: LAUNCH CRADLE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 在轨道上滑行的滑橇、托垫和释放锁。
entries.en: A sled on its rails, saddle pads and release latches.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 轨道还有预紧，释放锁一开它就会窜出。
entries.en: With the rails still preloaded, open the latches and it lurches off.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 轨道泄完预紧后再拆滑架。
entries.en: Take the preload off the rails before removing the cradle.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 滑架承受发射时几十 g 的加速度，结构厚重。
entries.en: The cradle takes tens of g at launch and is built heavy for it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 飞轮储能器
entries.en: FLYWHEEL STORE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 真空壳里的复合材料轮缘、磁悬浮轴承和电动/发电机。
entries.en: A composite rim in a vacuum housing on magnetic bearings, with a motor-generator.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 还在高速旋转：松开或切开，轮子甩出去。
entries.en: Still spinning fast: free or cut it and the wheel flies.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 开刹车冷却再上刹车，转速降到 300 rpm 以下再拆。
entries.en: Brake cooling on, then the brake; under 300 rpm, remove it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 飞轮储能 E = ½Iω²，与转速的平方成正比：20,000 rpm 时储能是 2,000 rpm 的一百倍。真空和磁悬浮让它几乎没有摩擦，自己能转好几天。
entries.en: A flywheel holds E = ½Iω², the square of its speed: at 20,000 rpm a hundred times what it holds at 2,000. Vacuum and magnetic bearings leave it almost no friction; on its own it spins for days.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 反作用飞轮
entries.en: REACTION WHEEL

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 壳体里的飞轮、轮毂轴承和定子线圈：用来转动整艘船。
entries.en: A wheel on its hub bearings with stator coils in a housing: for turning the ship.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 停用后也可能还在转。
entries.en: Even idle it may still be turning.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 读转速，停稳后再拆。
entries.en: Read its speed and wait for it to stop.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 电机让飞轮朝一个方向加速，船就朝反方向转（角动量守恒）。转速常在几千 rpm。
entries.en: Spin the wheel up one way and the ship turns the other (conservation of angular momentum). They run at thousands of rpm.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 消旋制动器
entries.en: DESPIN BRAKE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 旋转居住环轮毂上的制动盘、卡钳和散热片。
entries.en: The disc, calipers and cooling fins on a habitat ring's hub.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 环上负载带电时刹车，回馈电流会烧滑环；干刹会烧刹车。
entries.en: Brake with the ring's loads live and the regenerated current burns the slip ring; brake dry and the brake burns.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断环上负载、开冷却，两个环一起刹。
entries.en: Loads off the ring, cooling on, brake both rings together.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 电机-制动器把环的动能转成电存进电容（再生制动），电容满了要放电才能继续刹。只刹一个环，船体会被另一个环的角动量拧扭。
entries.en: The motor-brake turns the ring's energy into charge in a capacitor (regenerative braking); full, it has to be dumped before braking goes on. Brake only one ring and the other's angular momentum twists the hull.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 旋转气密封
entries.en: ROTARY SEAL

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 转动的轮毂和固定主轴之间的迷宫密封。
entries.en: A labyrinth seal between the turning hub and the fixed spine.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 环还在转时打开过渡气闸，会撕开它。
entries.en: Open the transfer airlock while the ring turns and it tears.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 环停稳、轴承锁上后再动它。
entries.en: Only once the ring has stopped and its bearing is locked.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 迷宫密封靠一圈圈齿的节流减少泄漏，加缓冲气槽隔开两侧，本身不接触——所以它能在转动中密封，但挡不住真正的开口。
entries.en: A labyrinth seal throttles leakage through ring after ring of teeth with a buffer-gas groove between, without touching — sealing while it turns, but no use against a real opening.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 轮辐电梯
entries.en: SPOKE ELEVATOR

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 沿导轨齿条升降的轿厢：门、驱动电机和安全钳。
entries.en: A car on its rack and pinion: doors, drive motor, safety gear.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 环在转时轿厢受离心力，导轨一断它会甩出去。
entries.en: With the ring turning the car feels the spin; cut its rail and it's flung.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 环消旋后再拆。
entries.en: Only after the ring is despun.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 旋转环用离心力造“重力”：半径 100 m、3 rpm 时约 1 g。轿厢从轮毂走到环上，感受到的重力从零升到 1 g。
entries.en: A rotating ring makes gravity from its spin: about 1 g at 100 m radius and 3 rpm. The car's ride from hub to rim goes from nothing to a full g.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 系绳阻尼器
entries.en: TETHER DAMPER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 液压缸、弹簧和气囊：吸收系绳的振动。
entries.en: A hydraulic cylinder, spring and gas reservoir: soaking up the tether's vibration.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 系绳还绷着，阻尼器里压着弹簧和气压。
entries.en: With the tether taut, the damper holds spring and gas pressure.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 系绳停转、张紧器松开之后再拆。
entries.en: Once the tether has stopped and its tensioner is slack.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 长系绳会像琴弦一样振动，阻尼器把振动能量变成热。
entries.en: A long tether rings like a string; the damper turns that motion into heat.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 液压夹钳
entries.en: HYDRAULIC CLAMP

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 固定钳口、液压缸推动的活动钳口和底板。
entries.en: A fixed jaw, a moving jaw pushed by its cylinder, and the base plate.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 保着压整件拆下，钳口会弹开砸坏东西。
entries.en: Removed while it holds pressure, its jaw springs open.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先开它的保压开关泄压，再拆。
entries.en: Release its holding switch to bleed it, then remove it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 夹钳靠液压锁保持夹紧力，即使泵停了也能保压很久。一组夹钳共同承担载荷时，松开的顺序决定剩下的夹钳受力。
entries.en: A clamp's lock valve holds its grip long after the pump stops. When several share a load, the order they're released in decides what the rest must carry.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 隔振台
entries.en: VIBRATION ISOLATION TABLE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 蜂窝台面、气动隔振腿和水平阀。
entries.en: A honeycomb top on pneumatic legs with levelling valves.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 没锁时，附近的切割和撞击会通过它震坏精密件。
entries.en: Unlocked, a cut or knock nearby shakes the precision parts on it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先锁住隔振台，再在附近动刀。
entries.en: Lock the table before any cutting nearby.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 隔振台把几赫兹以上的振动衰减到百分之一以下；锁住后它就成了刚性的，不再放大冲击。
entries.en: It cuts vibration above a few hertz to under a hundredth; locked, it's rigid and stops amplifying shocks.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 救生舱
entries.en: ESCAPE POD

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 发射架上的救生舱：防热罩、侧舱门、座椅、制动火箭和发射夹。
entries.en: A pod in its cradle: heat shield, hatch, seats, retro pack and launch clamps.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 发射夹上装着火工品，待发电路带电就可能走火弹出。
entries.en: Its clamps carry pyrotechnics; with the arming circuit live, they can fire and throw it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断开待发开关，再拆发射夹和火工品。
entries.en: Disarm it at the pod control panel before touching the clamps or charges.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 爆炸螺栓里装着少量炸药，起爆电流只需几安培、几毫秒。发射电容是一路独立电源，专门为它供电。
entries.en: An explosive bolt holds a little charge; it needs a few amps for a few milliseconds to fire. The launch capacitor is a supply of its own, there for that alone.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 保管箱墙与库门
entries.en: VAULT AND DEPOSIT BOXES

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 一墙密封保管箱，或带锁栓的厚壁库门。
entries.en: A wall of sealed deposit boxes, or a thick vault door with locking bolts.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 库门带电锁死；库里可能有压。
entries.en: The vault door locks while powered; the vault may hold pressure.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断开门锁的所有电源，放气后开门，保管箱整件运走。
entries.en: Kill every supply of the lock, vent the vault, open it, take the boxes whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 库门的锁栓由电磁铁顶住：通电时锁死，断电后锁栓仍在原位，要扳动机械释放杆才收回。只要电磁铁还有任何一路电，释放杆就扳不动。
entries.en: The vault's bolts are held by a solenoid: powered, locked; unpowered, the bolts stay where they are until a mechanical release lever draws them. While the solenoid has any supply at all, the lever won't move.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 压水堆
entries.en: PRESSURISED-WATER REACTOR

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 压力容器、顶盖螺栓环、控制棒驱动管、堆芯和下腔室。
entries.en: Vessel, closure head on its stud ring, rod drive housings, core and lower plenum.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 停堆后仍有强辐射和衰变热，一回路高温高压。
entries.en: Shut down it is still radioactive and hot, its primary loop at high temperature and pressure.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 保持冷却、等它降温，屏蔽下作业，整件走危险品口。
entries.en: Keep it cooled, let it come down, work behind shielding, send it whole to the hazard mouth.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 一回路约 15.5 MPa、315 °C，水在高压下不沸腾。停堆一小时后衰变热约为额定功率的 1.5%，一天后约 0.5%——一座 100 MW 的堆一天后仍在发 0.5 MW 的热。
entries.en: The primary runs about 15.5 MPa and 315 °C, water held liquid by pressure. An hour after shutdown the decay heat is about 1.5 % of rated power, after a day about 0.5 % — a 100 MW reactor still putting out half a megawatt.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 控制棒驱动机构
entries.en: CONTROL ROD DRIVE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 耐压外壳、提升与保持线圈、棒位指示和驱动杆。
entries.en: Pressure housing, lift and hold coils, rod position indicator and drive rod.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 它是一回路压力边界的一部分。
entries.en: It's part of the primary pressure boundary.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 一回路泄压、冷却后再拆。
entries.en: Only with the primary depressurised and cool.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 磁力提升式驱动机构断电时，控制棒靠自身释放落入堆芯（失电安全）。
entries.en: With a magnetic-jack drive, losing power drops the rods into the core by themselves (fail-safe).

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 主冷却剂泵
entries.en: REACTOR COOLANT PUMP

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 屏蔽电机、飞轮、密封组件和泵壳。
entries.en: Canned motor, flywheel, seal package and casing.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 它是冷却堆芯的唯一手段：先断它，堆芯就开始升温。
entries.en: It's what cools the core: cut it first and the core heats up.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 堆芯冷下来之前别断它的电。
entries.en: Leave its power on until the core is cool.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 泵上的飞轮让断电后的冷却流量缓慢下降，给堆芯多几十秒的冷却。
entries.en: Its flywheel makes the flow coast down slowly after a power loss, buying the core tens of seconds of cooling.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 稳压器
entries.en: PRESSURISER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 高大的容器，上部蒸汽空间、喷淋头、电加热器和安全阀。
entries.en: A tall vessel: steam space above the water, spray head, heaters, relief valves.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 它维持一回路的压力：里面是高压饱和水和蒸汽。
entries.en: It holds the primary's pressure: saturated water and steam at high pressure.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 一回路泄压冷却后再拆。
entries.en: Only after the primary is relieved and cool.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 加热器烧出蒸汽升压，喷淋冷水降压。15.5 MPa 下水的饱和温度约 345 °C。
entries.en: Heaters raise the pressure by boiling, cold spray lowers it. At 15.5 MPa water saturates at about 345 °C.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 汽轮机
entries.en: STEAM TURBINE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 高压缸和低压缸同轴，叶片一级比一级长。
entries.en: High- and low-pressure cylinders on one shaft, blades growing longer stage by stage.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 极重，转子可能还在盘车。
entries.en: Very heavy, and its rotor may still be turning on its gear.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 停稳、隔离蒸汽后，沿法兰分段拆。
entries.en: Stopped and isolated from steam, it comes apart at its flanges.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 蒸汽每经过一级膨胀一点、体积变大，所以后面的叶片更长。整机常重几十吨。
entries.en: The steam expands a little at every stage and takes more room, so the blades lengthen. A whole set weighs tens of tonnes.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 凝汽器
entries.en: CONDENSER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 壳体、管束、水室和热井：把乏汽凝成水。
entries.en: Shell, tube bundle, waterboxes and hotwell: exhaust steam back to water.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 管束里有冷却水，热井里有凝结水。
entries.en: Cooling water in its tubes, condensate in its hotwell.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 两侧排空后再拆。
entries.en: Drain both sides before removing it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 凝汽器在真空下工作：蒸汽凝结体积缩小上千倍，自己就把壳内抽成低压。
entries.en: It works in vacuum: condensing, the steam shrinks a thousandfold and pulls the shell down to low pressure by itself.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 控制鼓
entries.en: CONTROL DRUM

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 一面贴着碳化硼吸收体的铍鼓，由电机转动。
entries.en: A beryllium drum faced on one side with boron carbide, turned by a motor.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 没锁就吊堆芯，鼓会滑转，吸收体转开，附近一阵剂量。
entries.en: Lift the core with it unlocked and it slips, the absorber turns away, and a burst of dose goes out.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 吊堆芯前把每个控制鼓机械锁死。
entries.en: Lock every drum mechanically before the core is lifted.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 鼓转到吸收体朝向堆芯，吸收中子、压低反应性；转到铍面朝内，反射中子、提高反应性。
entries.en: Turned absorber-in, it soaks up neutrons and holds the reactor down; beryllium-in, it reflects them back and raises it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 阴影屏蔽板
entries.en: SHADOW SHIELD

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 钨和氢化锂交替叠层的屏蔽板，挡住堆芯的直射辐射。
entries.en: Layers of tungsten and lithium hydride stacked across the core's line of sight.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 它后面才是安全区；把它拆走前，先想好你在哪里干活。
entries.en: Only behind it is safe; before moving it, know where you'll work.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 吊着它挡在堆芯前，在它的阴影里作业。
entries.en: Hang it in front of the core and work in its shadow.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 钨挡伽马射线，氢化锂慢化并吸收中子。阴影里的剂量率只剩约 1%。航天堆不做全包屏蔽，只屏蔽乘员方向以省质量。
entries.en: Tungsten stops gamma, lithium hydride slows and absorbs neutrons. In its shadow the dose rate falls to about 1 %. Space reactors shield only towards the crew to save mass.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 超导纵场线圈
entries.en: SUPERCONDUCTING TF COIL

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 钢壳里的铠装导体绕组，每匝中心通液氦。
entries.en: A winding pack of cable-in-conduit turns in a steel case, liquid helium through each turn.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 带着几十亿焦的磁能：失冷或切支撑会失超，能量瞬间释放。
entries.en: It holds gigajoules of field: lose its cooling or cut its supports and it quenches, all at once.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 开泄能开关、保持制冷，储能泄完再拆。
entries.en: Close the dump switch, keep it cold, take it out only once it's run down.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: Nb₃Sn 超导体在约 18 K 以下无电阻，平时用 4.5 K 液氦冷着。失超时局部变成有电阻的导体，电流 × 电阻 = 热，热又让更多导体失超——几秒内整个线圈的储能变成热和力。
entries.en: Nb₃Sn has no resistance below about 18 K and is kept at 4.5 K in liquid helium. In a quench a patch turns resistive, current times resistance makes heat, the heat takes more conductor normal — and in seconds the coil's whole store becomes heat and force.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 中心螺线管
entries.en: CENTRAL SOLENOID

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 饼式绕组叠在拉紧板之间，中间是孔，上下预压法兰。
entries.en: Pancake windings stacked between tie plates, the bore down its middle, pre-compression flanges.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 和纵场线圈一样储着磁能，会失超。
entries.en: Like the TF coils it stores field energy and can quench.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 泄能完成后再拆预压结构。
entries.en: Remove its pre-compression only after it's dumped.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 中心螺线管靠变化的磁通在等离子体里感应出电流（变压器原理），它自己承受巨大的电磁力，要预压住。
entries.en: The central solenoid drives current in the plasma by changing its flux, like a transformer; it carries huge electromagnetic forces and is held under pre-compression.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 线圈支撑
entries.en: COIL SUPPORT

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 两个端块之间一叠薄柔性板：让线圈冷缩时不拉坏底座。
entries.en: A stack of thin flexible plates between two blocks: lets the coil shrink as it cools.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 线圈带场时切或拆它，线圈失超。
entries.en: Cut or free it while the coil is energised and the coil quenches.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 线圈泄完能再拆。
entries.en: Only after the coil is dumped.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 从室温冷到 4 K，几米长的钢结构会缩短几毫米；柔性板在一个方向软、另一个方向硬，吸收收缩又能承重。
entries.en: From room temperature to 4 K a few metres of steel shrinks by millimetres; the plates are soft one way and stiff the other, taking up the shrinkage and still carrying the load.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 真空室壁
entries.en: VACUUM VESSEL WALL

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 内外两层壳之间夹着加强肋，夹层里流屏蔽水。
entries.en: Inner and outer shells with ribs between; shielding water runs in the gap.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 夹层里可能还有水；内壁被中子活化。
entries.en: The gap may still hold water; the inner shell is activated by neutrons.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 排空夹层，按标线分段。
entries.en: Drain the gap and cut it on its marked lines.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 真空室是等离子体的第一道包络，也是氚的屏障。聚变中子会把结构钢活化，退役后要按低放废物处理。
entries.en: The vacuum vessel is the plasma's first enclosure and a tritium barrier. Fusion neutrons activate its steel; retired, it's low-level waste.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 包层模块
entries.en: BLANKET MODULE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 贴在真空室内壁上的模块：面向等离子体的第一壁和后面的屏蔽块。
entries.en: Modules lining the vessel: a plasma-facing first wall and a shield block behind.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 铍瓦面怕撞；冷却管里有水。
entries.en: Its beryllium face hates knocks; its pipes hold water.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 排空冷却管，拆螺栓整块取出。
entries.en: Drain its pipes, unbolt it and lift it out whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 第一壁表面承受每平方米几兆瓦的热流。铍粉有毒，切割会产生铍尘。
entries.en: The first wall takes megawatts per square metre. Beryllium dust is toxic, and cutting it makes some.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 偏滤器
entries.en: DIVERTOR

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 钢体上竖着钨单块的内外靶板，中间是穹顶，带冷却管。
entries.en: A steel cassette with tungsten monoblock targets at each end, a dome between, and coolant pipes.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 很重，冷却管里有高压水。
entries.en: Heavy, with high-pressure water in its pipes.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 排空冷却管后整盒拆下。
entries.en: Drain it and take the cassette out whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 偏滤器把等离子体边缘的热和杂质引到靶板上，靶板热流可达每平方米 10–20 MW，接近火箭喉部。
entries.en: It leads the plasma edge's heat and impurities onto its targets, which take 10–20 MW per square metre — rocket-throat territory.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 回旋管
entries.en: GYROTRON

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 电子枪、超导磁体里的谐振腔、输出窗和顶部收集极。
entries.en: Electron gun, cavity inside a superconducting magnet, output window, collector on top.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 自带超导磁体；电子枪和收集极带几十千伏高压。
entries.en: It has its own superconducting magnet; its gun and collector run at tens of kilovolts.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 高压放电、磁体泄能后整件拆下。
entries.en: Discharge its high voltage and dump its magnet, then remove it whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 电子在强磁场里回旋，把能量交给毫米波：一支回旋管输出约 1 MW、170 GHz 的微波。输出窗是一片人造金刚石。
entries.en: Electrons gyrating in a strong field hand their energy to millimetre waves: one tube puts out about 1 MW at 170 GHz. Its output window is a disc of synthetic diamond.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 电子回旋加热天线
entries.en: EC LAUNCHER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 波纹波导束、固定聚焦镜和可转向的反射镜。
entries.en: A bundle of corrugated waveguides, a fixed focusing mirror and a steering mirror.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 反射镜精密易损；波导里可能有绝缘气体。
entries.en: Its mirrors are precise and fragile; its waveguides may hold insulating gas.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 远离它切割，整件拆下。
entries.en: Cut well away and remove it whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 转向镜把微波束打到等离子体里特定的磁面上，加热或驱动电流。
entries.en: The steering mirror aims the beam onto a chosen magnetic surface in the plasma, to heat it or drive current.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 中性束注入器
entries.en: NEUTRAL BEAM INJECTOR

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 离子源、加速栅极、中和室、偏转磁铁和低温泵。
entries.en: Ion source, accelerator grids, neutraliser, bending magnet and cryopumps.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 栅极带近百万伏高压，低温泵里冷凝着氢。
entries.en: Its grids run near a megavolt; its cryopumps hold condensed hydrogen.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 高压放电、低温泵回温泄气后再拆。
entries.en: Discharge it and let the cryopumps warm and vent before removing it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 把氘离子加速到上百 keV，再中和成不受磁场约束的中性原子，射进等离子体加热。低温泵一回温，冷凝在上面的氢会全部变回气体。
entries.en: Deuterium ions accelerated to hundreds of keV, neutralised so the field doesn't stop them, fired into the plasma. Warm the cryopumps and all the hydrogen frozen on them turns back to gas.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 弹丸注入器
entries.en: PELLET INJECTOR

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 在冷头下冻结氘冰的螺杆挤出机、切刀和气枪管。
entries.en: A screw extruder freezing deuterium ice under a cold head, a cutter and a gas gun.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 里面是冻着的氘，回温就变成可燃气体。
entries.en: It holds frozen deuterium that turns into flammable gas as it warms.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 回温泄气后再拆。
entries.en: Let it warm and vent before removing it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 毫米级的冰弹丸以每秒几百米射进等离子体，从里面补充燃料。
entries.en: Millimetre ice pellets fired in at hundreds of metres a second fuel the plasma from inside.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 窗口插件
entries.en: PORT PLUG

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 填满窗口的屏蔽块，里面有让光线穿过的反射镜迷宫。
entries.en: A shielding block filling a port, with a mirror labyrinth for the light to thread.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 极重，正面被活化。
entries.en: Very heavy, its face activated.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 按标线分段吊出。
entries.en: Cut on its lines and lift it out in sections.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 迷宫让诊断光路拐几次弯，中子沿直线走不出来。
entries.en: The labyrinth bends the diagnostic light path several times; neutrons, going straight, can't follow.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 制冷机冷箱（氦）
entries.en: CRYOPLANT COLD BOX

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 真空容器里的板翅式换热器和透平膨胀机：生产 4.5 K 液氦。
entries.en: Plate-fin exchangers and turboexpanders in a vacuum vessel: making 4.5 K helium.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 它停了，超导线圈就开始升温。
entries.en: Stop it and the superconducting coils start to warm.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 磁体泄完能之前保持它运行（要有电）。
entries.en: Keep it running (it needs power) until the magnets are dumped.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 从室温到 4.5 K 要经过几级换热和膨胀，每取走 1 W 的 4 K 热量，要在室温端花几百瓦电。
entries.en: Room temperature to 4.5 K takes several stages of exchange and expansion; every watt taken out at 4 K costs hundreds of watts at room temperature.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 氢冷箱
entries.en: HYDROGEN COLD BOX

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 真空夹套里一串板翅式换热器、透平和节流阀：液化氢气。
entries.en: Plate-fin exchangers, turbines and a Joule-Thomson valve in a vacuum jacket: liquefying hydrogen.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 它一停，低温罐就开始升压。
entries.en: Stop it and the cryogenic tanks start to climb.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 抽液期间保持它运行，最后再断电。
entries.en: Keep it running while you draw the cargo off; cut its power last.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 氢在 −253 °C 液化。冷箱同时负责把罐里蒸发的气体重新液化，所以它就是罐压的“刹车”。
entries.en: Hydrogen liquefies at −253 °C. The cold box also reliquefies what boils off the tanks — it's the brake on their pressure.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 稀释制冷机冷板
entries.en: DILUTION FRIDGE STAGE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 镀金铜板一级级吊着：50 K、4 K、蒸馏室、冷板、混合室。
entries.en: Gold-plated copper plates hung one below the other: 50 K, 4 K, still, cold plate, mixing chamber.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 混合室还在毫开时动它，下面的芯片会裂。
entries.en: Touch the stack while the mixing chamber is still at millikelvin and the chip cracks.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 按顺序回温，全部回到室温附近再拆。
entries.en: Warm it up in order and take it apart only near room temperature.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: ³He 从富 ⁴He 相“溶解”到稀相要吸热，这就是混合室能降到 10 mK 的原因。冷板之间用细同轴线和低导热支撑隔开，一层比一层冷。
entries.en: ³He dissolving from the concentrated phase into the dilute one takes heat in — how the mixing chamber reaches 10 mK. The plates are joined only by thin coax and low-conductance supports, each colder than the last.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 量子处理器封装
entries.en: QUANTUM PROCESSOR PACKAGE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 铜样品盒里的超导量子芯片，边缘一排 SMA 接头。
entries.en: A superconducting qubit chip in its copper sample box, SMA connectors round its edge.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 极冷时极脆：热冲击、振动、碰撞都会让它开裂。
entries.en: At base temperature it's brittle: thermal shock, vibration or a knock cracks it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 等它按序回温、锁住隔振台，再取。
entries.en: Wait for an ordered warm-up and lock the isolation table before taking it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 超导量子比特工作在约 10 mK，任何热、振动、杂散光都会破坏量子态。芯片本身是全船最贵的单件之一。
entries.en: Superconducting qubits work at about 10 mK, where any heat, vibration or stray light destroys their state. The chip is among the dearest single items aboard.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 脉管制冷机冷头
entries.en: PULSE-TUBE COLD HEAD

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 旋转阀、回热器、脉管和两级冷台：把系统预冷到 4 K。
entries.en: Rotary valve, regenerators, pulse tubes and two stages: pre-cooling the system to 4 K.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 它一停，整台稀释制冷机开始回温。
entries.en: Stop it and the whole dilution fridge starts warming.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 混合气回收完之后再停它。
entries.en: Stop it only after the mixture is recovered.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 脉管制冷机冷端没有运动部件，振动小，所以适合量子计算。压缩机通过柔性氦管供气。
entries.en: A pulse tube has no moving parts at its cold end and so little vibration — why quantum computers use it. Its compressor feeds it through flexible helium lines.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 气体处理系统
entries.en: GAS HANDLING SYSTEM

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: ³He/⁴He 回路的模拟面板、压力表、冷阱和泵。
entries.en: The ³He/⁴He circuit's mimic panel, gauges, cold trap and pumps.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 回路里是极贵的 ³He；没回收就停机，它会沸掉。
entries.en: The circuit holds very costly ³He; stop the fridge before recovering it and it boils off.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 停循环、把混合气收回储罐，再停冷头。
entries.en: Stop the circulation, recover the mixture to its tank, then stop the cold head.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 一台稀释制冷机约用几十升（标准状态）³He，每升价格数千美元。混合气收回储罐后压力会升到储罐的平衡值。
entries.en: A dilution fridge uses some tens of standard litres of ³He at thousands of dollars a litre. Recovered, the mixture settles at its storage tank's pressure.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 室温测控机柜
entries.en: ROOM-TEMPERATURE ELECTRONICS

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 任意波形发生器、数字化仪，一排 SMA 输出。
entries.en: Arbitrary waveform generators and digitisers, rows of SMA outputs.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 价值高、怕撞；接着进制冷机的同轴线。
entries.en: Valuable and fragile; coax runs from it into the fridge.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电拔线，整柜送设备口。
entries.en: Isolate, unplug, send it whole to the equipment bay.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 每个量子比特要几路微波控制和读出线，几十个比特就是几百根同轴线。
entries.en: Each qubit needs several microwave lines for control and readout; tens of qubits mean hundreds of coax runs.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 镜片（主镜 / 副镜）
entries.en: MIRROR SEGMENT

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 镀膜镜面和背后的轻量化肋板坯体。
entries.en: A coated face on a ribbed, lightweighted blank.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 附近切割的金属粉尘会污染镜面；促动器没锁就拆会掉落碎裂。
entries.en: Cutting nearby dusts its face; freed with its actuators unlocked, it drops and cracks.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先放防尘罩、锁促动器，从外圈往里拆。
entries.en: Run the dust cover down, lock the actuators, take the rings from the outside in.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 望远镜镜面的面形精度在几十纳米，镀膜只有约 100 nm 厚（铝或金）。一粒金属粉尘就是一个散射点。每块镜片由三到六个促动器支撑，外圈镜片的边缘搭在内圈上。
entries.en: A telescope mirror is true to tens of nanometres; its coating is about 100 nm of aluminium or gold. A grain of metal dust is a scattering spot. Each segment sits on three to six actuators, and the outer ring's edges rest on the inner.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 六足调整机构
entries.en: HEXAPOD

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 上下平台之间六根交叉的直线作动器：六个自由度调姿。
entries.en: Six crossing linear actuators between two plates: positioning in six degrees of freedom.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 它托着副镜；拆它之前副镜要先固定。
entries.en: It carries the secondary mirror; secure the mirror before you touch it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 锁住负载，断电后整件拆下。
entries.en: Lock its load, isolate it, remove it whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: Stewart 平台：六根杆的长度组合唯一决定上平台的位置和姿态，定位精度可达微米。
entries.en: A Stewart platform: the six legs' lengths fix the top plate's position and attitude, to micrometres.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 后光学平台
entries.en: AFT OPTICS BENCH

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 三镜、折转镜和精密指向镜排在光学平台上，光路通向仪器。
entries.en: Tertiary, fold and steering mirrors on a bench, the beam threading them to the instruments.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 整个平台的对准精度极高，撞一下全部失准。
entries.en: The whole bench is aligned to fine tolerances; one knock and it's all out.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 远离切割，整台慢慢运走。
entries.en: No cutting nearby; move the whole bench, slowly.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 平台用低膨胀材料（碳化硅、殷钢）做成，温度变化也不让光路偏移。
entries.en: The bench is low-expansion material (silicon carbide, Invar) so temperature doesn't shift the beam.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 精密指向镜
entries.en: FAST STEERING MIRROR

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 柔性铰链上的小镜子，背后三根压电堆。
entries.en: A small mirror on a flexure with three piezo stacks behind it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 压电堆带高压；镜面怕污染。
entries.en: Its piezo stacks carry high voltage; its face hates dust.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电后整件拆下。
entries.en: Isolate it and remove it whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 每秒上千次修正指向，抵消船体抖动；行程只有几毫弧度。
entries.en: It corrects the pointing thousands of times a second against the ship's jitter, over a few milliradians.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 精密导星仪
entries.en: FINE GUIDANCE SENSOR

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 取光镜、中继光学和两个导星探测器。
entries.en: Pick-off mirror, relay optics and two guide detectors.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 精密光学，怕撞怕尘。
entries.en: Precision optics; hates knocks and dust.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 远离切割，整件拆下。
entries.en: Cut away from it, remove it whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 盯住一颗导星，把望远镜的指向稳定在毫角秒级。
entries.en: It locks onto a guide star and holds the telescope's pointing to milliarcseconds.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 波前传感器
entries.en: WAVEFRONT SENSOR

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 微透镜阵列把光分成点阵，相机测每个点的偏移。
entries.en: A lenslet array splits the light into spots; a camera measures how each one moves.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 精密光学与相机，怕撞。
entries.en: Precision optics and a camera; fragile.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电后整件运走。
entries.en: Isolate and move it whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 夏克-哈特曼传感器：点的偏移就是波前的局部斜率，据此算出镜面要怎么调。
entries.en: A Shack-Hartmann sensor: each spot's shift is the wavefront's local slope, from which the mirror corrections are computed.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 镜片镀膜舱
entries.en: MIRROR RECOATER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 真空腔、蒸发源和挡板，镜片面朝下装在夹具里。
entries.en: A vacuum chamber, evaporation sources and shutter, a segment held face-down.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 腔里可能有镜片；蒸发源带电。
entries.en: A segment may be inside; its sources are electrically heated.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电，取出里面的镜片单独处理。
entries.en: Isolate it and deal with any segment inside separately.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 在真空中把铝加热蒸发，原子沉积在镜面上形成约 100 nm 的反射膜。
entries.en: Aluminium evaporated in vacuum condenses on the mirror into a reflective film about 100 nm thick.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 红外相机
entries.en: INFRARED CAMERA

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 真空杜瓦、冷指、滤光轮、镜筒和背后的制冷机。
entries.en: A vacuum dewar, cold finger, filter wheel, lens barrel and the cryocooler on its back.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 探测器在低温下，杜瓦有真空；制冷机带电。
entries.en: The detector is cold, the dewar under vacuum, the cooler live.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电回温后整件拆下。
entries.en: Isolate it, let it warm, remove it whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 红外探测器要冷到几十开尔文以下，否则自己的热辐射会淹没信号。
entries.en: An infrared detector has to be cooled to tens of kelvin, or its own glow drowns the signal.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 光谱仪
entries.en: SPECTROGRAPH

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 狭缝、准直镜、衍射光栅、相机镜头和探测器。
entries.en: Slit, collimator, diffraction grating, camera optics and detector.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 光栅刻线极密，摸一下就毁。
entries.en: The grating's ruling is so fine a touch ruins it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 盖着遮光罩整件运走。
entries.en: Move it whole under its cover.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 光栅每毫米上千条刻线，把光按波长分开；从谱线能读出元素和速度。
entries.en: A grating with thousands of lines a millimetre spreads light by wavelength; the lines in the spectrum give elements and velocities.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 日冕仪
entries.en: CORONAGRAPH

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 镜筒入口的遮挡盘挡住恒星本体，只看它周围的日冕。
entries.en: An occulting disc at the tube's mouth blots out the star to see the corona round it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 刚从近日点回来，可能还很烫；光学精密。
entries.en: Just back from perihelion it may be hot; its optics are precise.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 测温，冷下来再整件拆。
entries.en: Measure its temperature, wait for it to cool, remove it whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 日冕亮度只有日面的百万分之一，杂散光必须压到极低，所以镜筒里一圈圈都是挡光环。
entries.en: The corona is a millionth as bright as the disc, so stray light is driven down with vane after vane inside the tube.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 粒子探测器
entries.en: PARTICLE DETECTOR

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 准直器后面一叠硅探测器平面和吸收板。
entries.en: A stack of silicon detector planes and absorbers behind a collimator.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 精密、怕撞，偏压电源带高压。
entries.en: Precise and fragile, its bias supply at high voltage.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电后整件拆下。
entries.en: Isolate it and remove it whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 粒子穿过每层硅时损失能量，按损失的多少和穿透深度分辨粒子种类和能量。
entries.en: A particle loses energy in each silicon layer; how much and how deep it gets tell its kind and energy.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 磁强计
entries.en: MAGNETOMETER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 三个正交绕组的磁通门传感头和电子箱。
entries.en: A fluxgate head with three orthogonal windings, and its electronics.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 精密，装在伸杆根部。
entries.en: Precise, mounted at the root of its boom.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 整件拆下送设备口。
entries.en: Remove it whole to the equipment bay.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 磁强计要远离船上的磁性材料和电流，所以装在长杆末端；电子箱留在根部。
entries.en: It has to be far from the ship's magnetic materials and currents, hence the boom; its electronics stay at the root.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 分析仪器
entries.en: LABORATORY INSTRUMENTS

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 气相色谱、质谱仪、显微镜这类实验室仪器。
entries.en: Gas chromatographs, mass spectrometers, microscopes and the like.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 价值高、怕撞；质谱仪有真空泵和高压。
entries.en: Valuable and fragile; a mass spectrometer has vacuum pumps and high voltage.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电，整件轻运送设备口。
entries.en: Isolate it and carry it whole and gently to the equipment bay.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 色谱柱按沸点和极性把混合气分开，质谱按质荷比称出每种分子。
entries.en: A chromatograph's column separates a mixture by boiling point and polarity; a mass spectrometer weighs each molecule by mass to charge.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 浸没式服务器机柜
entries.en: IMMERSION RACK

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 竖插的刀片服务器整个泡在绝缘冷却液槽里。
entries.en: Blade servers stood on edge, all of them under a tank of dielectric fluid.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 槽里还有液就吊出来，液体泼出，短路相邻机柜。
entries.en: Lift it with the tank still full and the fluid spills, shorting the racks beside it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先从槽的接口把冷却液抽干，再吊机柜。
entries.en: Draw the tank dry at its port, then lift the rack.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 绝缘液（氟化液或合成油）直接接触芯片带走热量，比风冷高效得多。它本身很贵，泼掉就是损失；失重下泼出的液团会漂到隔壁机柜上。
entries.en: The dielectric (a fluorinated fluid or synthetic oil) touches the chips directly and carries heat far better than air. It's expensive in its own right; spilt, it's lost, and in free fall the globules drift onto the next rack.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 存储阵列与交换机
entries.en: STORAGE AND SWITCHING

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 一层层硬盘托架和控制器，或带线卡的核心交换机。
entries.en: Shelves of drive carriers and their controllers, or a core switch with its line cards.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 硬盘里可能是客户的监管数据。
entries.en: The drives may hold the client's data under custody.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先把监管盘锁进运输箱，再拆阵列。
entries.en: Latch the custody drives into their transport bays before the array.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 数据的价值和硬件无关：一个硬盘的硬件值几百块，里面的数据可能牵扯合同违约。
entries.en: Data's worth has nothing to do with the hardware: the drive is worth a few hundred, what's on it may be a breach of contract.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 监管硬盘
entries.en: CUSTODY DRIVE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 托架里的硬盘，带锁扣把手和活动灯。
entries.en: A drive in its carrier, with latch handle and activity light.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 没锁进屏蔽运输箱就带走，算违约，罚款。
entries.en: Taken out without being latched into the shielded transport bay, it's a breach: fined.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先拨它的监管锁扣，再整件运走。
entries.en: Throw its custody latch first, then take it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: “监管链”要求数据从离开机柜到交给客户，每一步都可证明没有被读取或复制。
entries.en: Chain of custody means every step from rack to client must show the data was never read or copied.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 顶驱
entries.en: TOP DRIVE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 吊在游车下的钻井电机：齿轮箱、主轴、两个内防喷阀和吊卡。
entries.en: The drilling motor under the travelling block: gearbox, main shaft, two IBOP valves, elevator.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 它连着钻杆，钻杆里可能还有扭矩和泥浆压力。
entries.en: It's on the string, which may still hold torque and mud pressure.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 钻杆泄扭泄压之后再动它。
entries.en: Only after the string's torque and pressure are bled.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 顶驱从上方直接旋转钻杆，同时从鹅颈管注入泥浆。功率常在 1 MW 以上。
entries.en: A top drive turns the string from above and pumps mud in through its gooseneck, often at over a megawatt.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 绞车
entries.en: DRAWWORKS

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 缠着大绳的卷筒、盘式刹车、电机和齿轮箱。
entries.en: A grooved drum with the drill line, disc brakes, motor and gearbox.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 大绳承受着整串钻具的拉力。
entries.en: Its line carries the whole string's pull.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 钻具卸完、大绳松弛后再拆。
entries.en: Only once the string is out and the line slack.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 大绳经天车和游车穿成多股，绞车拉一股，就能吊起几百吨。
entries.en: The line is reeved through crown and travelling blocks; one pull at the drum lifts hundreds of tonnes.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 天车与游车
entries.en: CROWN AND TRAVELLING BLOCKS

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 井架顶部的一排滑轮（天车）和上下移动的滑轮组（游车）。
entries.en: The sheaves atop the derrick (crown) and the block that rides up and down (travelling).

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 大绳绷着时它们是一套张紧的滑轮组。
entries.en: With the line taut they're a tensioned tackle.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 松了大绳再拆。
entries.en: Slack the line first.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 10 股大绳的滑轮组，绞车拉力乘以约 10 就是吊重。
entries.en: With ten lines strung, the hook load is about ten times the drum's pull.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 转盘
entries.en: ROTARY TABLE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 钻台上的转盘：齿圈、方补心和驱动小齿轮。
