entries.en: The turntable in the drill floor: ring gear, master bushing, drive pinion.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 它的刹车锁着钻杆里的残余扭矩。
entries.en: Its brake holds the residual torque in the string.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 关转盘刹车泄扭，扭矩表读到接近 0。
entries.en: Release the rotary brake to bleed the torque until the gauge reads near zero.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 几千米的钻杆像一根扭簧：转盘停下时，钻杆里还扭着几圈。
entries.en: Kilometres of pipe act as a torsion spring: when the table stops, the string is still wound up by several turns.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 钻杆
entries.en: DRILL PIPE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 三根一立的钻杆，接头处有耐磨带；排放架上一层层码着。
entries.en: Stands of three joints, hardbanding at the tool joints; racked in rows.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 还在井里的钻杆带着扭矩和泥浆压力。
entries.en: Pipe still in the hole holds torque and mud pressure.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 泄扭泄压后自上而下逐节卸扣。
entries.en: Bleed it, then break the stands out from the top down.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 钻杆接头是锥形螺纹，上扣扭矩几万牛·米。排放架上的钻杆是普通货物。
entries.en: Tool joints are tapered threads made up to tens of thousands of newton-metres. Racked pipe is ordinary cargo.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 钻具组合
entries.en: BOTTOM-HOLE ASSEMBLY

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 钻铤、扶正器、随钻测量工具、取芯筒和钻头。
entries.en: Drill collars, stabiliser, MWD tool, core barrel and bit.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 最重的一段，随钻工具里有电池，取芯筒里有岩芯。
entries.en: The heaviest part; the MWD tool carries batteries, the core barrel a core.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 电池按危险品处理，岩芯单独回收。
entries.en: Treat the batteries as hazards and recover the core separately.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 钻铤给钻头加压，扶正器让井眼保持笔直。岩芯是钻井的“产品”，常是合同指定件。
entries.en: Collars put weight on the bit; the stabiliser keeps the hole straight. The core is what drilling is for, often a named item.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 泥浆泵
entries.en: MUD PUMP

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 三缸往复泵：动力端、十字头、液力端和脉动阻尼器。
entries.en: A triplex pump: power end, crossheads, fluid end and pulsation dampener.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 排出管和阻尼器里有高压泥浆；阻尼器预充着氮气。
entries.en: Its discharge and dampener hold mud under pressure; the dampener is precharged with nitrogen.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 泄掉排出管压力和阻尼器的氮气，再拆。
entries.en: Bleed the discharge and the dampener's nitrogen, then remove it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 泥浆泵排压可达 35 MPa。脉动阻尼器的氮气囊吸收每一冲程的压力波动。
entries.en: Mud pumps discharge at up to 35 MPa. The dampener's nitrogen bladder absorbs each stroke's pressure surge.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 振动筛
entries.en: SHALE SHAKER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 弹簧上倾斜的筛箱，两台振动电机，筛出钻屑。
entries.en: A tilted basket on springs with two vibrator motors, screening the cuttings out.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 筛箱里是黏糊糊的泥浆。
entries.en: Its basket is full of sticky mud.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电后整件拆下。
entries.en: Isolate it and remove it whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 失重下没有重力让钻屑滑下筛面，船上的振动筛靠振动方向把钻屑“抛”出去。
entries.en: Without gravity cuttings don't slide off the screen; a ship's shaker throws them off along its vibration.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 泥浆净化设备
entries.en: MUD TREATMENT

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 除砂器、除气器、离心机、液气分离器和搅拌器。
entries.en: Desander, degasser, centrifuge, mud-gas separator and agitator.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 里面有泥浆，除气器和液气分离器里可能有可燃气。
entries.en: They hold mud, and the degasser and separator may hold flammable gas.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 排空、通风后再拆。
entries.en: Drain and vent them before removing them.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 钻到含气地层时，泥浆会带着天然气返回；除气器在真空下把气体分出来送去燃烧或放空。
entries.en: Drilling through gas, the mud comes back carrying it; the degasser draws it out under vacuum to flare or vent.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 铁钻工
entries.en: IRON ROUGHNECK

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 轨道上的小车、折叠臂和上下两套扳手头。
entries.en: A carriage on its rail, folding arm, spinner and torque wrench heads.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 液压驱动，保着压时动作会很猛。
entries.en: Hydraulic, and violent if it moves while pressurised.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 泄压后拆。
entries.en: Relieve it before removing it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 铁钻工代替人上卸钻杆螺纹：上面旋扣，下面用几万牛·米扭矩紧扣或松扣。
entries.en: It makes and breaks the pipe connections in place of a crew: spinning above, up to tens of thousands of newton-metres below.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 防喷器组
entries.en: BLOWOUT PREVENTER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 环形防喷器加三道闸板防喷器（含剪切闸板），侧出口阀。
entries.en: An annular preventer over three ram preventers (one blind-shear), with side outlet valves.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 关着的闸板下面可能憋着井压。
entries.en: Pressure may be trapped below closed rams.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 从节流/压井管线泄压，确认无压后再拆。
entries.en: Bleed it through the choke or kill line and confirm it's dead before removing it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 井涌时防喷器在几秒内封住井口；剪切闸板能剪断钻杆封井。它是井控的最后一道屏障，也是钻井船上最贵的设备之一。
entries.en: In a kick the BOP shuts the well in seconds; the shear rams cut the pipe and seal. It's the last barrier of well control and one of a drillship's dearest items.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 立管与节流管汇
entries.en: STANDPIPE AND CHOKE MANIFOLD

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 立管、闸阀、节流阀、压力表和防喷器蓄能器组。
entries.en: Standpipe, gate valves, adjustable choke, gauges and the BOP accumulator unit.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 管汇和蓄能器里都有高压。
entries.en: Both the manifold and the accumulators hold high pressure.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 经泄压阀放压，蓄能器泄到 0 再拆。
entries.en: Bleed it through its valves, bring the accumulators to zero, then remove it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 防喷器蓄能器（Koomey）在 21 MPa 下储存足够关闭全部闸板的液压能，断电也能工作。
entries.en: The BOP accumulators (a Koomey unit) store enough fluid at 21 MPa to close every ram, power or no power.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 正仲氢转化器
entries.en: ORTHO-PARA CONVERTER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 换热器通道里填着氧化铁催化剂，泡在冷浴里。
entries.en: Hydrous iron oxide catalyst packed in a heat exchanger's passages, in a cold bath.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 里面是极冷的氢。
entries.en: Full of very cold hydrogen.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 回温泄压后再拆。
entries.en: Warm it and relieve it before removing it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 常温氢 75% 是正氢；液化后它会自发转成仲氢并放热，足以把一罐液氢蒸掉大半，所以液化时就要用催化剂转化掉。
entries.en: Room-temperature hydrogen is 75 % ortho; liquefied, it slowly converts to para and gives off enough heat to boil away most of a tank — so it's converted on a catalyst as it's liquefied.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 液氮预冷器
entries.en: LN₂ PRECOOLER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 液氮浴槽里的盘管，工艺气从中穿过预冷。
entries.en: A coiled bundle in a liquid nitrogen bath, the process gas running through it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 槽里有液氮，一直在蒸发。
entries.en: It holds liquid nitrogen, always boiling off.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 抽空液氮、放掉蒸发气后再拆。
entries.en: Draw off the nitrogen and vent the boil-off before removing it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先用 77 K 的液氮把气体预冷，后面的透平才能高效地冷到 20 K。
entries.en: Pre-cooling the gas with 77 K nitrogen lets the turbines downstream reach 20 K efficiently.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 电弧炉炉芯
entries.en: ARC FURNACE CORE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 耐火衬里的炉壳、三根石墨电极和水冷炉顶。
entries.en: A refractory-lined shell, three graphite electrodes and a water-cooled roof.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 停机不等于冷却：几百度的炉芯断了冷却会热震开裂。
entries.en: Stopped isn't cold: cut the cooling on a core still at hundreds of degrees and thermal shock cracks it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 保持冷却直到它冷透，再整件吊出。
entries.en: Keep the cooling on until it's cold through, then lift it out whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 耐火材料导热差，内外温差大时热应力会把它震裂。炉芯从 760 °C 降到 150 °C，在冷却回路工作时约需两分半。
entries.en: Refractory conducts heat badly; a big temperature difference through it cracks it. With the loop running, the core comes down from 760 °C to 150 °C in about two and a half minutes.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 分选机
entries.en: SORTER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 涡电流分选机或磁选滚筒：把金属按种类分开。
entries.en: An eddy-current sorter or magnetic drum: separating metals by kind.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 转子里是强永磁体，会吸铁屑和无人机。
entries.en: Its rotor is strong permanent magnets that pull steel swarf and the drone.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电、等转子停，再拆。
entries.en: Isolate it, let the rotor stop, then remove it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 高速旋转的磁极在铝、铜里感应涡流，产生的斥力把有色金属“弹”过分料板，铁则被磁吸走。
entries.en: Spinning magnets induce eddy currents in aluminium and copper whose repulsion flicks them over the splitter, while iron is held by the magnet.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 尾气洗涤塔
entries.en: WET SCRUBBER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 填料床、喷淋头、除雾器和循环泵。
entries.en: Packed bed, spray header, mist eliminator and recirculation pump.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 塔底的液体吸收了有害气体，有腐蚀性。
entries.en: The sump liquid has taken up the off-gas and is corrosive.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 排空塔底液，再拆。
entries.en: Drain the sump, then remove it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 碱液喷淋吸收尾气里的酸性气体（SO₂、HCl）。
entries.en: An alkaline spray absorbs the acid gases (SO₂, HCl) from the off-gas.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 破碎头
entries.en: CRUSHER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 圆锥破碎机：动锥在碗形衬板里偏心摆动。
entries.en: A cone crusher: a mantle gyrating inside a bowl liner.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 料仓里还有矿时，它连着矿堆的重量。
entries.en: With ore still in the hopper, it bears the heap's load.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先卸空料仓，再拆。
entries.en: Empty the hopper first.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 偏心轴让动锥一张一合，矿石在狭缝里被挤碎；很重，常要分段。
entries.en: An eccentric opens and closes the gap and the ore is crushed in it; heavy, often taken out in sections.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 炮塔与炮座
entries.en: GUN TURRET

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 多面体炮室、炮管、耳轴、回转座圈和下方的弹药提升机。
entries.en: Faceted gunhouse, barrel, trunnion, slewing ring and the hoist below.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 提升机和炮膛里可能还有弹药。
entries.en: Rounds may still be in the hoist and the breech.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先清空弹药，再按标线拆炮塔。
entries.en: Clear the ammunition first, then take it apart on its lines.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 炮塔很重，座圈的滚道承受全部重量和后坐力；炮管是厚壁高强钢。
entries.en: A turret is heavy; its roller race carries the whole weight and the recoil. The barrel is thick high-strength steel.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 箱式发射架
entries.en: BOX LAUNCHER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 并排的发射箱，各有易碎盖；或诱饵弹发射筒。
entries.en: Canisters side by side with frangible covers; or decoy tubes.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 箱里可能有弹：切、烤、撞都会让它起爆。
entries.en: A canister may still be loaded: cut, heated or knocked, it goes off.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 别在附近切割；弹药按危险品整件送。
entries.en: Don't cut near it; send the munitions whole as hazards.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 导弹的固体发动机和战斗部都是含能材料，受热到一定温度会自燃（烤燃）。
entries.en: A missile's solid motor and warhead are energetic materials that ignite on their own above a certain temperature (cook-off).

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 近防炮
entries.en: CLOSE-IN WEAPON SYSTEM

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 旋转多管炮、上方的雷达罩和底座。
entries.en: A rotary cannon, its radar dome above, and the mount.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 弹鼓里可能有弹，电容带电。
entries.en: Its drum may hold rounds and its capacitors charge.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 放电、清空弹鼓后再拆。
entries.en: Discharge it and empty the drum before removing it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 射速每分钟几千发，弹鼓装上千发——一个弹鼓就是一座小弹药库。
entries.en: It fires thousands of rounds a minute from a drum of over a thousand — the drum is a small magazine.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 弹药：烤燃与殉爆
entries.en: MUNITIONS: COOK-OFF AND CHAIN

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 弹库里的炮弹和导弹：受热、撞击都会起爆，一发引一串。
entries.en: Shells and missiles in the magazine: heat or a knock sets one off, and one sets off the rest.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 在弹药附近切割会把它烤到起爆；一发炸了，附近的接连殉爆。
entries.en: Cutting near a round cooks it off; one goes, and those near it follow one by one.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先开注水阀淹掉弹库（弹药报废但安全），或远离弹药作业。
entries.en: Open the flood valve to wet the magazine (the rounds are scrap, but safe), or keep the laser well away.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 激光在弹药一定范围内工作会持续加热它，到达烤燃温度就起爆；以超过一定速度撞到东西也会起爆。弹库的热测点读出最烫的那一发。注水后的弹药既不怕热也不怕撞，但也不值钱了。
entries.en: The beam working near a round keeps heating it until it reaches its cook-off temperature; hitting something fast enough sets it off too. The magazine's heat test point reads its hottest round. Wetted rounds fear neither heat nor knocks — and are worth nothing.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 超导磁体失超
entries.en: SUPERCONDUCTING MAGNET QUENCH

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 八组超导线圈储着磁能，靠液氦和冷箱保持超导。
entries.en: Eight coil packs holding field energy, kept superconducting by liquid helium and the cold box.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 失冷超过临界温度、或带场切支撑，线圈失超：能量瞬间释放，并连锁到相邻线圈。
entries.en: Lose the cooling past the critical temperature, or cut a support while energised, and it quenches — all at once, and the coils beside it follow.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 合上泄能开关、保持冷箱有电，储能读数降到安全值再断冷却、拆线圈。
entries.en: Close the dump switch, keep the cold box powered, wait for the stored energy to fall to safe, only then the cooling and the coils.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 泄能时电流经泄能电阻按 e^(−t/τ) 衰减，几个时间常数后降到安全值以下，这时线圈升温也无害。顺序反过来（先断冷却），线圈在满能量时升温越过临界温度，失超释放的热和电磁力会毁掉线圈和周围设备，还会烧掉一部分昂贵的液氦。
entries.en: Dumping, the current decays through the resistor as e^(−t/τ) and after a few time constants is below safe; then the coil can warm harmlessly. The other way round — cooling off first — it warms past critical while full, and the quench's heat and forces wreck it and what's near, boiling off costly helium.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 还在转的飞轮
entries.en: A FLYWHEEL STILL SPINNING

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 飞轮开局 20,000 rpm；刹车、冷却和转速表管着它。
entries.en: The flywheel comes in at 20,000 rpm; brake, brake cooling and a tachometer go with it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 不开冷却干刹，8 秒后卡钳烧坏，从此停不下来；300 rpm 以上松开，轮子甩出去。
entries.en: Brake it dry and the caliper burns out in 8 s and it can't be stopped; free it above 300 rpm and it's thrown.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先开刹车冷却再上刹车，等到 300 rpm 以下再拆；轨道预紧从尾往头松。
entries.en: Brake cooling on, then the brake; under 300 rpm, take it out. Slack the rail preloads from the tail forward.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 开着冷却时刹车每秒降 250 rpm，从 20,000 降下来约 80 秒；干刹降速减半。飞轮能量与转速平方成正比，300 rpm 时只剩开局的 0.02%。两组电容断主电后仍带 400 V，喂着上轨的直线电机：先放电。
entries.en: With cooling on the brake takes 250 rpm off a second, about 80 s down from 20,000; dry, half as fast. The energy goes with the square of the speed: at 300 rpm, 0.02 % of what it started with. Two capacitor banks keep 400 V on the upper rail's linear motor after the mains is off: discharge them first.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 救生舱火工品
entries.en: ESCAPE POD PYROTECHNICS

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 每个救生舱两个发射夹，前夹装着爆炸螺栓，接着它自己的发射电容。
entries.en: Each pod has two launch clamps; the front one carries an explosive bolt fed by its own launch capacitor.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 待发电路还带电时拆发射夹或火工品，螺栓走火，救生舱被弹出去。
entries.en: Free the clamp or the charge with the arming circuit live and the bolt fires: the pod is thrown out.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 在竖井的救生舱控制面板断开待发开关，再拆夹子；火工品送危险品口。
entries.en: Disarm it at the pod control panel in the shaft, then the clamps; the charges go to the hazard mouth.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 发射电容是一路独立电源，主开关管不到它。爆炸螺栓本身是危险品，不能进熔炉。某些合同里会有一个救生舱的发射电路仍然带电（“救生舱待发”事故）。
entries.en: The launch capacitor is a supply of its own, beyond the main switch. The bolts are hazards and never go to the furnace. Some contracts have one pod whose circuit is still armed.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 残磁
entries.en: RESIDUAL MAGNETISM

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 磁力牵引头断电后还留着磁场。
entries.en: The magnetic towing head keeps a field after its power is off.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 范围内会把无人机和散落的钢件吸过去撞上。
entries.en: It pulls the drone and loose steel in range onto itself.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 在线圈电源断开后，用退磁控件消磁，再靠近。
entries.en: With its coil supply dead, degauss it at its control before going near.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 铁磁材料磁化后会保留剩磁；退磁是用逐渐衰减的交变磁场把磁畴打乱。退磁要求线圈本身没电，否则会重新磁化。
entries.en: Ferromagnetic material keeps some magnetisation; degaussing scrambles its domains with a decaying alternating field — which needs the coil's own supply dead, or it simply re-magnetises.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 预紧机构
entries.en: PRELOADED MECHANISMS

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 靠液压蓄能器或锁销撑着、储着力的臂、轴、铰链和缆。
entries.en: Arms, shafts, hinges and cables held under load by accumulators or locking pins.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 锁销还在、或液压还有压就拆枢轴，它会弹开，砸坏它和它撞上的东西。
entries.en: Take the pivot out with a pin still in or pressure still on, and it springs, smashing itself and what it hits.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先泄蓄能器的压，再拔全部锁销，张力表归零，最后拆枢轴。
entries.en: Bleed the accumulator, pull every pin, see the tension gauge reach zero, then the pivot.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 预紧储存的是弹性能和液压能：拉缆 E = F²L/2EA，蓄能器 E ≈ pV·ln(p/p₀)。卸能的顺序总是“能量—锁—结构”。拆完锁销但没泄压，力全落在枢轴上，枢轴一松就释放。
entries.en: Preload stores elastic and hydraulic energy: a cable E = F²L/2EA, an accumulator roughly pV·ln(p/p₀). The order is always energy, then locks, then structure. Pins out but pressure still on, all the force sits on the pivot, released the moment it goes.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 各自带电的无人机
entries.en: DRONES WITH THEIR OWN POWER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 机库里每个机位、每架无人机都有自己的电池。
entries.en: Every bay and every drone in the hangar has a battery of its own.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断了主电池它们照样带电；电池还在机身上就松开，无人机醒来把自己甩进机位。
entries.en: Kill the main battery and they're still live; release one with its pack aboard and it wakes and throws itself into its bay.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断机位充电开关、断机身电池开关，拔两根线，摘电池包，再整机运走。
entries.en: Charger off at the rack, battery off on the airframe, both leads out, pack off — then the drone, whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 无人机的飞控在失去链路时会尝试自主起飞；只有电池物理断开才算安全。整机交付设备口价值远高于熔成废料。
entries.en: A drone's controller tries to take off on its own when its link drops; only a physically disconnected battery is safe. Delivered whole it's worth far more than melted.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 低温货罐
entries.en: CRYOGENIC CARGO TANKS

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 真空夹套里的低温货罐，压力跟着温度走。
entries.en: Cold cargo tanks in vacuum jackets, their pressure following their temperature.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 回温升压；安全阀冻住时压力冲到爆罐。夹套破了漏热快十倍。
entries.en: Warming raises the pressure; with the relief frozen it climbs to burst. A broken jacket leaks heat ten times faster.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 保持制冷机运行，从货罐接口抽液；冻住的阀先加热解冻。
entries.en: Keep the chillers running, draw the cargo at each tank's port, thaw a frozen valve with its heater.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 有液体时罐的蒸气压随温度升高大约每 20 °C 翻一倍。真空夹套完好时漏热很慢，一单合同里升不到 10 °C；夹套一破就快得多。
entries.en: With liquid in it the vapour pressure roughly doubles every 20 °C. A sound vacuum jacket lets heat in slowly — under 10 °C in a contract's time; broken, far faster.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 蒸发升压
entries.en: BOIL-OFF

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 低温罐一直在蒸发，罐压持续上升；制冷运转时压力保持。
entries.en: The tanks boil off and their pressure keeps climbing; with refrigeration running it holds.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先断电，制冷一停，压力爬到安全阀放空（货物损失）或爆罐。
entries.en: Cut the power first and the cooling stops: the pressure climbs to the relief (cargo lost) or to burst.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 边制冷边从软管抽液，抽得越多压力越低；最后才断电。
entries.en: Refrigerate while you draw the cargo off at the hose — the more drawn, the lower the pressure — and cut the power last.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 蒸发的气体占液体几百倍的体积，所以一点点漏热就让压力明显上升；保温层破损处升得更快。安全阀起跳放掉的就是货物本身。
entries.en: Boil-off gas takes hundreds of times the liquid's volume, so a little heat leak raises the pressure fast, faster where the insulation is torn. What the relief vents is the cargo itself.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 冻住的安全阀
entries.en: A FROZEN RELIEF VALVE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 某个罐的安全阀出口结了冰塞，打不开。
entries.en: One tank's relief valve has an ice plug in its outlet and won't lift.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 压力过了起跳值它也不泄放，一直升到爆罐。
entries.en: Past its set pressure it doesn't relieve; the tank climbs on until it bursts.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 测各罐安全阀的温度：异常冷的那个开加热解冻，或先把它的罐抽低。
entries.en: Read each relief valve's temperature: thaw the abnormally cold one with its heater, or draw its tank down first.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 泄放的低温气体在出口膨胀降温，空气或水汽在出口冻成冰塞。测温探针能发现它：冻住的阀比其它阀冷得多。
entries.en: Cold gas venting through the outlet expands and chills it, freezing moisture into an ice plug. The probe shows it: the frozen valve reads far colder than the rest.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 稀释制冷机按序回温
entries.en: DILUTION FRIDGE WARM-UP

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 量子芯片在毫开级的混合室里；制冷机一层层冷板吊着它。
entries.en: The qubit chip sits in the mixing chamber at millikelvin, hung under stage after stage.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 混合气没收回就停冷头，混合气沸掉、冷板受损；极冷时加热或动它，芯片热震开裂。
entries.en: Stop the cold head before recovering the mixture and it boils off; heat it or touch it while still at millikelvin and the chip cracks.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 停循环泵 → 回收混合气 → 停脉管冷头 → 冷板自然回温，过了极冷再开加热；锁住隔振台再动刀。
entries.en: Stop circulation → recover the mixture → stop the pulse tube → let the stages warm, heaters only past the coldest → lock the isolation table before any cutting.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 混合室最冷、回温最慢。在低于热震温度时打开加热器，芯片表面和内部温差太大，硅片会裂；低于脆性温度时任何振动都能让它碎。隔振台没锁，附近的切割会通过台面震到芯片。
entries.en: The mixing chamber is coldest and warms slowest. Heaters switched on below the shock temperature put too much difference between the chip's surface and its body and the silicon cracks; below the brittle temperature any shake breaks it. With the isolation table unlocked, a nearby cut shakes the chip.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 冷链不能断
entries.en: THE COLD CHAIN

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 三个冷舱 −25 °C，靠冷机和制冷主机保温。
entries.en: Three cold holds at −25 °C, held there by the chillers and the refrigeration plant.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电或切坏制冷，冷舱回温；过了 −5 °C 货物解冻，只剩 45% 价值。
entries.en: Cut the power or the plant and the holds warm; past −5 °C the cargo thaws and keeps 45 % of its value.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先在外部面板插上“船坞临时供冷”，再断电、再动制冷系统。
entries.en: Plug in berth cooling at the outside panel first, then cut the power and work the plant.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 冷冻货物的价值来自“从未解冻”：一次回温就不可逆。制冷剂从储液罐回收口闭环回收；开舱顶货舱口前先放气。
entries.en: Frozen cargo is worth what it is because it never thawed: one warm-up can't be undone. The refrigerant is recovered at the receiver's port; vent each hold before opening its roof hatch.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 冰体
entries.en: THE ICE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 整座冰山就是货：每块冰 0.6 m³ 水，靠加热垫逐块融化。
entries.en: The iceberg is the cargo: each block 0.6 m³ of water, melted block by block with the heater pads.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 融水积到 3 m³ 不抽、总线带电，发动机舱短路；鞍座夹着时切裂纹处的冰，冰体裂开。
entries.en: Let 3 m³ of melt pile up with the bus live and the engine room shorts; cut the cracked blocks with the saddles still clamped and the ice splits.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 开加热垫，边融边从水总管接口抽走；冰剩一半以下再松鞍座。
entries.en: Heaters on, draw the melt off at the water header as it comes; release the saddles only once less than half the ice is left.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 融化 1 kg 冰要 334 kJ。冰切得很慢——切口会重新冻上。应变表读冰体裂纹的扩展程度（开局 90%）。
entries.en: Melting a kilogram of ice takes 334 kJ. Ice cuts very slowly, its kerf freezing over again. The strain gauge reads how far the crack has run (90 % at the start).

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 钻杆残余扭矩与泥浆压力
entries.en: TRAPPED TORQUE AND MUD PRESSURE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 八节立根还扭着残余扭矩，管里憋着泥浆压力。
entries.en: Eight stands still wound with residual torque, mud pressure trapped inside.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 带扭矩卸扣，钻杆反弹扭断、甩打钻台；带压卸扣，泥浆喷出污染设备。
entries.en: Break a stand with torque on and it whips round, smashing the drill floor; with pressure on, the mud blows out over the equipment.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 关转盘刹车泄扭（扭矩表 < 5%），开泄压阀放泥浆（可回收），再卸扣。
entries.en: Release the rotary brake to bleed the torque (gauge under 5 %), open the relief and recover the mud, then break out.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 扭矩泄放按时间常数指数下降；泥浆从泄压阀放到回收口是有价值的货。扭矩表和压力表都在钻台上。
entries.en: The torque bleeds off exponentially; the mud drained through the relief is cargo worth recovering. Both gauges are on the drill floor.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 卡瓦与自上而下
entries.en: SLIPS, TOP DOWN

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 每节立根下面一副卡瓦，托着它和它下面的整串钻杆。
entries.en: Under each stand a set of slips, holding it and everything below it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先卸下面的，上面的失去支撑掉落；卡瓦没坐好就卸，下面的整串掉进井。
entries.en: Break a lower stand first and those above lose their support and drop; break out with the slips open and the string below drops down the hole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 从最上面一节开始，确认下面的卡瓦坐着，逐节往下卸。
entries.en: Start with the top stand, check the slips under it are set, and work down.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 卡瓦是楔形牙块，钻杆越重咬得越紧。钻台作业的铁律：任何时候钻杆都要被卡瓦或吊卡之一抓着。
entries.en: Slips are wedged dies that grip harder the heavier the pipe. The rig floor's rule: at every moment the string is held by either the slips or the elevator.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 交叉连通罐
entries.en: CROSS-CONNECTED TANKS

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 三个罐经交叉阀接到一根总管，大泵从泵房回收口抽总管。
entries.en: Three tanks on one header through crossover valves; the big pump draws the header at the pump room's port.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先断电泵就抽不动；抽干还开着泵干转损坏；先泄罐顶气再抽，罐被吸瘪。
entries.en: Cut the power first and the pump can't draw; leave it on dry and it wrecks itself; vent the ullage before drawing and the tank collapses.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 开交叉阀，带着增压抽完，关回收口，再关增压、泄罐顶气；支管残液从低点排放口抽。
entries.en: Crossovers open, draw it off pressurised, close the port, then pressurisation off and ullage vented; drain the branches at their low points.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 开着交叉阀的罐液位会经总管拉平（连通器）。增压阀开着时，氮气球罐保持罐压，抽液不会抽出真空。有的合同里一个交叉阀显示关、实际内漏：关着时那个罐液位还在降。
entries.en: Tanks with open crossovers level out through the header. With the pressurisation open, the nitrogen sphere keeps the ullage pressure up and drawing can't pull a vacuum. In some contracts a crossover reads shut but leaks: that tank's level keeps falling with it closed.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 浸没冷却
entries.en: IMMERSION COOLING

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 十二个机柜各泡在一槽绝缘冷却液里。
entries.en: Twelve racks, each standing in a tank of dielectric coolant.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 槽里有液就吊机柜，液体泼洒，短路同一排相邻的机柜。
entries.en: Lift a rack with its tank full and the fluid spills, shorting the racks beside it in the row.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 每个槽从接口抽干，再吊机柜。
entries.en: Draw each tank dry at its port before lifting its rack.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 冷却液本身很贵，按体积计价；失重下泼出的液团会漂到相邻机柜上。
entries.en: The coolant is dear and paid by volume; in free fall what spills drifts onto the next racks.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 数据监管
entries.en: DATA CUSTODY

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 存储阵列的硬盘是客户的监管物，要锁进屏蔽运输箱。
entries.en: The storage drives are the client's property in custody, to be latched into shielded transport bays.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 监管锁扣没拨就拔出硬盘，算违约罚款。
entries.en: Pull a drive with its custody latch open and it's a breach, fined.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先拨每块盘的监管锁扣，运输箱整件送设备口。
entries.en: Throw every drive's latch; take the transport bays whole to the equipment bay.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 运输箱本身是合同指定件。锁扣拨上后，硬盘是客户封存的财产，完整计价。
entries.en: The transport bays are named items. Latched, the drives are the client's sealed property and pay whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 失重水球
entries.en: THE WATER BALL

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 网罩里团着几十立方米的水，里面养着鱼。
entries.en: Tens of cubic metres of water held in a net, fish living in it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 网罩或支架被切、被拆，水球散开：水损失，舱里电气泡水，总线带电就短路，鱼死。
entries.en: Cut or free the net or its frame and it bursts: the water lost, the room's electrics soaked (shorted if the bus is live), the fish dead.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先用泵把水抽到安全量以下（水球会变小），再拆网罩；鱼苗箱是指定件。
entries.en: Pump it down below the safe fraction first (the ball shrinks as you go), then the net; the fish holding tank is a named item.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 没有重力，表面张力把水团成球；网罩只是轻轻兜着它。30 m³ 水是 30 吨，散开后的水团以原有的速度四处漂。
entries.en: With no gravity surface tension rounds the water into a ball; the net only cradles it. 30 m³ is 30 tonnes, and burst, it drifts apart at whatever speed it had.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 外观相同的三种介质
entries.en: THREE LOOK-ALIKE MEDIA

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 溶剂、酸液和乙二醇三只罐，三路管子一样且在途中交叉。
entries.en: Solvent, acid and glycol in three tanks; their three identical pipes cross on the way to the header.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 抽一路时另两路阀没关，三种混成废液，一文不值还要付处理费。
entries.en: Draw one with the others' valves open and they mix into waste: worthless, and you pay for its disposal.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 在总管每个口旁的取样点测一下是什么，关掉另两路的阀再抽。
entries.en: Sample at the point beside each header port to see what it is, shut the other two branches, then draw.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 总管 1 号口出来的是 3 号罐，2 号口是 1 号罐，3 号口是 2 号罐——不测就会接错。支路还有液就拆总管，各路都会漏出来按量罚款。分离器有残压，从塔上的口泄压。
entries.en: Header port 1 is tank 3, port 2 is tank 1, port 3 is tank 2 — guess and you're wrong. Take the header off with liquid in the branches and they all leak, fined by volume. The separator keeps some pressure; relieve it at its port.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 富氧闪燃
entries.en: OXYGEN-RICH FLASH FIRE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 舱里氧浓度远高于空气的 21%，各舱各不相同。
entries.en: Rooms whose oxygen is well above air's 21 %, each different.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 有气压、氧超过阈值时在附近动激光，整舱闪燃，设备烧坏，无人机也被烧。
entries.en: With pressure in it and oxygen over the threshold, a laser nearby flashes the whole room: equipment burnt, the drone too.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先读各舱氧浓度，从各自的接口分舱放气，再动激光。
entries.en: Read each room's oxygen, vent each through its own port, then use the laser.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 氧浓度从 21% 升到 35% 以上，可燃物的点燃温度大幅下降、燃速成倍提高，织物和塑料几乎一点就着。舱门打开，两舱空气会混合。
entries.en: From 21 % to over 35 % oxygen, ignition temperatures fall and burning rates multiply; fabric and plastics light at almost nothing. Open a door between two rooms and their air mixes.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 复合材料毒烟
entries.en: COMPOSITE FUMES

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 机身板件是碳纤维复合材料，用螺栓固定。
entries.en: The airframe panels are carbon-fibre composite, bolted on.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 在有气的舱旁激光切它，放出有毒烟雾，电子设备掉价、玻璃起雾。
entries.en: Cut it with the laser next to a room with air and it fills with toxic smoke: electronics lose value, glass fogs.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 拧螺栓整块拆，或先把舱抽成真空再切。
entries.en: Unbolt the panels whole, or vent the room to vacuum before cutting.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 环氧树脂基体在激光下热解，产生一氧化碳、氰化氢和细碳纤维尘。舱抽成真空时烟雾随空气一起排掉。
entries.en: The epoxy matrix pyrolyses under the beam into carbon monoxide, hydrogen cyanide and fine fibre dust. Venting the room takes the smoke out with the air.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 辐射阴影
entries.en: RADIATION SHADOW

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 停了的堆芯 1 m 处 3.2 Sv/h；屏蔽板、掩蔽间和液氢罐后面是阴影。
entries.en: The shut-down core reads 3.2 Sv/h at a metre; behind the shield, the shelter and the hydrogen tanks is shadow.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 无人机累积剂量过 150 mSv，电子设备紊乱；切开堆芯包壳全船污染。
entries.en: Past 150 mSv the drone's electronics fault; cut the core's cladding and the whole ship is contaminated.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先把屏蔽板吊到堆芯前，在它的阴影里干活；锁好控制鼓，堆芯整件走危险品口。
entries.en: Hang the shield in front of the core and work in its shadow; lock the control drums and send the core whole to the hazard mouth.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 剂量率与距离平方成反比：7 m 外约 65 mSv/h，停一分多钟就会出事（游戏里 1 秒按 2 分钟剂量计）。屏蔽板在哪，阴影就在哪——装着的、吊在吊车上的都算。剂量探头读所在位置的剂量率。
entries.en: Dose rate falls with the square of distance: at 7 m about 65 mSv/h, and a minute or so there is trouble (each second counts two minutes' dose). The shadow is wherever the shield is — on its mounts or on the crane. The dose probe reads the rate where it sits.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 停机不等于冷却
entries.en: STOPPED ISN'T COLD

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 炉芯或堆芯停了还有几百度，只靠冷却回路降温。
entries.en: A furnace or reactor core stopped is still hundreds of degrees, cooled only by its loop.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 高温时断了冷却，热冲击把它震裂；没冷透就吊出、收散热瓣，同样开裂变形。
entries.en: Cut the cooling while it's hot and thermal shock cracks it; lift it or fold its radiator petals before it's cold and it cracks or deforms the same.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 保持泵有电、回路满，读温度等它冷透，再断电、再吊出。
entries.en: Keep the pump powered and the loop full, watch the temperature down, then cut power and lift it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 冷却回路工作时约每秒降 4 °C。MF-126 的炉芯 350 °C 以上断冷却会裂，150 °C 以上吊出会裂；NR-95 的堆芯 60 °C 以上收散热瓣会变形。
entries.en: With the loop running it comes down about 4 °C a second. MF-126's core cracks if the cooling goes above 350 °C and if lifted above 150 °C; NR-95's petals deform if folded above 60 °C.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 近日点余热
entries.en: PERIHELION HEAT

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 刚掠过太阳，隔热瓦和前部壳体分区 300–800 °C。
entries.en: Just back from a pass close to the sun: heat tiles and forward hull at 300–800 °C by zone.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 热区切割隔热瓦会碎；从热区取出的设备被烫坏；无人机进最热区会受伤。
entries.en: Cut a hot tile and it shatters; equipment taken out of a hot zone is heat-damaged; the drone is burnt in the hottest.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 接上船坞冷却回路加速降温，用测温探针确认各区，冷了再动。
entries.en: Plug in the berth's cooling loop to speed it, read each zone with the probe, work it once cool.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 真空中只能辐射散热，各区按自己的速率自然冷却；冷却回路能接到的区冷得快得多。
entries.en: In vacuum each zone sheds heat only by radiation, at its own rate; the zones the cooling loop reaches cool much faster.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 负压与生物污染
entries.en: NEGATIVE PRESSURE AND BIOHAZARD

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 隔离舱压力低于相邻舱；生物废物箱、滤芯和废液罐带污染。
entries.en: Isolation rooms kept below their neighbours' pressure; biohazard boxes, filters and waste tanks are contaminated.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 切开或未密封就搬，污染散进舱里空气，随气流扩散；干净舱被污染，设备价值降四分之一。
entries.en: Cut or moved unsealed, it spills into the air and travels with it; a clean room contaminated marks its equipment down a quarter.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先封好每件生物危险品，经回收软管的滤芯放气，再开门。
entries.en: Seal every biohazard item, vent through the recovery hose's filter, then open doors.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 负压让空气只往隔离舱里流，污染出不来；负压一撤（门开了、墙切了），流向就反过来。回收软管的过滤器能把空气里的污染滤掉。
entries.en: Negative pressure keeps the air flowing into the isolation room so nothing gets out; lose it (a door open, a wall cut) and the flow reverses. The recovery hose's filter takes contamination out of the air.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 按受力顺序释放
entries.en: RELEASE IN ORDER OF LOAD

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 卷扬机的缆还绷着；两台外挂吊舱一上一下全挂在尾后。
entries.en: The winch's cable still taut; two outboard pods hang aft, one above, one below.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 刹车没松就拆卷扬轴，卷筒甩出；只拆一台吊舱，船体被另一台拽扭。
entries.en: Take the winch shaft with the brake on and the drum flies; take one pod alone and the other twists the hull.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先拔刹车销（张力表归零）；在舰尾设船体支撑，或两台吊舱一起拆。
entries.en: Pull the brake pins (tension to zero) first; set the hull support at the stern, or take both pods together.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 对称挂着的两个重物互相平衡；去掉一个，剩下那个的力矩全由船体承受，超出就扭坏吊梁和支柱。锁喉夹块受力来自卷扬机的缆，要刹车、锁销、蓄能器三样都处理掉。
entries.en: Two weights hung symmetrically balance each other; take one and the hull carries the other's whole moment, twisting its beams and struts. The throat clamp's load comes from the winch cable: brake, pins and accumulator all have to be dealt with.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 拆三明治
entries.en: UNMAKING THE SANDWICH

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 上下两条船体用 8 个液压夹钳夹着中间的居住舱。
entries.en: Two hulls clamp the habitat between them with eight hydraulic clamps.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 货舱没放气就松夹钳会弹开；一侧比另一侧多松两个，货舱扭转、裂了的横梁 2 断掉。
entries.en: Release a clamp before the hold is vented and it springs open; get two ahead on one side and the hold twists and cracked beam 2 snaps.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先放气；交叉成对地松：上1→下4→上4→下1→上2→下3→上3→下2；横梁 2 等上1、下1 松开后再拆。
entries.en: Vent first; release in crossed pairs: U1→L4→U4→L1→U2→L3→U3→L2; beam 2 only after U1 and L1 are off.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 横梁 2 已经开裂，它的载荷表读 192 kN（其余 120 kN）。夹钳还保着压就整件拆下，钳口弹开。三套电路各自独立：上体走主电池，下体和货舱各有自己的电池。
entries.en: Beam 2 is already cracked; its load cell reads 192 kN (the others 120 kN). A clamp taken off while still holding pressure springs its jaw. Three separate circuits: the upper hull on the main battery, the lower hull and the hold each on their own.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 货柜就是承力梁
entries.en: THE CONTAINERS ARE THE BEAM

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 货柜四角扭锁锁在一起，整列货柜就是船体的承力箱梁。
entries.en: Containers twist-locked corner to corner: each column of them is the hull's load-bearing box beam.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 外侧还满着就卸空里面一列，那里折弯；同列从下面抽，上面压下来；拉杆还紧着切会抽回来。
entries.en: Empty an inner column while the outer ones are full and it kinks there; pull from the bottom of a column and the ones above come down; cut a tie rod still tight and it whips.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 从两端往中间卸，每列从上往下；先松花篮螺丝（拉力计读 0）再拆拉杆；有压的箱先抽气。
entries.en: Unload from the ends inward, each column top down; slack the turnbuckles (gauge at zero) before the tie rods; pump down pressurised boxes first.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 船坞夹着第 4 列；每一列的弯曲 = 外侧还在位货柜的量 × 力臂，除以本列的刚度（弦杆 + 在位货柜数）。应变片读本列弯曲占极限的百分比。住人箱 60 kPa、低温箱 450 kPa。
entries.en: The berth holds column 4. Each column's bending is the containers still outboard of it times their lever, over its own stiffness (chords plus containers in place). Strain gauges read it as a share of the limit. Accommodation boxes hold 60 kPa, cryo boxes 450 kPa.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 帆的张力网
entries.en: THE SAIL'S TENSION NET

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 4 台绞盘的刹车各绷着一个象限的薄膜和撑索（每根 12 kN）。
entries.en: Four winch brakes each hold a quadrant's film and stays taut (12 kN a stay).

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 绷着切薄膜就撕，裂口跑到两边；切撑索，角梁甩向吊舱；没接地就碰薄膜，静电打无人机。
entries.en: Cut the film taut and it tears, the tear running on; cut a stay and the corner spar whips at the gondola; touch the film unearthed and static jumps to the drone.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先在左下角接船坞地线，进吊舱松四台绞盘刹车，然后薄膜一块块整块拆，最后撑索和梁。
entries.en: Earth it at the bottom-left socket, release all four winch brakes in the gondola, then take the film off panel by panel, stays and spars after.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 张力计读每个象限的拉力。右上角那块开局就撕了，挨着它切也会撕穿。帆面面积大、电阻高，太阳风让它积累了大量静电。
entries.en: The tension gauges read each quadrant's pull. The top-right panel is already torn, and cutting next to it tears through. A sail is a huge, highly resistive surface; the solar wind has charged it heavily.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 软壳气囊
entries.en: SOFT-SHELL GASBAGS

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 气囊是 30 kPa 的低压容积，形状全靠内压撑着；每个有张紧器和束缚带。
entries.en: Each gasbag is a 30 kPa volume whose shape is only its pressure; each has a tensioner and straps.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 鼓着就切，囊壁撕开塌下来砸设备；张紧器开着就拆带子，带子抽回来。
entries.en: Cut it inflated and the wall tears and collapses onto the equipment; take a strap with the tensioner on and it whips back.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 每个气囊：抽气到 3 kPa 以下（会折叠）→ 松张紧器 → 拆束缚带 → 拆气囊。
entries.en: Each bag: pump below 3 kPa (it folds) → slack its tensioner → its straps → the bag.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 织物壳体只能受拉不能受压：泄了气，它就是一块布。服务舱电池是独立电源，断了脊柱电池它还带电；电容另有放电点。
entries.en: A fabric shell carries tension, never compression: deflated, it's cloth. The service bay's battery is independent of the spine's; the capacitor has its own discharge point.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 旋转的系绳
entries.en: A SPINNING TETHER

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 两个吊舱用系绳连着，整组 2.0 rpm 旋转，张紧器另压着 8 kN。
entries.en: Two pods joined by a tether, the whole pair turning at 2.0 rpm, the tensioner adding 8 kN.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 转着切系绳，两个吊舱沿切线甩出；干刹 6 秒滚轮打滑，制动器永久失效。
entries.en: Cut the tether while it turns and both pods fly off on the tangent; brake it dry and in 6 s the rollers slip and the brake is gone for good.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先开制动冷却再刹，停下后松张紧器，再拆系绳；推进剂先别排（制动失效时要靠 B 舱姿控反喷）。
entries.en: Brake cooling on, then the brake; stopped, slack the tensioner, then the tether. Keep B's propellant (if the brake fails, its thrusters are the only way to stop).

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 系绳张力 = 40 kN × (rpm/2)² + 张紧器 8 kN。开冷却时制动每秒降 0.025 rpm。磨损段只剩 5/7 股：停了但张紧器没松就切，整根崩断。
entries.en: Tension is 40 kN × (rpm/2)² plus the tensioner's 8 kN. With cooling, the brake takes 0.025 rpm off a second. The worn length has 5 of 7 strands: cut it stopped but still tensioned and the whole tether parts.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 铰接与单总线
entries.en: ARTICULATION AND ONE BUS

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 七节模块铰接成一列，400 V 总线经每个联轴器串过去；K-4 卡死弯着。
entries.en: Seven modules articulated in a train, the 400 V bus running through every coupling; K-4 is jammed and bent.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 切断上游总线，后面全黑、罐泵抽不动；后面还挂着 75 t 以上就拆 K-4，后半列弹开。
entries.en: Cut the bus upstream and everything aft goes dark, the tank pumps dead; take K-4 with more than 75 t still hanging aft and the rear half springs.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 从尾巴开始拆 M7、M6，最后处理 K-4；后段要电时打开 M6 的备用电池。
entries.en: Take M7 and M6 off from the tail first and K-4 last; open M6's backup battery when the aft modules need power.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: K-4 上的弯矩计读后面还挂着多少吨（满载约 160 t）。冷却液软管：阀开着时切会喷，先关阀、从低点排放口放掉残液。
entries.en: K-4's bending gauge reads the tonnes still hanging aft (about 160 t full). The coolant hoses spray if cut with their valves open: shut them and drain the low points first.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 料仓与松散矿石
entries.en: THE HOPPER AND LOOSE ORE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 料仓里是一堆细矿和几十块看得见的矿块，从底部放料门放出。
entries.en: The hopper holds a heap of fines and tens of visible chunks, let out through the gates in its floor.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 料仓还半满以上时把放料门硬撬开或切开，矿一下倒向一边，撕裂料仓焊缝。
entries.en: Force or cut a gate open with the hopper still over half full and the ore dumps to one side, tearing its welds.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 正常打开放料门，让矿流进长槽按吨计价；张力件先泄力再拆。
entries.en: Open the gates properly and let the ore run into the trough, paid by the tonne; take the load off tensioned members before removing them.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 细矿以每秒几吨的流量流出，按矿种计价；上面的矿块随着矿堆下降一块块松开跟着走。
entries.en: The fines run out at tonnes a second, paid by ore type; the chunks above come loose one by one as the heap sinks and follow it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 锁轨货物
entries.en: RAIL-LOCKED CARGO

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 货物和滑轨之间是轨道锁，不是螺栓：扳手卸不掉。
entries.en: Cargo sits on its rail behind rail locks, not bolts: no wrench frees it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 门没开就解锁，货撞门；前面一件还锁着就放后面的，后一件撞前一件；切托着货的轨道，货被扯坏。
entries.en: Unlock with the doors shut and it hits them; release one behind a locked one and it rams it; cut the rail carrying it and it's torn.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先放气、开货门（门靠总线供电，断电前开），再从最前面一件开始解锁，让货沿轨道开出。
entries.en: Vent, open the cargo doors (on bus power — before you cut it), then unlock from the front, letting each piece run out along its rail.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 货物出轨道末端后制动到 0.4 m/s 慢慢滑出；前一件没运走就放下一件会撞上。SV-122 的仪器挂在减振吊架上：还有仪器锁着就切主梁或减振连杆，整架砸下。
entries.en: Off the rail's end the cargo is braked to 0.4 m/s and drifts out; release the next before the last is moved and they collide. SV-122's instruments hang in a damped frame: cut its beam or links with instruments still locked to it and the whole frame drops.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 还在转的居住环
entries.en: HABITAT RINGS STILL TURNING

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 两个居住环约 3 rpm 旋转，靠轮毂的电机-制动器消旋。
entries.en: Two habitat rings turning at about 3 rpm, despun by the motor-brakes at their hubs.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 环上负载带电时刹车会烧滑环；只刹一个环船体被拧；环还转就锁轴承，轴承卡死。
entries.en: Brake with the ring's loads live and the slip ring burns; brake only one and the hull twists; lock the bearing while it turns and it seizes.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断环上负载 → 开制动冷却 → 两环一起刹（电容满了放电）→ 停稳后锁轴承 → 再开过渡气闸。
entries.en: Ring loads off → brake cooling on → brake both together (dump the capacitor when full) → lock the bearing once still → only then the transfer airlocks.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 制动把环的动能回馈进电容，电容满了刹车就不起作用，要放电。两环转速差太大持续太久，船坞夹具过载。环上的门对着压力低得多的一侧打开，冲击会打碎玻璃。
entries.en: Braking feeds the ring's energy into a capacitor; full, the brake stops working until it's dumped. Two rings too far apart in speed for too long overload the berth's clamps. A ring room's door opened onto far lower pressure breaks its glass.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 主轴受力
entries.en: THE SPINE'S LOAD PATH

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 尾部的反应堆、发动机和推进剂挂在 440 m 主轴上，弦杆是传力路径。
entries.en: The tail — reactor, engines, propellant — hangs on the 440 m spine; its chords carry the load.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 切一根弦杆，剩下的弦杆分担整个尾部；超出能力那一段撕裂，尾部下坠扭转。
entries.en: Cut a chord and the rest carry the whole tail; past what they take, that segment tears and the tail sags and twists.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先把尾部的重量拆下来，弦杆最后切。
entries.en: Take the weight off the tail first; cut the chords last.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 每一段承受它后面还在船上的所有重量，由还完整的弦杆平分。应变探头读各段受力。
entries.en: Each segment carries everything still aboard aft of it, shared by its chords that are still whole. Strain probes read each segment's load.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 多日作业
entries.en: A JOB OF SEVERAL DAYS

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 这艘船太大，一个工作日拆不完。
entries.en: This ship is too big for one working day.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 每多一天，合同就多一天的运营成本。
entries.en: Every extra day adds a day's running cost to the contract.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 规划好顺序，减少无用功；收工时一切自动保存，第二天接着干。
entries.en: Plan the order to waste nothing; at the end of a day everything is saved and work goes on next day.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 工作日按合同的游戏时间计算。收工时整个物理状态保存，下一天在原处继续。
entries.en: Days are counted from the contract's play time. At day's end the whole physical state is saved and the next day picks up where it stood.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 镜面污染
entries.en: MIRROR CONTAMINATION

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 主镜镜片极贵、易碎，有一张卷帘式防尘罩。
entries.en: The primary's segments are very dear and fragile; there is a roll-down dust cover.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 镜面附近的切割把金属粉尘撒在镜面上，每次切割都掉价值。
entries.en: Every cut near an uncovered segment throws metal dust on its face and takes value off.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先放下防尘罩（电机要有电），再在附近切割。
entries.en: Run the dust cover down (its motor needs power) before cutting anywhere near.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 防尘罩是电动卷帘，没电不能放下；跟着卷轴一起拆走就没了。粉尘污染到一定程度后就不再更糟。
entries.en: The cover is a motorised blind and won't run without power; taken away with its roller, it's gone. Dust alone can only take a segment down so far.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 促动器锁与外圈先拆
entries.en: ACTUATOR LOCKS, OUTER RING FIRST

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 每圈镜片的促动器有一个锁开关，锁只在镜面控制柜有电时才能锁上。
entries.en: Each ring of segments has an actuator lock switch, which only latches while the mirror control cabinet has power.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 促动器没锁就拆镜片，镜片掉出镜座碎裂；外侧还有镜片时拆内侧，外侧的边缘崩掉。
entries.en: Free a segment with its ring unlocked and it drops out and cracks; free an inner one with an outer one still on and the outer's edge chips.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断电前锁好所有圈的促动器，从外圈到内圈拆。
entries.en: Lock every ring before the power goes, and take them from the outside in.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 外圈镜片的内缘搭在内圈镜片上，所以必须由外向内。
entries.en: An outer segment's inner edge is carried by the one inside it, so it has to go outside-in.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 承压玻璃与烤裂
entries.en: GLASS UNDER PRESSURE AND HEAT

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 观景玻璃、穹顶玻璃和精密罩板，用压条螺栓固定，背后扛着舱压。
entries.en: Viewing glass, dome glass and precision panels, held by clamping strips with the room's pressure behind them.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 舱里还有压就拆，玻璃被推出去碎掉；附近 0.7 m 内动激光，玻璃烤裂。
entries.en: Unbolt it with pressure inside and it's blown out and shatters; work the laser within 0.7 m and it crazes.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先泄压，远离玻璃切割，拧下压条整块取出。
entries.en: Vent first, cut well away, unbolt the strips and lift it out whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 一块 2 m² 的观景玻璃在 100 kPa 下受 20 吨推力，压条螺栓一松就失去约束。PS-12 的中央竖井两层的门同时开着时，两层成了一个舱，放一边会把另一层一起带走。
entries.en: A 2 m² viewing pane at 100 kPa carries twenty tonnes; loosen its strips and nothing holds it. On PS-12, with both of the shaft's doors open on two decks, those decks are one room, and venting one takes the other with it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 双路电锁库门
entries.en: THE TWO-SUPPLY VAULT LOCK

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 库门电磁铁走两路电：主总线，和检修柜里的门锁备用电源。
entries.en: Each vault door's solenoid has two supplies: the main bus and a backup in the service locker.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 断了外部主开关，测点读零，门锁和总线照样带电——备用电源经电磁铁倒灌回总线。
entries.en: Kill the main switch outside and the test point reads zero, but the lock and the bus are still live — the backup feeds back through the solenoid.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 进舰尾检修柜断备用电源，两路都断后扳释放杆，库放气，再开门。
entries.en: Go into the stern service locker and kill the backup; with both dead, pull the release lever, vent the vault, open it.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 门锁带电时库门打不开，释放杆也扳不动；扳了以后门自己就能开，不需要电。保管箱整件运走。
entries.en: While the lock has power the door won't open and the lever won't move; once pulled, the door opens on its own, no power needed. The deposit boxes go out whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 船中船
entries.en: A SHIP INSIDE A SHIP

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 货舱里装着一艘完整的小飞船，合同要它整艘完好取出。
entries.en: A whole small ship rides in the hold; the contract wants it out whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 小船任何一块外壳被切或拆，就不再“完整”，只按零件算；托架锁先松船首侧，它会撞向舱门。
entries.en: Cut or take any of its hull and it's no longer whole, only parts; release a bow-side cradle lock first and it lurches into the door.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先处理小船自己的电池、燃料和舱压，从尾到首松托架锁，开首门，开绞车整体拖出。
entries.en: Make it safe first — its battery, fuel and air — release the cradle locks stern first, open the bow door, run the winch to slide it out.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 整艘完好的小船按一个整体计价，远高于它的零件（溢价约是零件价值的 7 倍）。撞上舱门会扣掉一部分溢价、碰坏它的设备。
entries.en: Whole, the small ship is priced as one, far above its parts (about seven times their value). Lurching into the door costs part of that premium and knocks its fittings.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 带压罐与气垫
entries.en: PRESSURISED TANKS AND THE ULLAGE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 推进剂罐顶部是一层高压气垫（增压气），把液体压向出口。
entries.en: Above a propellant tank's liquid sits a cushion of high-pressure gas that drives it to the outlet.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 带压时切开，气垫会把推进剂一起喷出来；整罐切断，几秒内排空。泄压后的罐只会慢慢渗。
entries.en: Cut it under pressure and the cushion blows the propellant out with it; sever the tank and it empties in seconds. A vented tank only seeps.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先关增压，再从排气口放掉气垫，最后才抽液、拆罐。
entries.en: Shut the pressurisation off first, vent the ullage at its port, only then draw it down and take it out.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 增压气不断补进来，罐压就降不下去，放气只是白放；所以顺序是先断气源、再放气垫。气垫放掉后，罐里只剩液体自己的蒸气压，破口处只是渗出，不再喷射。
entries.en: While the pressurant keeps coming the tank pressure won't fall and venting is wasted, so the order is: cut the supply, then vent the ullage. With it gone only the liquid's own vapour pressure is left, and a hole seeps instead of jetting.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 自燃推进剂
entries.en: HYPERGOLIC PROPELLANTS

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 甲基肼罐（T-1、T-3）和四氧化二氮罐（T-2）分开装，T-2 不接燃料总管。
entries.en: Methylhydrazine in T-1 and T-3, nitrogen tetroxide in T-2; T-2 is not on the fuel manifold.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 两种一碰就着，不需要火花，真空里也会爆；爆燃按 TNT 当量计伤害半径。
entries.en: The two light the moment they meet, no spark needed, even in vacuum; the blast's reach goes by its TNT equivalent.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: T-2 从它自己的排放口 LD-2 单独抽；两种的管线和罐别同时破口。
entries.en: Draw T-2 alone at its own drain LD-2; never have both kinds' lines or tanks open at once.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 自燃推进剂省掉了点火器，发动机开关几百次都可靠，所以常用于姿控和变轨。代价是两种都剧毒、腐蚀，泄漏的蒸气碰上就起火。拆解时它们必须在不同的时间、从不同的口子出来。
entries.en: Hypergolics need no igniter, so an engine relights reliably hundreds of times: that is why they fly in thrusters and orbit-raising stages. The price: both are toxic and corrosive, and their vapours ignite on contact. Taking a ship apart, they leave at different times through different ports.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先测再切：容器里有什么
entries.en: MEASURE BEFORE YOU CUT: WHAT'S INSIDE

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 灭火瓶、气瓶、储罐大多不是空的：测量工具扫过去会多一行“内容物”读数。
entries.en: Extinguishers, cylinders and tanks are mostly not empty: the measuring tool shows a CONTENTS line for each.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 气体端口叫“编号-V”，液体端口叫“编号-D”；装着液体的罐更重，抓不动。
entries.en: A gas port is named <tag>-V, a liquid port <tag>-D; a tank with liquid in it is heavier, too heavy to grab.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 先测，看清是什么、多少压力，再决定：放、抽，还是整件送走。
entries.en: Measure first: what it is, at what pressure. Then decide: vent, draw, or send it whole.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 灭火瓶里是约 5.7 MPa 的二氧化碳，氧气瓶是 15 MPa 的氧气，还有氮气、压缩空气、蓄能器、氦气和氢取样瓶；液罐里是水、泥浆、泡沫液、润滑油或服务推进剂。同样的外形，切开后的后果完全不同。
entries.en: Extinguishers hold CO2 at about 5.7 MPa, oxygen cylinders 15 MPa of oxygen; there are nitrogen, compressed air, accumulators, helium and hydrogen sample bottles; tanks hold water, mud, foam, lube oil or service propellant. The same shape, cut open, ends very differently.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 富氧助燃
entries.en: OXYGEN-RICH AIR

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 舱里氧气超过正常空气的 21%：氧气瓶破了，或者舱本来就富氧。
entries.en: A room's air with more oxygen than the usual 21 %: a cylinder burst, or the room was rich to begin with.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 氧越多，越容易点着、烧得越猛；切口、火花一碰就着。氢气本身也能烧。
entries.en: The more oxygen, the easier anything lights and the fiercer it burns: a cut or a spark is enough. Hydrogen burns on its own.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 测舱内氧浓度；超标就先把舱放空，再动激光。
entries.en: Measure the room's oxygen; over the mark, vent the room before the laser.

entries.kind: 首次遇见卡片及完整图鉴
entries.zh: 空气里的氮气稀释了氧，也吸走燃烧放出的热。氧浓度一旦超过 30%，布料、塑料、润滑油的燃速成倍上升；纯氧环境里连钢丝都能被点燃。
entries.en: The nitrogen in air thins the oxygen and soaks up a fire's heat. Above 30 % oxygen, fabric, plastics and oil burn several times faster; in pure oxygen even steel wool will burn.
